notes.title: Updates on Oct 19
notes.content:
Update Announcement
 
Dear Onmyoji,
 
In order to bring you a better gaming experience, the server will be shut down for maintenance from 2:00 - 5:00 EST on Oct 19. If it is not completed on time, the opening time will be postponed accordingly.
 
During the maintenance period, you will not be able to access the game from the server. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. Thank you for your support and understanding!
 
Important Updates
 
1. Reshape Fate Summoning Event

※ Level Requirement: Lv. 5

Summon period: After the maintenance on October 19 – 23:59 EST on October 30

【Uncollected SP/SSR】

During the event, the first SP/SSR shikigami summoned is guaranteed to be an uncollected one!

【Summon Chance Up】

- During the event, when summoning using Mystery Amulets, Jade, or AR Amulets, the drop rate of SP/SSR Shikigami will be 2.5 times the normal rate. The summon rate will revert to the normal rate after you successfully summons 3 SP/SSR Shikigami.

- For those who have completed their SSR collection before the maintenance on October 19, the drop rate for SSR Susanoo or SP Divine Prophet Susabi among all SP/SSR will initially be 15% and continue to increase as they continue to summon, ultimately reaching 100% at 500 summons.

- For others, the drop rate for SSR Susanoo or SP Divine Prophet Susabi among all SP/SSR will continually increase from 4%, up to a maximum of 20% when they has performed 500 summons.

【Special Summon Bonus】

1. For those who have completed their SSR collection before the maintenance on October 19:

- During the event, if they performs 599 summons but did not obtain SSR Susanoo or SP Divine Prophet Susabi, SSR Susanoo or SP Divine Prophet Susabi will appear on the 600th summon and a surprise pack will be presented to them as a reward. 

2. For others:

- The drop rate of SSR Susanoo or the SP Divine Prophet Susabi will be further increased to 30% if they have not obtained SSR Susanoo or SP Divine Prophet Susabi after 600th summons.

【Stage Rewards】

- Summon shikigami via Mystery Amulets, Jade, or AR Amulets for 100 times to receive a random SP shikigami.(Uncollected benefit will not apply)

- Summon shikigami for a certain number of times to receive corresponding stage rewards, which contain a Skill Daruma, a handful of Mystery Amulets, Skin Tokens, Jade, SR shikigami of your choice among other rare items.

【Important Rules】

- All SSR Collected is defined as having all SSR shikigami lit up in your Collection (excluding Ryomen).

- All SSR Collected does not include the crossover shikigami.

- Players below Lv. 5 won't be able to enjoy the event bonuses. But their summoning attempts made during the event are still counted towards the Stage Rewards, allowing them to claim the rewards and enjoy the Chance Up bonus as soon as they reach Lv. 5 during the event.

2. Millennial Guardian Event

※ Event duration: After the maintenance on October 19 –  23:59 EST on November 1

※ Participation requirement: Lv.15

※ The event has two phases. Phase one begins from after the maintenance on October 19 - before the maintenance on October 26.

【Expedition】

※ Event duration: After the maintenance on October 19 - before the maintenance on October 26

※ Susanoo will take the position of the onmyoji in battles.

※ Fight alongside Susanoo in adventurous challenges and receive rewards including Dried Fish, Souls, and more. Find Friendly Allies for assistance along the way.

※ In the special Storm Trial stage, take part in boss challenges and spend Thunder Sigils to receive Soul drops of your choosing as well as Dried Fish, Sizzling Crystals, and Memory Scroll shards among other rewards.

※ Players can also take part in the special Storm Trial stage challenges by spending AP up to 999 times daily.

【Moon Sea】

※ Event duration: After the maintenance on October 19 - before the maintenance on  October 26

※ Head to Moon Sea and challenge Starborn and Tsukuyomi to receive Moon Keys to open Lunar Treasures.

【Millennial Stories】

※ Event duration: After the maintenance on October 19 - 23:59 EST on November 1

※ Head to Millennial Stories and read all about the daily stories and shard stories of the event.

【Showdown Bidding】

※ Event duration: October 26 at 11:00 - November 1 at 11:00

※ The Showdown Bidding zone offers 1 match every 2 hours from 2:00-22:00 daily during the second phase of Millennial Guardian.

※ Players can view the lineup and the Souls of two teams. Support a team based on the given info. The battle result will be announced when the match countdown ends.

【Charging Pool】

※ Collect Sizzling Crystals in the Expedition zone. Rack them up to activate battle bonuses for the whole team.

※ Promote Susanoo on the Skills page by raising the skill levels of Spear of Thunder, Thunder Realm, and Thundering Speed.

※ The abilities in Charging Pool are only effective in the Expedition zone.

【Takamagahara Pass】

※ Complete quests in the event to gain Thunder Orbs, used to increase Susanoo's travel distance and receive Millennial Guardian exclusive nameplate and touch-responsive effect among other rewards.

※ The Thunder Pass can be purchased to unlock Millennial Guardian exclusive theme and Skill Daruma shards among other rewards.

※ Takamagahara Pass will be available until 23:59 EST on November 8. Unclaimed rewards will be reissued via in-game mail at the end of the event.

【Ibuki's Vault】

※ Spend Dried Fish obtained from the event to exchange for rewards in Ibuki's Vault. Rewards include Dodomeki's new Pearly Eyes skin, a random SSR/SP Shikigami Summoning Scroll, a Skill Daruma, the event exclusive frame, and illustrations among other rewards.

※ Ibuki's Vault is open until 23:59 EST on November 8. Please remember to purchase rewards in time.

The second phase of Millennial Guardian begins after the maintenance on October 26.

3. Summoning Bundle Event

※ Available: After the maintenance on October 19 –  23:59 EST on November 8

※ Spend Jade to purchase Summoning Bundle or Premium Summoning Bundle. Only one kind of the Summoning Bundles can be purchased during the event.

※ Summoning Bundle: Grants 5 free Mystery Summoning or Memory Summons attempts daily for 30 days. Free summon attempts from Summoning Bundle can be stored up to 10.

※ Premium Summoning Bundle: Grants 10 free Mystery Summoning or Memory Summons attempts daily for 30 days. Free summon attempts from Summoning Bundle can be stored up to 20.

※ When players summon shikigami in Mystery Summoning or Memory Summons, they will use the free attempts first. If they don't have enough free attempts, Mystery Amulets or Recollection Amulets will be used.

4. SSR Susanoo and SP Divine Prophet Susabi Memory Scrolls Event

※ Event duration:After the maintenance on October 19 –  23:59 EST on November 8

※ During the event, you can obtain scroll shards by participating in different in-game activities. For every scroll shard donated, you will receive 1 random reward. After the memory scroll has been repaired, you can view the corresponding story.

※ Rewards will be given out to players according to their donation ranking, including SSR Susanoo or SP Divine Prophet Susabi shards, the Maple Night frame, Skill Daruma, and more.

※ For those who rank top 1000 or those whose repair contribution is above 2000, they will receive the Thunder Divination Frame.

※ The story of the Scrolls will be unlocked follwing the progress of Millennial Guardian event.

5. Stars Aligned

When the stars are aligned, the prophecy will happen.

Give Divine Prophet Susabi Star Orbs and he will give you Fallen Stars in return.

After receiving a certain number of Star Orbs, he will grant Fallen Stars which can be exchanged for more rewards.

※ Event duration: After the maintenance on October 19 –  23:59 EST on November 1

※ Access portals: Jizo Statue and the Paper Doll in the Courtyard

※ Star Orbs can be obtained by gaining 100 Talisman EXP via daily quests in Talisman Pass, challenging Demon Encounter bosses, and purchasing packs.

※ When all 24 lanterns are lit, additional Fallen Stars will be rewarded. After 24 lanterns are lit for the first time, the event exclusive Stars Aligned frame can be claimed.

※ Fallen Stars can be exchanged for rare rewards in the Observatory. Rewards include the Courtyard's animated night and day Celestial Haven skin and the event exclusive animated Stars Re-aligned frame, as well as the SSR Orochi's Shivering Shadow skin and Chiming Thoughts frame.

※ The Courtyard's animated night and day Celestial Haven skin includes three time periods — Dawn, Dusk, and Night. The views shift for each time period at 7:00, 16:00, and 20:00, respectively based on the real-world time. Enjoy watching the sun and moon rise and fall and listen to Celestial music in the Courtyard. More Easter Eggs are waiting to be explored.

※ For more event rules, please head to the event page.

6. Celestial Gift Event

※ Event duration: After the maintenance on October 19 –  23:59 EST on November 1

※ During the event, access the event from the paper doll on the right of the Courtyard. Collect 100 Talisman EXP from daily quests to make a wish for free daily. Free wishes can be stored (up to 9). You can also spend 1 Wish Voucher to make a wish.

※ Each wish made is guaranteed to grant a reward. The same reward won't be granted twice. No more wishes can be made after all wish rewards are granted.

※ Each wish made also increases the wish progress. When the wish progress reaches 3/6/9, wish progress rewards can be claimed. Wish progress rewards include the Courtyard's Celestial Garden courtyard skin and event-exclutive emoji.

※ For more event rules, please head to the event page.

7. Assemble for the Ultra Odokuro zone!

※ At 6:00-9:00 and 19:00-22:00 every day, Demon Encounters are available. Players who have obtained the Unyielding mark are eligible to search for and challenge the Ultra Odokuro.

※ Ultra Odokuro offers mutation skills to players and the boss. Ultra Odokuro's mutation skills rotate each week.

※ Ultra Odokuro grants better ranking rewards for being victorious in battle.

※ Ultra Odokuro appears for 20 minutes. If it's not defeated within that time, it will flee.

※ For a better Ultra Tsuchigumo experience, eligible players have a chance of finding Ultra Odokuro daily, excluding Wednesdays. This doesn't affect their chance of finding Ghostly Songstress, Shinkirou, Namazu or Oboroguruma.

※ Available daily: October 19 – November 15

8. Added Return Challenges as the Return Benefits!

※ During the Return Benefits event, players can challenge levels in Return Challenges, and can get great resource rewards for achieving victory.

※ Team up with other players to receive additional Soaring Decors for being victorious in battle.

※ From the day players return to Heian-Kyo, they will receive 50 Return Challenge Passes every 6 days (resotre max up to 50 Passes). Be sure to use them in time.

※ Added the Return chat channel for return players to ask questions. Other players can help them by answering their questions.

9. Ebisu's Boutique is available

※ Event duration: After the maintenance on October 19 – 23:59 EST on December 20

※ Event details:

- During the event, you can obtain Ebisu's Fortune Shop exclusive frame Dazzling Gold by recharging in the game. You will have a chance to upgrade the frame by obtaining this the frame again from the future Ebisu's Boutique events.

- Recharge to certain amounts to receive the Moonlight Courtyard skin, Seimei's Dark Seimei skin, Skill Daruma, and more!

- For some itmes, if you receive more than one, they will be converted in to other items as follows:

Moonlight Courtyard skin → 1000 Jade

Seimei's "Dark Seimei" skin → "Lord of Kyoto" frame

Seimei's "Dark Seimei" skin + "Lord of Kyoto" frame → "Lord of Kyoto" frame (Gold Daruma version)

- For Players who already have the "Lord of Kyoto" frame (Gold Daruma version), they will gain the right to enter the Boutique, and receive 2 Boutique talismans when they receive the "Dark Seimei" skin again.

- Players who have obtained the Lord of Kyoto frame twice are eligible to receive the exclusive My Page skin.

※ Improvement:

- Fully improved Seimei's Fortune Shop Dark Seimei skin, including adjustments made to the concept art, fine model, skill actions, effects and voices. Also, a new exclusive bio has been added.

 10. New Totem's Inkborn Apex Series Skins

※ Available: After the maintenance on October 19

※ The new totem's Inkborn Apex series skins are available in Ebisu's Fortune Shop. The series includes Cloud Blazer, Branch Skulker, Shadowy Pouncer, and Bell Nipper.

※ Players can exchange them with Boutique Talismans.

11. Paper Doll Skin Updated

※ New Paper Doll Skins are available after the maintenance on October 19 –  23:59 EST on November 15

※ Added Divine Prophet Susabi, Susanoo, Celebration and Autumn Harvest Paper Doll skins which can be purchased in Paper Doll Shrine > Collection.

※ Note: The Paper Doll's Autumn Harvest skin is the Paper Doll's Month Series skin, pricing at 128 Jade. Collect all Month Series Paper Doll Skins and you will unlock the exclusive Paper Doll Skin: Traces of Time skin.

12. Wish Bundle

※ Event duration: After the maintenance on October 19 –  23:59 EST on October 30

※ S-Jade can be used to purchase Silver and Gold Packs. Bronze Pack can be claimed by the player above Lv.15.

※ The number of Bronze, Silver, and Gold Packs players purchased will be calculated respectively. When they reach certain thresholds, players who purchased the packs can claim additional rewards.

※ Inkfish Pond Frame is included in Silver, and Gold Packs, surplus frames will be converted to 50 Jade.

13. Memory Summons Updated

※ Summoning duration: After the maintenance on October 19 – 23:59 EST on November 1

※ Chance Up shikigami for this update including Fallen God Orochi, Virtuoso Hana, Kidomaru, Shiranui, Menreiki, Shishio.

※ Chance Up shikigami for the next update will include Inaba Kaguya, Void Menreiki, Asura, Miketsu, Aoandon, Ootengu.

【New pack】

※ The new Recollection Pack is now available! They can be purchased in Shop > Pack.

※ For more details, please check on the event page.

14. Bonding Shrine Updated

※ The Bonding Shrine ends on Oct 30 at 23:59.

※ The Bonding Coin will vanish after the Bonding shrine is closed, please use them in time.

15. New Skin - Duskveil Crypt

※ Nightveil Higanbana's new skin - Duskveil Crypt will be available in the Skin shop after the maintenance on October 19, with a 20% off discount in the first week! Don't miss it!

16. Good luck doesn't wait! - Selectable Soul Drop Event

Not enough souls to get your Shikigami fully equipped? No worries, the Soul drop event is coming!

※ Event Duration:  October 22 -  October 23

- During this event, you can choose the type of souls that drop into the Soul Zone.

- You can choose 4 types of souls. The same soul cannot be chosen more than once in any lineup. After you have selected a lineup, you can edit it at any time for free.

- Your selected lineup will be in effect for the first 200 challenges each day. After this, the soul lineup will return to normal.

Improvement

1. Improved the display of the Courtyard:

※ Added the Auto Yard mode. Players of Lv. 30 or above can enable it in Settings. The game will enter the Yard mode if no action is taken within 5 minutes for players to enjoy the view of their Courtyard. Players can also switch between different background music for their Courtyard with the button in the bottom right corner.

※ Moved the portal to Traveler's Stop to the scroll on the Courtyard. Added Mentor's Guidance portal to Traveler's Stop.

※ Resized the scale of the main Courtyard page.

※ Resized the buttons at the bottom of the Exploration map.

※ Unified the style of some of the buttons in the Courtyard.

※ Improved the display of the paper doll's push rewards and letters.

※ Improved page turning button below the paper doll hanging on the right of the Courtyard. Added an animated notification when players first access the Courtyard.

※ Improved the display style for the pets in Pet House when they're hungry, sad, visited by friends, and upgraded.

2. Added Return Gift for return players:

※ Consolidated benefits and rewards for return players from playing different zones to the Return Gift page for players to easily check them.

3. Added a Preset button to the Preset Lineup in Demon Encounter boss battles and Guild Kirin Hunt battles for players to quickly deploy their lineup.

4. Improved the battle experience for Assembly Bosses. Players who haven't reached Lv. 35 and don't have grade 6 shikigami will receive damage reduction when challenging Assembly Bosses.

5. Improved the rotation feature for Themes, Nameplates, and TR Effects.

※ When Random Set is enabled, checking any Nameplate, Theme, or TR Effect will check the correlated resources from the same set. The option is disabled by default.

※ Changed Auto-alternate Limited-time Decorations to Limited-Time Deco Rotate. When this is enabled, the limited time Theme, Nameplate, and TR Effect will be used by default. The option is enabled by default.

※ If players have already made changes to the status of these two options, they will remain unchanged.

6. Improved the chat feature, changing the unlocking level of chat emoji search and synchronizing images sent features to Lv. 15.

7. Soul Profiles limit adjusted:

※ The Soul Profiles limit has been increased from 200 to 300.

※ The Preset Lineups limit adjusted:

- The Preset Lineups limit has been increased from 50 to 80.

※ The Soul storage limit adjusted:

- When the grade 6 level 15 Souls players own reach 1,500/2,000/3,000/4,000/5,000/6,000/7,000 (previously 2,000/3,000/4,000/5,000/6,000/7,000/8,000), the Souls they can store will be increased to 6,500/7,000/8,000/9,000/10,000/11,000/12,000 respectively.

8. Improvements for Ultra Area Boss:

※ Improved how levels are unlocked and how their progress is carried over for all levels. Now, all Area Boss levels are unlocked based on the highest level unlocked for one of the Area Bosses.

※ Improved how selected modifiers are saved when quitting levels in some scenarios. Now, when players quit a level, the currently selected modifiers will be saved.

※ Improved the display adaptability of AP for some devices.

9. Improved the chat channel:

※ Team creation info has been moved from the System channel to the Team channel. Players can see team creation messages while they're not on a team, and won't see any team creation messages while they're on a team.

※ Improved the auto-sharing rules and text for upgraded Souls. Now, only outstanding or interesting Souls will be auto-shared via the System channel, and the Souls will be displayed in a more direct manner as text.

10. Improved the issue with the SR shikigami Garuda where his Valuable Feather ended up in a looping trigger that could not be stopped in some scenarios.

11. Improved the looks and display of cute edition shikigami in Fellowship > Decors and the outfits on the Customize page. Now, the styles are unified.

12. Improved the fine model for the SSR shikigami Susabi before and after his evolution.

13. Improved the fine model for the SSR shikigami Susabi's special Golden Shrine skin.

Fixed Issue

1. Fixed the incorrect skill description and skill label for some shikigami.

2. Improved the pose of the SP shikigami Yamalord Enma when she's on the shikigami selection page in Draft Duel.

3. Fixed the overlapping issue with the limited time Nameplate, Theme, and TR Effect where they were overlapping with the default ones.

4. Fixed the issue where the Assist access was blocked by the paper doll in portrait mode.

5. Fixed the issue where when the external chat window is brought up, the damage amount displayed in-battle was missing.

6. Fixed the issue where changing skins in the Onmyoji menu was causing the character in the Courtyard to be changed.

7. Fixed the issue with [Silver Fan: Star] and [Silver Fan: Death] where their effective time was incorrect in some scenarios.

8. Fixed the issue with [Possess] by Nyunai-suzume, where when the effect was triggered, additional stats weren't timely removed.

notes.title: Updates on Aug 17
notes.content:
Update Announcement
 
Dear Onmyoji,
 
In order to bring you a better gaming experience, the server will be shut down for maintenance from 2:00 - 4:00 EST on August 17. If it is not completed on time, the opening time will be postponed. For details regarding the update, please check the update announcement which will be posted later, or the game login page after the maintenance.
 
During the maintenance period, you will not be able to access the game from the server. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. Thank you for your support and understanding!
 
Important Updates
 
1. SP Heartseeker Momiji Assembly Event

SP Heartseeker Momiji will soon be available for summoning, stay tuned!

※ Assembly period:  August 20 - 23:59 EST on August 23

※ Summoning period: After the maintenance on August 24 - 23:59 EST on September 4

※ During the Assembly period, you can watch the story and claim rewards on the summon page.

2. Battle of Blessings: Daruma Fest Event

※ Event duration: After the maintenance on August 17 - 23:59 EST on August 23

※ Mountain spirits have showed up in the blessing event to crash the party. Catch the mountain spirits in entertaining battles during the event. Each player has 5 challenge attempts daily. A successful challenge is to catch a mountain spirit. A failed challenge won't consume the attempts.

※ During the event, catch a total of 20 spirits to unlock all the rewards, including the Rapid Promotion chance for an SR shikigami.

※ The choices of Rapid Promotion for SR shikigami only include all SR released prior to Oshiroibaba (including Oshiroibaba).

※ For more details, please head to the event page.

3. Sweet Roulette Event

※ Event duration: After the maintenance on August 17 - 23:59 EST on August 23

※ During the event, Sweet Vouchers are available for purchase in the Pack shop. 1 Sweet Voucher will be rewarded for completing the Demon Encounter zone daily.

※ You can spend 1or 5 Sweet Voucher to roll the Amezaiku's roulette for once or five times. Each rolling has a chance of receiving an exclusive skin (including  the Maestro's Serene Virtuoso skin, Okuribito's Winter Waltz skin, Valiant Yamakaze's Frost Feathers skin), the Summon Room's Starry Tunes skin, Jade, and Skill Daruma shards among other rare items.

※ If you fail to obtain an exclusive skin or the Summon Room's Starry Tunes skin in the first 14 rolls, you're guaranteed to receive an exclusive skin or summon Room's Starry Tunes skin in the 15th roll (You won't receive the skin you already owned).

※ When the event is over, the remaining Sweet Vouchers will be removed. Please use them in time.

4. Guild Draft Event

※ Event duration: After the maintenance on August 17 - 23:59 EST on August 30

※ During the event, every Sunday from 02:00 - 23:00, the Leader and Officers can start a Guild Draft.

※ You can register, pick random initial shikigami and Blessings, fight your Guildmates for Feat and Guild Medals among other great rewards.

※ The more members playing, the more Guild Medals the Guild can earn. We recommend starting the zone while more Guildmates are online.

5. Special Skin Pack – Worldly Days Series is on sale!

※ Worldly Days Series skin pack will be available in the Skin Shop after the maintenance on August 17.

※ The Special Skin Pack enjoys an exclusive 64%-off discount for the first week! 

※ The Skin pack includes 5 skins as follow:
- Senhimei's Tidal Symphony skin
- Taishakuten's Sacred Sundown skin
- Suzuka Gozen's Draconic Night skin
- Nyunai-suzume's Midday Murmurs skin
- Akaname's Morning Dew skin

※ You can also purchase them in skin store separately with 20% off for the first week. (the discount applies to both Skin Tokens and S-Jade)

※ Discount period: After the maintenance on August 17 - before the maintenance on August 24

6. FORTUNE! Discount and Free Refresh in Soul Shop

※ Event duration: 0:00 EST on August 17 - 23:59 EST on August 23

※ Every day during the event, the first 10 purchases in the soul shop will have a 20% discount and the lineup can be refreshed 30 times for free.

Fixed Issue

Fixed language and technical bugs.

notes.title: Updates on July 27
notes.content:
Update Announcement
 
Dear Onmyoji,
 
In order to bring you a better gaming experience, the server will be shut down for maintenance from 2:00 - 5:00 EST on July 27. If it is not completed on time, the opening time will be postponed accordingly.
 
During the maintenance period, you will not be able to access the game from the server. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. Thank you for your support and understanding!
 
Important Updates
 
1. Underworld Upheaval Summoning Event

※ Level Requirement: Lv. 5

Summon period: After the maintenance on July 27 – 23:59 EST on August 7

【Summon Chance Up】

- During the event, when summoning using Mystery Amulets, Jade, or AR Amulets, the drop rate of SP/SSR Shikigami will be 2.5 times the normal rate. The summon rate will revert to the normal rate after you successfully summons 3 SP/SSR Shikigami.

- For those who have completed their SSR collection before the maintenance on July 27, the drop rate for SP Yamalord Enma among all SP/SSR will initially be 10% and will continue to increase as they continue to summon, ultimately reaching 100% at 500 summons.

- For others, the drop rate for SP Yamalord Enma among all SP/SSR will continually increase from 3%, up to a maximum of 15% when they has performed 500 summons.

【Special Summon Bonus】

1. For those who have completed their SSR collection before the maintenance on July 27:

- During the event, if they performs 599 summons but did not obtain SP Yamalord Enma, SP Yamalord Enma will appear on the 600th summon and a surprise pack will be presented to them as a reward. 

2. For others:

- The drop rate of SP Yamalord Enma will be further increased to 25% if they have not obtained SP Yamalord Enma after 600th summons.

【Stage Rewards】

Summon shikigami for a certain number of times to receive corresponding stage rewards, which contain a Skill Daruma, a handful of Mystery Amulets, Skin Tokens, Jade, SR shikigami of your choice among other rare items.

【Important Rules】

- All SSR Collected is defined as having all SSR shikigami lit up in your Collection (excluding Ryomen).

- All SSR Collected does not include the crossover shikigami.

- Players below Lv. 5 won't be able to enjoy the event bonuses. But their summoning attempts made during the event are still counted towards the Stage Rewards, allowing them to claim the rewards and enjoy the Chance Up bonus as soon as they reach Lv. 5 during the event.

2. The Immortal Eyes Event

The destruction of the Underworld has brought Yamalord Enma here. But where will she lead the dead souls to now? Follow the Lady of the Underworld as she passes the trials of monsters and discover the fate of the Underworld!

※ Event duration: After the maintenance on July 27 – 23:59 EST on August 2

※ Participation requirement: Lv. 15

【Sanzu Tributaries】

The Underworld river has been divided and the dead souls have no place to rest. Clear evil forces and you just might be able to rebuild the path to reincarnation.

※ Yamalord Enma will take the position of the onmyoji in battles.

※ Spend Underworld Lamps to challenge zones and win Souls, EXP Pamphlets, Coins, and Evo Materials among other great rewards.

【Underworld Turmoil】

Traps laid by monsters as well as the lost belongings of dead souls are hidden in the turmoil of the war.

※ Solve mysteries with Yamalord Enma and explore oddities on the map.

※ Collect the shards of certain remains and unlock insights into the past in Book of Life.

【Cleansed Impurities】

The evil of monsters and spirits pervades the Underworld. But since everything in the Underworld belongs to Enma, their power is at her command.

※ Collect Oxen Fiends and Horse Masks in Sanzu Tributaries and Underworld Turmoil zones.

※ Collect Oxen Fiends to raise Yamalord Enma's stats and skill levels.

※ Spend Horse Masks to unlock and promote skill levels for the whole team.

【Blissful Walk】

※ Complete daily quests and achievement quests in the event to gain Wandering Names, used to increase Walk distance and receive rewards.

※ The Underworld Pass can be purchased to unlock Theme: Immortal Eyes and Skill Daruma shards among other rewards.

※ Blissful Walk will be available until August 9 at 23:59. Unclaimed rewards will be reissued via in-game mail at the end of the event.

【Underworld Shop】

※ Obtain great rewards and Blissful Gold in the event.

※ Spend Blissful Gold in the event shop to purchase the SR shikigami Okikumushi's Kokeshi skin, the event-exclusive Reincarnation Lord frame, Skill Daruma, and SSR/SP Summoning Scroll among other rewards. Oxen Fiends and Horse Masks can also be purchased from the shop.

※ Underworld Shop is open until August 9 at 23:59. Please remember to purchase rewards in time.

3. SP Yamalord Enma Memory Scrolls Event

※ Event duration: After the maintenance on July 27 – 23:59 EST on August 16

During the event, you can obtain scroll shards by participating in different in-game activities. For every scroll shard donated, you will receive 1 random reward. After the memory scroll has been repaired, you can view the corresponding story.

Rewards will be given out to players according to their donation ranking, including SP Yamalord Enma shards, Soul Collector frame, Skill Daruma, and more.

For players who rank top 1000 or those whose repair contribution is above 2000, they will receive the Final Judgment Frame.

4. Realm Summons with Chance Up Bonus

※ Event duration: After the maintenance on July 27 – 23:59 EST on August 7

※ During the event, purchase the Realm Summoning pack to create a team or spend Jades to join others' team. The summonable SP/SSR shikigami will be defined by the daily selections.

※ The shikigami pool includes SSR shikigami Fukengaku and the shikigami released before.
※ For the detailed rules and shikigami selections of each day, please check the event page when the event is available.

5. Bonding Shrine

※ During the event, summon Shikigami via Mystery Amulets, Jade, AR Amulets, or Recollection Amulets to receive Bonding Coins. Bonding Coins can be used in the Bonding Shop to purchase various rare items, including the latest SP/SSR shikigami and Hakuzosu's Nocturnal Predator skin among other rewards.

※ Each Bonding Shrine event lasts until three new SSR/SP shikigami have arrived in Heian-Kyo. Shikigami that can be summoned via a Mystery Amulet, Jade, or AR Amulet will become available in the Bonding Shop when they arrives in Heian-Kyo.

※ Bonding Coins will be removed by the end of this Bonding Shrine event.

6. Special skin Exalted Lotus

※ After the maintenance on July 27, Taishakuten's Special edition skin Exalted Lotus will be available in the Skin Store at the price of 220 S-Jade. You can purchase it for 160 S-Jade in the first week!

※ The skin features the following:
- New actions and skill effects
- Exclusive frame
- Exclusive voice and sound effects
- Exclusive Bio.

※ Note: The first week discount doesn't stack with any other kind of discount.

7. Memory Summons Updated

※ Summoning duration: After the maintenance on July 27 - 23:59 EST on August 9

※ Chance Up shikigami for this update including Ninja Yamausagi, Crimson Yoto, Senhime, Yamakaze, Hana, Lord Arakawa.

※ Chance Up shikigami for the next update will include Monumental Otakemaru, Vengeful Hannya, Fukengaku, Tamamonomae, Kaguya, Ichimokuren.

※ The new Recollection Pack is now available! They can be purchased in Shop > Pack.

※ For more details, please check on the event page.

8. New skin available in the Shrine

The Yamalord Enma's Dark Blue skin is available in the Shrine.

※ Duration: after the maintenance on July 27 - 23:59 EST on August 4

※ Price:
- Yamalord Enma's Dark Blue skin: SP Skin Tokens * 40

9. Paper Doll Skin Updated

※ New Paper Doll Skins are available after the maintenance on July 27 – 23:59 EST on August 23

※ Added Senhime, Blue Sea and Rain Paper Doll skins which can be purchased in Paper Doll Shrine > Collection.

※ Note: The Paper Doll's Rain skin is the Paper Doll's Month Series skin, with 128 S-Jade. Collect all Month Series Paper Doll Skins and you will unlock the exclusive Paper Doll Skin: Traces of Time skin.

10. Double Guild Medals from Demon Encounter

※ Event duration:  0:00 EST on July 27 - 23:59 EST on August 2

※ During the event, the Guild Medals obtained after challenging Demon Encounter will be doubled!

Improvement

1. Improvements for Auto challenge Function: 

※ If auto-challenge is enabled in solo mode, the lineup will be automatically locked once the player is ready.

※ If auto-challenge is enabled in team mode, the lineup will need to be manually locked.

2. Improvements for auto wish-making in Guild:

※ When a wish is made, the default shard amount for the wish has now been changed to 1.

※ Simplified how players make and edit their wishes. Removed the second confirmation pop-up for making and editing wishes.

3. Added Japanese voices for the SP shikigami Fallen God Orochi: in-battle voice, touch-responsive voice in the Shikigami menu, Profile animation, voice, bios, and summoning animation.

4. Improved how players can equip shikigami skins before the Evo feature is enabled during the rookie stage.

Fixed Issue

1. Fixed the incorrectly appeared Show Shikigami button on the Shikigami menu Profile page in some scenarios.

2. Fixed the special effect display error on the SSR shikigami Mishige in some scenarios.

3. Fixed an issue with the SR shikigami Garuda where his Valuable Feather mark wasn't correctly triggered in some scenarios.

4. Fixed an incorrect interaction between the R shikigami Jikikaeru and the sacrifice mechanics where Jikikaeru's passive skill Change of Luck was triggered when he's sacrificed.

5. Fixed the model display of the SP shikigami Fallen God Orochi in some scenarios.

6. Fixed the issue where multiple exclusive effects of the same kind were incorrectly valid in some scenarios.

7. Fixed the missing default emojis in the chat screen.

8. Fixed an issue that the Co-op quests can not be posted by Mentor in some scenarios.

notes.title: Updates on July 20
notes.content:
Update Announcement
 
Dear Onmyoji,
 
In order to bring you a better gaming experience, the server will be shut down for maintenance from 2:00 - 4:00 EST on July 6. If it is not completed on time, the opening time will be postponed. For details regarding the update, please check the update announcement which will be posted later, or the game login page after the maintenance.
 
During the maintenance period, you will not be able to access the game from the server. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. Thank you for your support and understanding!
 
Important Updates
 
1. SP Yamalord Enma Assembly Event

SP Yamalord Enma will soon be available for summoning, stay tuned!

※ Assembly period:  July 23 - July 26 at 23:59 EST

※ Summoning period: After the maintenance on July 27 - August 7 at 23:59

※ During the Assembly period, you can watch the story and claim rewards on the summon page.

2. Summer Workout Event

※ Event duration: After the maintenance on July 20 - 23:59 EST on August 2

※ During the event, take part in the Exploration zones, Soul zones, Evo zones and Duel to earn points and exchange the rewards. 

※ For more details, please check on the event page.

3. Battle Puzzles Event

※ Event duration: After the maintenance on July 20- 23:59 EST on July 26

※ Level requirement: Lv. 15

※ New shikigami with new challenges!

※ Event Rules:

During the event, a puzzle with three difficulty levels will be unlocked for challenge each day. You will enter the battles with pre-configured shikigami and Soul sets. Use the skills wisely to solve the puzzle for rewards!

4. FORTUNE! Discount and Free Refresh in Soul Shop

※ Event duration: 0:00 EST on July 20 - 23:59 EST on July 26

※ Every day during the event, the first 10 purchases in the soul shop will have a 20% discount and the lineup can be refreshed 30 times for free.

Improvement

1. Improvements for Mentor's Guidance:

※ Adjusted how quests are completed in Practice Trainings. The fixed quests have now been divided into four categories, each granting a certain number of points, to allow players with different preferences to complete quests.

※ Added a feature for the Apprentice to request help from their Mentor. When an Apprentice encounters a quest that they may need help with, they can use the Request Help button on the quest to request help from their Mentor.

※ Adjusted the difficulty levels of Co-op Quests, changing the number of available quests to 4. When the Mentor gifts Souls to their Apprentice, they will receive more resource rewards.

※ Adjusted tags and matching rules. Mentors can get tags based on the actions they preferred.

Fixed Issue

Fixed language and technical bugs.

notes.title: Updates on July 6
notes.content:
Update Announcement
 
Dear Onmyoji,
 
In order to bring you a better gaming experience, the server will be shut down for maintenance from 2:00 - 4:00 EST on July 6. If it is not completed on time, the opening time will be postponed. For details regarding the update, please check the update announcement which will be posted later, or the game login page after the maintenance.
 
During the maintenance period, you will not be able to access the game from the server. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. Thank you for your support and understanding!
 
Important Updates
 
1. Summer Funfair Event

Some friends have arrived in Heian-Kyo once again in the summer heat and they're now holding a funfair in the capital! Let's go and have some fun!

※ Event duration: After the maintenance on July 6 –  23:59 EST on July 19

【Ice Candy Castle】

Come and have some ice in the heat of summer! Don't you try to run, you trouble makers!

※ Help shikigami complete orders to receive Fair Tickets and special rewards!

【Daruma Builder】

Keep steady and stack them up! Help Kamaitachi stack up daruma! The higher the better!

※ Control the shaking Ichitaro and drop daruma blocks at the right moments. The more centered it is over the block below, the higher the score you will get!

※ If it's too far to one side of the block below or the daruma stack collapses, you will fail and the game will end.

※ Spend Fair Tickets to participate in Competitive or Cooperative modes and get  FairCoins based on your score. Come and experience it with friends!

【Gem Digger】

Dig for underground treasures with amulets and the Paper Doll!

※ Control the Paper Doll and release amulets at the right moments to dig for treasures buried underground.

※ Spend Fair Tickets to start the game and receive Fair Coins as well as Forgotten Books.

【Night Shows】

Familiar faces have appeared on the stage, as well as mysterious guests. Give them candies and be rewarded!

※ Spend Fair Tickets and Demon Parade Passes to start the show. Get shikigami shards and Fair Coins by giving candies to shikigami!

※ At least 1 SSR/SP shikigami will appear in each game in Night Shows. Don't miss out!

【Magic Masks】

The masks are here again with new tools!

※ Slide on the screen to move the masks. Merge them into masks of higher grades and earn more Fair Coins!

※ Use new items Swallow and Hammer wisely to get more points!

【Affection Wishes for Gudetama and Bad Badtz-Maru】

※ Players who don't yet own Gudetama or Bad Badtz-Maru can wish for the Affection of them in Guilds!

2. Talisman Pass (July)

※ Event duration: After the maintenance on July 6 –  before the maintenance on August 3

※ You can complete different missions to increase the Talisman level.

※ As the Talisman level increases, Onmyoji can obtain various rewards including the exclusive frame.

※ Purchase the Deluxe Talisman to unlock bonus rewards such as the exclusive animated frame, an exclusive illustration and Hana's Gilded Phoenix skin!

Updated Legacy Talisman and related shop:

- You can purchase Legacy Talisman from the Talisman Pass - Shop page. Upon purchase, each Talisman Pass level you reached grants you a Talisman Coin. Each Talisman Pass grants up to 50 Talisman Coins.

- Talisman Coins can be used to purchase month-related skins from previous Talisman Passes. Spend Talisman Coins to purchase the Kaguya's return skin - Origami Moon and Otakemaru's return skin - Kraken Drums for the current Talisman Pass.

3. Realm Raid: Froglet Invasion Event

※ Event duration: 0:00 EST on July 6 -  23:59 EST on July 10

※ During the event, after you refresh the Realm Raid, froglets will appear to take the place of a few random  realms. In these particular realms, the shikigami and the onmyoji will be replaced by froglets. You can challenge up to 3 froglet realms daily.

※ During the event, each day after you finish raiding froglet realms for 3 times and refreshing the page, Oboroguruma will appear to take the place of a realm, where the shikigami will be replaced by froglets and the onmyoji will be replaced by Oboroguruma. In the Oboroguruma realm, your own froglets will receive stats bonus. You can challenge up to 1 Oboroguruma realm daily.

※ Challenging froglet realms grants Medals and Froglet Medals as rewards, with a chance to grant Oboroguruma Realm Cards. If you deploy all froglets in   battle, you will receive extra rewards on victory. The Medal drop from this event is not affected by Medal Drop Bonus.

※ During the event, items that are exchangeable with Froglet Medals will be available in Shop > General > Medal. These items include: upgradable   animated Froglet Invasion frame and grade 5 Oboroguruma Realm Card among others. The event items will be removed from Shop after the event. The Froglet Medals you earn in the event will be kept for you to exchange for the   items available in future Realm Raid: Froglet Invasion events.

※ The first time you claim the highest level progress chest from Realm Raid each day, you will receive an extra random froglet shard.

※ The froglet realm, Oboroguruma realm respawning attempt and froglet shard claiming attempt can not be accumulated and will refresh at 0:00 EST each day. 

※ For more details, please head to the Realm Raid page.

Fixed Issue

Fixed language and technical bugs.

notes.title: Updates On June 29th
notes.content:
Update Announcement
 
Dear Onmyoji,
 
In order to bring you a better gaming experience, the server will be shut down for maintenance from 2:00 - 4:00 EST on June 29. If it is not completed on time, the opening time will be postponed accordingly.
 
During the maintenance period, you will not be able to access the game from the server. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. Thank you for your support and understanding!
 
Important Updates
 
1. The Final Advent Event - Evil's Arrival

Event duration: After the maintenance on June 29 - the end of the event (final ending: victory/defeat)

Defeat: Final Judgment progress reaches 100%.

Victory: Defeat Asura and Orochi before the Final Judgment progress reaches 100%.

※ The battle against Orochi is the last stage, which begins after Asura is defeated.

【Frontline Battle: Asura】

Asura, the Destroyer joined the fray to...

Asura's HP is the amount of Spiritual Entity Shards he has – 666,666. For each Spiritual Entity Shard defeated, 1 point will be deducted from his HP.

※ You can invite friends or match with other Onmyoji to form a team of 5 and battle with their own shikigami.

※ Blessings and Marks acquired along the journey can increase the your own ability and the team's.

※ After the whole team have completed their Individual Blessings and Team Marks, they will start challenging Asura's Spiritual Entity Shard.

※ Defeat as many Asura's Spiritual Entity Shards as possible in the given time to get great rewards.

【Final Judgment Progress】

※ The judgment progress begins at 20%. Onmyoji will be defeated when it reaches 100%.

※ The Fall of Ame-no-Habakiri, Naga Invasion on Heian-Kyo, and the Passage of Time are three factors that can increase progress.

1. Fall of Ame-no-Habakiri: There are a total of 5 Ame-no-Habakiri. After the Evil's Arrival stage begins, an Ame-no-Habakiri falls according to the story. The other Ame-no-Habakiri falls once every 48 hours starting from June 30 at 18:00 EST, destroying all Field Towers with insufficient Troops. Each Field Tower destroyed increases the judgment progress by 10%.

2. Naga Invasion: Each Naga invaded increases the judgment progress by 0.05%.

3. Passage of Time: The judgment progress increses by 0.25% for every 1 hour.

【Battlefield: Field Tower Fortification】

※ After the event starts, there will be a total of 12 Field Towers. You will need to submit Troops to fortify the towers.

※ Field Towers with insufficient troops will be destroyed by the Ame-no-Habakiri.

※ Troops can be earned from Frontline Battle and Ultra Demon Encounter, and daily free giveaways at 12:00 and 17:00 based on Rank level.

※ Field Towers can attack the Nagas invading Heian-Kyo during Ultra Demon Encounter.

※ Field Tower levels are Constructing/Lv. 2/Lv. 3/Lv.4. Constructing Field Towers cannot attack. From Lv. 2 onward, the higher the level of a Field Tower, the more powerful it is against the Nagas.

【Battlefield: Ultra Demon Encounter】

※ Each day, from 5:00 - 21:00, Nagas will attack Heian-Kyo from the north, east, and south. There will be a total of 26 waves of attacks.

※ Onmyoji can help the Field Towers fight against the Nagas. The zone supports auto battle with Sakuramochi. The daily challenge attempt limit is 100.

※ Each day from 6:00 - 8:00 and 19:00 - 21:00, there will be more invading Nagas.

※ The Assembly Bosses of each day's Demon Encounter will also appear in the zone. Defeat them for additional rewards. After the bosses are defeated a number of times, they will return to their normal form in Demon Encounter.

【Evil God: Orochi】

※ Orochi stands at the edge of the execution ground and looks down on the mortal world.

※ The power of the Evil God looms over the world. We will need to work out a way to fight him and save Heian-Kyo!

2. Slithering Shadow Event

Give Kagura Crane Bell to light up the lantern and she will give you Gilded Leaf in return as rewards. 

Gilded Leaf can be exchanged for rich rewards.

※ Event duration: After the maintenance on June 29 - 23:59 EST on July 12

※ The Crane Bell can be obtained by gaining 100 Talisman EXP via daily quests in Talisman Pass, challenging Demon Encounter bosses, and purchasing packs.

※ When all the lantern are lit up, you can claim additional Gilded Leaf. When you light up 24 lanterns for the first time, you can claim the event exclusive Slithering Shadow frame.

※ Gilded Leaf can be exchanged for rare rewards in Shadowy Tower. Rewards include the event exclusive animated Dark Slithering Shadow frame, Kagura's Graceful Serenity skin, Hiromasa's Myrtle Musician skin and the Feast Song frame.

※ For more event rules, please head to the event page.

3. Ibuki's Race Event

Ibuki is here again for the summer to organize a race for all players.

※ Event duration: After the maintenance on June 29 - 23:59 EST on July 5

※ Each game will have multiple players. Bring eligible Souls to the game and race with other players in Ibuki's Race.

※ Ibuki will upgrade the Souls submitted to the game, then give out ratings to rank them.

【Rift Realm】

※ Event duration: After the maintenance on June 29 - 23:59 EST on July 5

※ Spend Fish Cakes to challenge Rift Realm and receive rewards based on the damage dealt in each battle.

【Important Adjustments】

※ The eligible Souls for the event must have SPD, ATK Bonus, or Crit as their sub stats.

※ Added the Team mode where you can invite 1-3 eligible friends to the race. Team mode doesn't grant participation rewards and doesn't use reward attempts.

※ Added the Abandon Soul feature. You can abandon the Souls used in a race after the race is over.

※ Added the Nudge and Emojis features.

※ Ibuki's Race now grants 8 initial participation rewards. Each day 1 reward attempt is recovered at 0:00.

※ Improved how Souls are selected. You can now quickly filter through your Souls.

※ Improved the animation playback speed in the race.

4. New Skin - Twin Horrors

※ Futakuchi's new skin - Twin Horrors will be available in the Skin shop after the maintenance on June 29, with a 20% off discount in the first week! Don't miss it!

5. Paper Doll Skin Updated

※ New Paper Doll Skins are available after the maintenance on June 29 - 23:59 EST on July 26

※ Added Glorious Company, Forever Company, Thoughtful Memories and Golden Sanctuary Paper Doll skins which can be purchased in Paper Doll Shrine > Collection.

6. Memory Summons Updated

※ Summoning duration: After the maintenance on June 29 - 23:59 EST on July 12

※ Chance Up shikigami for this update including Inaba Kaguya, Guardian Ubume, Kinnara, Hakuzosu, Higanbana, Ootengu.

※ Chance Up shikigami for the next update will include Demoniac Shuten Doji, Jr. Ootengu, Suzuhikohime, Menreiki, Susabi, Enma.

※ The new Recollection Pack is now available! They can be purchased in Shop > Pack.

※ For more details, please check on the event page.

7. Royal Battle Arena overhaul!

※ Adjusted the zone available time to Fridays-Sundays at 7:00-10:00 and 19:00 - 22:00.

※ Changed the unlocking requirement for full Win Rewards from 12 wins to 9 wins.

※ Players no longer need to configure the stats and Souls of weekly shikigami. Arena will prepare pre-configured weekly shikigami for players.

※ Before each battle, both sides will pick shikigami 3 times. Chosen shikigami and the shikigami the opponent didn't choose can be deployed in the battle.

※ There will be a few Public Shikigami that can be deployed by both side in a battle.

※ In the battle stage, both side will each deploy 5 shikigami and 1 onmyoji.

8. The Skin shop now has a Wish List. You can add the skins you want to the Wish List.

9. FORTUNE! Discount and Free Refresh in Soul Shop

※ Event duration: 0:00 EST on June 29 - 23:59 EST on July 5

※ Every day during the event, the first 10 purchases in the soul shop will have a 20% discount and the lineup can be refreshed 30 times for free.

Improvement

1. Improvements for the R shikigami Ame Onna:

※ Improved [Sky Tears] skill effects: Dispels 1 buff from each of the enemies with a 50% base chance of inflicting Shackle of Tears lasting 2 turns on them. Dispels 4 debuffs or controlling effects from each ally.

2. Fellowship Assembly Improvements

※ Improved how units are deployed in zone challenges for Fellowship teams. The leader can choose to deploy an offline team member's onmyoji. After it's configured, the member will deploy an onmyoji instead of a shikigami, and the leader can deploy two shikigami.

※ If the leader chooses to deploy an offline member's onmyoji, the onmyoji EXP from the zone challenges will go to that member. The leader won't receive onmyoji EXP this way.

3. Improved the detail button of the monster skills when players under the Simplified Battle Page setting

4. N shikigami and materials can be configured to be the walking character in the Courtyard now.

5. Adjusted the shikigami bio unlocking requirements related to Duel Victories for all shikigami. Now victories in Underworld Arena and Draft Duel count towards the unlocking progress.

6. Added the Rotate feature and Realm Skin Preview feature to Realm Skins.

7. Improved the Memory Summons page display. Added more shikigami info and voice artist info. Now tapping a shikigami's avatar can view detailed info of the shikigami.

8. Improved the description text for the Onmyoji Cosmetics system.

9. Improved the Skin shop skin display order.

10. Improved the shikigami skin display logic for Draft Duel and Underworld Arena events. Now Special skins on shikigami will be prioritized.

11. Added more actions and voices for the SSR shikigami Hana.

12. Added the SP Fallen God Orochi in the Draft Duel.

13. Improved the display of Celestial Strider Frame

Fixed Issue

1. Fixed the issue where when playing the audio of character bios in the Shikigami menu, other voices were overlapping.

2. Fixed the missing flying birds effect on the model of the SSR shikigami Hana's before-evolution, after-evolution, and Dark Blue skins.

3. Fixed the issue where chat stickers were unable to be unequipped.

4. Fixed the adaptability issues of some iPad devices regarding some of the scenes.

5. Fixed the issue with Draft Duel where the Souls on allied shikigami were not displayed in battle status info.

6. Fixed the issue where when importing a Soul-sorting Profile and opening the Soul-sorting page, the profile orders were in disorder.

7. Fixed the issue with the SSR shikigami Suzuhikohime's Divine Ritualist skin being stuck when Suzuhikohime was configured as the character for the Wanted Quests display shikigami.

8. Fixed the display issue with the SP shikigami Void Menreiki's skin, the SSR shikigami Shiranui's Glamour Songbird skin, and the SSR shikigami Ungaikyo's Dream World skin.

notes.title: Updates on June 22nd
notes.content:
Update Announcement
 
Dear Onmyoji,
 
In order to bring you a better gaming experience, the server will be shut down for maintenance from 2:00 - 5:00 EST on June 22. If it is not completed on time, the opening time will be postponed. For details regarding the update, please check the update announcement which will be posted later, or the game login page after the maintenance.
 
During the maintenance period, you will not be able to access the game from the server. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. Thank you for your support and understanding!
 
Important Updates
 
1. Final Judgment in God's Name Summoning Event

※ Summon period: After the maintenance on June 22 - July 5 at 23:59 EST

【Summon Chance Up】

- During the event, when summoning using Mystery Amulets, Jade, or AR Amulets, the drop rate of SP/SSR Shikigami will be 2.5 times the normal rate. The summon rate will revert to the normal rate after you successfully summons 3 SP/SSR Shikigami.

【Moon Amulet】

- During the event, you can get a Moon Amulet at your 520th Mystery Summon.

- A Moon Amulet can be used to summon any one of the following SSR shikigami:

Asura, Taishakuten, Senhime, Kinnara, Suzuka Gozen, Enmusubi, Kidomaru, Ungaikyo, Takiyashahime, Otakemaru, Shiranui, Orochi, Hakuzosu, Onikiri, Menreiki, Miketsu, Tamamonomae, Yamakaze, Yuki, Higanbana, Susabi, Kaguya, Hana, Ichimokuren, Yoto Hime, Aoandon, Ibaraki Doji, Shishio, Enma, Lord Arakawa, Shuten Doji, and Ootengu.

- When the event ends,  unused Moon Amulet will be consumed and a random shikigami will be selected from the abovementioned Shikigami for you.

【Special Summon Bonus】

- For those who have completed their SSR collection before the maintenance on June 22:

During the event, if they performs 599 summons but did not obtain SP Fallen God Orochi, SP Fallen God Orochi will appear on the 600th summon and a surprise pack will be presented to them. 

- For others:

The drop rate of SP Fallen God Orochi will be further increased to 25% if they have not obtained SP Fallen God Orochi after 600th summons.

【Stage Rewards】

- Summon shikigami for a certain number of times to receive corresponding stage rewards, which contain a Skill Daruma, a handful of Mystery Amulets, Skin Tokens, Jade, SR shikigami of your choice among other rare items.

【Important Rules】

- This event is only available to Onmyoji above Lv. 5.

- All SSR Collected is defined as having all SSR shikigami lit up in your Collection (excluding Ryomen).

- All SSR Collected does not include the crossover shikigami.

- Players below Lv. 5 won't be able to enjoy the event bonuses. But their summoning attempts made during the event are still counted towards the Stage Rewards, allowing them to claim the rewards and enjoy the Chance Up bonus as soon as they reach Lv. 5 during the event.

2. The Final Advent Event

The Evil God has returned to bring down his judgment! Under the setting sun, Orochi will pass judgment on the mortals according to the rules of Takamagahara. Answer the call and stop him at all cost!

※ The Final Advent has two stages: Bitter Prelude and Evil's Arrival.

※ Bitter Prelude: After the maintenance on June 22 – before the maintenance on June 29

※ Evil's Arrival: After the maintenance on June 29 – the end of the event (Victory or Defeat ending)

※ Bitter Prelude rules are as follows:

【Exploration】

Ride the Oboroguruma and explore the battlefield to look for the keys and solve the crisis...

※ In Exploration, you will need to select a group of shikigami and deploy them in battle, experience various random activities while riding Oboroguruma.

※ Explore 5,000 miles to reach the end and claim victory. Keep checking your Vice during the journey. If its maxed out, the exploration fails!

※ The event's Exploration zone has no item cost or attempts limit. Complete the main journey to receive Lustful Keys which can be used to open Snake Chests.

※ During the Bitter Prelude stage, 30 free Snake Chests will be delivered daily. Open them to receive rewards.

※ The event's Exploration zone is only available during the Bitter Prelude stage.

【Patrol】

※ Spend Patrol Passes to patrol the battlefield and eliminate the naga lurking there.

※ Clearing a stage unlocks a stage of higher difficulty. Max Level 10. The higher the difficulty, the greater the rewards.

※ In Level 10 battles, clear it in limited turns to get extra rewards.

※ Patrol is only available during the Bitter Prelude stage.

【Ration Support】

※ Six major forces have scheduled to rally in a week. Submit the Ration can help them march and earn you support rewards.

※ The Marching Progress of the six major forces will begin at 0% and finish at 100%. Submit Rations to increase the Marching Progress of a force. All onmyoji share the same Marching Progress.

※ Rations can be obtained from the event's Exploration and Patrol zones.

※ Ration Support is only available during the Bitter Prelude stage.

【Ranks】

※ Battle together with the six major forces on the battlefield and earn Reputation.

※ Raise Rank levels by collecting enough Reputation.

※ The Rank system breaks down into 4 ranks and 10 levels, starting from Soldier I to the highest rank General.

※ Raising Rank levels increases battle power and grants rewards.

※ Reputation can be obtained from all battle zones and Ration Support.

※ The Rank system is available throughout the Final Advent event.

【Chapter Takamagahara】

※ It is the place where event stories are recorded.

※ You can also re-experience the story of Takamagahara Mysteries from here.

※ Chapter Takamagahara is available throughout the Final Advent event.

【Shadowy Shop】

※ Collect Mystic Scales from various zones to exchange rewards at the Shadowy Shop.

※ Rack up enough Mystic Scales and exchange them for the exclusive animated Serpent's Devouring frame, a Skill Daruma, and a Random SSR/SP Shikigami Summoning Scroll, among other rewards.

※ The SP shikigami Fallen-God Orochi's Dark Passenger Skin will be unlocked when the event is finished (price subject to Victory/Defeat ending).

※ Shadowy Shop is available until July 12 at 23:59
【Orochi's Invite】

※ Complete quests to receive Oboroguruma's Power. Collect Oboroguruma's Power to unlock rewards.

※ Purchase Orochi's Invite to unlock more rewards including Theme: Final Advent.

※ Orochi's Invite is available throughout the Final Advent event.

3. SP Fallen God Orochi Memory Scrolls Event

※ Event duration: After the maintenance on June 22 – July 12 at 23:59 EST

During the event, you can obtain scroll shards by participating in different in-game activities. For every scroll shard donated, you will receive 1 random reward. After the memory scroll has been repaired, you can view the corresponding story.

Rewards will be given out to players according to their donation ranking, including SP Fallen God Orochi shards, Final Judgment frame, Skill Daruma, and more.

For players who rank top 1000 or those whose repair contribution is above 2000, they will receive the Final Judgment Frame.

4. Onmyoji 4.5th Anniversary Celebration Summoning Bonus

※ Duration: After the maintenance on June 22 -  23:59 EST on June 28

※ During the event, Onmyoji above Lv.10 will have a free summon attempt each day.

※ It can be stacked with the 500-day summoning bonus.

5. Onmyoji 4.5th Anniversary Celebration Sign-in Bonus

※ Event duration: After the maintenance on June 22 - July 1 at  23:59 EST

※ During the event, you can claim daily rewards from the paper doll in the Courtyard, including exclusive illustration: Starry night, Heian-Kyo Traveler frame and Mystery Amulets.

※ Starry night and Heian-Kyo Traveler frame can only be claimed on June 22, don't miss out!

6. Onmyoji 4.5th Anniversary Celebration - All Skin 20% Off

※ Duration: After the maintenance on June 22 -  23:59 EST on June 29

※ All skins available for purchase in the Skin Shop can enjoy a 20% off discount.

※ Discounts do not apply to the Asura's Celestial Strider skin, Ame Onna's Lady in the Snow skin and the crossover event skins.

7. Special skin Celestial Strider

※ After the maintenance on June 22, Asura's Special edition skin Celestial Strider will be available in the Skin Store at the price of 220 S-Jade. You can purchase it for 160 S-Jade in the first week!

※ The skin features the following:

- New actions and skill effects
- Exclusive frame
- Exclusive voice and sound effects
- Exclusive Bio.

※ Note: The first week discount doesn't stack with any other kind of discount.

※ If you want to experience all the skill effect of Asura's Celestial Strider skin, please head to Seetings > Field Effect and click the Full screen option.

8. New Skin - Origami Swallow

※ Kamimai's new skin - Origami Swallow will be available in the Skin shop after the maintenance on June 22, with a 20% off discount in the first week! Don't miss it!

9. New skin available in the Shrine

The Fallen God Orochi's Dark Blue skin, Shiro Mujou's Pale skin and Kuro Mujou's Pale skin are available in the Shrine.

※ Duration: after the maintenance on June 22 - 23:59 EST on July 5

※ Price: 
- Fallen God Orochi's Dark Blue skin: SP Skin Tokens * 40
- Shiro Mujou's Pale skin: SP Skin Tokens * 10
- Kuro Mujou's Pale skin: SP Skin Tokens * 10

10. Ebisu's Boutique is available

※ Event duration: After the maintenance on June 22 -  23:59 EST on August 23

※ Event details:

- During the event, you can obtain Ebisu's Fortune Shop exclusive frame Dazzling Gold by recharging in the game. You will have a chance to upgrade the frame by obtaining this the frame again from the future Ebisu's Boutique events.

- Recharge to certain amounts to receive the Verdant Springtime Courtyard skin, Seimei's Dark Seimei skin, Skill Daruma, and more!

- For some itmes, if you receive more than one, they will be converted in to other items as follows:

Verdant Springtime Courtyard skin → 1000 Jade

Seimei's "Dark Seimei" skin → "Lord of Kyoto" frame

Seimei's "Dark Seimei" skin + "Lord of Kyoto" frame → "Lord of Kyoto" frame (Gold Daruma version)

- For Players who already have the "Lord of Kyoto" frame (Gold Daruma version), they will gain the right to enter the Boutique, and receive 2 Boutique talismans when they receive the "Dark Seimei" skin again.

- Players who have obtained the Lord of Kyoto frame twice are eligible to receive the exclusive My Page skin

11. Wish Bundle

※ Event duration: After the maintenance on June 22 - 23:59 EST on July 5

※ S-Jade can be used to purchase Silver and Gold Packs. Bronze Pack can be claimed by the player above Lv.15.

※ The number of Bronze, Silver, and Gold Packs players purchased will be calculated respectively. When they reach certain thresholds, players who purchased the packs can claim additional rewards.

※ Aquatic Butterfly Frame is included in Silver, and Gold Packs, surplus frames will be converted to 50 Jade.

12. Double Guild Medals from Demon Encounter

※ Event duration:  0:00 EST on June 22 - 23:59 EST on June 28

※ During the event, the Guild Medals obtained after challenging Demon Encounter will be doubled!

Fixed Issue

Fixed language and technical bugs.

notes.title: Updates on June 8
notes.content:
Update Announcement
 
Dear Onmyoji,
 
In order to bring you a better gaming experience, the server will be shut down for maintenance from 2:00 - 4:00 EST on June 8. If it is not completed on time, the opening time will be postponed. For details regarding the update, please check the update announcement which will be posted later, or the game login page after the maintenance.
 
During the maintenance period, you will not be able to access the game from the server. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. Thank you for your support and understanding!
 
Important Updates
 
1. Furry Bond Summoning Event

※ Event duration: After the maintenance on June 8 - 23:59 EST on June 14

※ Level requirment: Lv. 5

【Summon Chance Up】

※ During the event, when summoning using Mystery Amulets, Jade, or AR Amulets, the drop rate of SP/SSR Shikigami will be 2.5 times the normal rate. The summon rate will revert to the normal rate after you successfully summons 3 SP/SSR Shikigami.

【Furry Shop】

※ During the summoning event, you will receive 1 Furry Coin for every 5 summons made(using Mystery Amulet, Jade, or AR Amulet).

※ Furry Coins can be exchanged for the new pet Panda and accessories, returning pets Pom, Snowball, Flowerbond, returning frames and skins among other great rewards.

※ The pets and the accessories are only available to Onmyoji above Lv. 20.

※ The Furry Shop will be available until June 17 at 23:59.

Note:
Onmyoji below Lv. 5 won't be able to enjoy the SP/SSR Chance Up bonus and other bonuses during the event when you perform summons. But the summoning attempts you made during the event are still counted towards the amount required to receive Furry Coins, allowing you to claim the Furry Coins as soon as they reach Lv. 5 during the event.

※ For more details, please check on the event page.

2. Takamagahara Mysteries Event

Outside the capital, the snake shadows are on the move. Find out the truth behind these strange anomalies and get ready for battle.

※ Level requirement: Lv.15

※ Event duration: June 12 at 0:00 EST – June 21 at 23:59 EST

※ Collect Memory Ambers from Talisman Pass and submit them to unlock Takamagahara Mysteries Chapters, the unlock progress are shared among the whole server.

※Rewards will be issued after you experience a chapter.

※ After all chapters are unlocked, you won’t receive any Memory Ambers from Talisman Pass in the following days.

3. Good luck doesn't wait! - Selectable Soul Drop Event

Not enough souls to get your Shikigami fully equipped? No worries, the Soul drop event is coming this weekend!

※ Event Duration: 0:00 EST on June 11 - 23:59 EST on June 12

- During this event, you can choose the type of souls that drop in the Soul Zone.

- You can choose 4 types of souls. The same soul cannot be chosen more than once in any lineup. After you have selected a lineup, you can edit it at any time for free.

- Your selected lineup will be in effect for the first 200 challenges each day. After this, the soul lineup will return to normal.

4. Paper Doll Skin Updated

※ Added Panda Paper Doll skins which can be purchased in Paper Doll Shrine > Collection.

※ Purchase Period: After the maintenance on June 8 - 23:59 EST on June 28

Fixed Issue

Fixed language and technical bugs.

notes.title: Updates on June 1st
notes.content:
Update Announcement
 
Dear Onmyoji,
 
In order to bring you a better gaming experience, the server will be shut down for maintenance from 2:00 - 4:00 EST on June 1. If it is not completed on time, the opening time will be postponed accordingly.
 
During the maintenance period, you will not be able to access the game from the server. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. Thank you for your support and understanding!
 
Important Updates
 
1. Coin Chaos Event

※ Event Duration: After the maintenance on June 1 - 23:59 EST on June 14

※ Event details:
- Collect Tesso's Coins to unlock stage rewards.
- Spending the required amount of Coins to receive Tesso's Gifts.

※ How to obtain Tesso's Coins:
– Clearing Soul zones, Exploration zones, and Evo zones.
– Completing daily quests in Coin Chaos.

Note: When the event ends, excess Tesso's Coins will be converted into Coins.

2. Talisman Pass (June)

※ Event duration: After the maintenance on June 1 –  before the maintenance on July 6

※ You can complete different missions to increase the Talisman level.

※ As the Talisman level increases, Onmyoji can obtain various rewards including the exclusive frame.

※ Purchase the Deluxe Talisman to unlock bonus rewards such as the exclusive animated frame, an exclusive illustration and Suzuhikohime's Divine Ritualist skin!

※ Updated Legacy Talisman and related shop:

- You can purchase Legacy Talisman from the Talisman Pass - Shop page. Upon purchase, each Talisman Pass level you reached grants you a Talisman Coin. Each Talisman Pass grants up to 50 Talisman Coins.

- Talisman Coins can be used to purchase month-related skins from previous Talisman Passes. Spend Talisman Coins to purchase the Yoto Hime's return skin - Ceremonial Blade and Kuro Mujou's return skin - Will of Battle for the current Talisman Pass.

3. New Feature - Shikigami Profile system

※ The Profile system contains the Info, Audio, Animation, and Scroll contents of shikigami. Tap Profile in the Shikigami menu to see the profile of the shikigami.

【Info and Audio】

※ Info contains the personal information of the shikigami. Audio contains the spoken lines and their translations of the shikigami. 

※ The first batch of Info and Audio includes including Kidomaru, Enmusubi. Suzuka Gozen, Kinnara, Senhime, Taishakuten, Asura, Shokurei, Mishige, Yato no Kami, Suzuhikohime, and Fukengaku.

※ The Info and Audio of other shikigami is being revised and will be released in future updates. Please stay tuned!

※ There is no Info contents on crossover-exclusive shikigami.

【Animation and Scrolls】

※ Animation contains the Animation Scroll videos and Animated Scroll videos of the shikigami. Scroll contains the Memory Scroll text and illustrations of the shikigami. 

※ The Scroll portal originally under the Bios sub-page in the Shikigami menu have been integrated to the Animation and Scroll pages in the Profile system.

4. Paper Doll Skin Updated

※ New Paper Doll Skins are available after the maintenance on June 1 - 23:59 EST on June 28

※ Added Enmusubi and Pale Fragrance Paper Doll skins which can be purchased in Paper Doll Shrine > Collection.

※ Improved the display of new skin notice for paper doll.

5. Memory Summons Updated

※ Summoning duration: After the maintenance on June 1 - 23:59 EST on June 14

※ Chance Up shikigami for this update including Lovebound Kiyohime, Divine Miketsu, Shokurei, Otakemaru, Miketsu, Ibaraki Doji.

※ Chance Up shikigami for the next update will include Worldly Aoandon, Inferno Ibaraki Doji, Mishige, Enmusubi, Yuki, Shishio.

※ The new Recollection Pack is now avaliable! They can be purchased in Shop > Pack.

※ For more details, please check on the event page.

6. Realm Raid: Froglet Invasion Event

※ Event duration: 0:00 EST on June 1 -  23:59 EST on June 5

※ During the event, after you refresh the Realm Raid, froglets will appear to take the place of a few random  realms. In these particular realms, the shikigami and the onmyoji will be replaced by froglets. You can challenge up to 3 froglet realms daily.

※ During the event, each day after you finish raiding froglet realms for 3 times and refreshing the page, Oboroguruma will appear to take the place of a realm, where the shikigami will be replaced by froglets and the onmyoji will be replaced by Oboroguruma. In the Oboroguruma realm, your own froglets will receive stats bonus. You can challenge up to 1 Oboroguruma realm daily.

※ Challenging froglet realms grants Medals and Froglet Medals as rewards, with a chance to grant Oboroguruma Realm Cards. If you deploy all froglets in   battle, you will receive extra rewards on victory. The Medal drop from this event is not affected by Medal Drop Bonus.

※ During the event, items that are exchangeable with Froglet Medals will be available in Shop > General > Medal. These items include: upgradable   animated Froglet Invasion frame and grade 5 Oboroguruma Realm Card among others. The event items will be removed from Shop after the event. The Froglet Medals you earn in the event will be kept for you to exchange for the items available in future Realm Raid: Froglet Invasion events.

※ The first time you claim the highest level progress chest from Realm Raid each day, you will receive an extra random froglet shard.

※ The froglet realm, Oboroguruma realm respawning attempt and froglet shard claiming attempt can not be accumulated and will refresh at 0:00 EST each day.

notes.title: Updates on May 25
notes.content:
Update Announcement
 
Dear Onmyoji,
 
In order to bring you a better gaming experience, the server will be shut down for maintenance from 2:00 - 4:00 EST on May 25. If it is not completed on time, the opening time will be postponed. For details regarding the update, please check the update announcement which will be posted later, or the game login page after the maintenance.
 
During the maintenance period, you will not be able to access the game from the server. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. Thank you for your support and understanding!
 
Important Updates
 
1. Glitter Convergence Summoning Event

※ Event duration: After the maintenance on May 25 - 23:59 EST on May 31

※ Level requirment: Lv. 5

【Summon Chance Up】

※ During the event, when summoning using Mystery Amulets, Jade, or AR Amulets, the drop rate of SP/SSR Shikigami will be 2.5 times the normal rate. The summon rate will revert to the normal rate after you successfully summons 3 SP/SSR Shikigami.

※ The SR shikigami Uminocho will be added into the summon pool and Demon Parade after the maintenance on May 25.

【Wish Shop】

※ During the summoning event, you will receive 1 Wish Coin for every 10 summons made(using Mystery Amulet, Jade, or AR Amulet).

※ Wish Coins can be exchanged for the new SR shikigami Uminocho, Skill Daruma, Guardian Ubume's Bamboo skin, Kamimai's Noble Violet skin, Kainin's Royalty skin, and limited-time return illustrations among other great rewards.

※ The Wish Shop will be available until June 7 at 23:59.

2. Courtyard Cleanup Event

※ Level requirement: Lv.15

※ Event duration: After the maintenance on May 25 -  23:59 EST on June 5

※ During the event, complete daily quests of Talisman Pass for a chance to obtain the following cleaning items: Broomstick, Dustpan, Cleaning Cloth, Bucket, and Paper Hat.

※ The daily demand of each type of the cleaning items are randomized daily. Submit the required amount of the cleaning items to claim rewards and Cleaning Points.

※ The Courtyard Cleanup illustration and Ittan-momen's Ceiba Unbound skin among other rewards can be unlocked when the Cleaning Points reach different milestones!

※ Cleaning items are removed daily. Remember to submit them in time!

3. Phantom Duel Event

※ Event duration: After the maintenance on May 25 -  23:59 EST on June 7

【Event Access】

Onmyoji above Lv.15 can head to the event via the Jizo Statue, the Paper Doll in the Courtyard, or the Arena.

【Building the Lineup】

※ Use Phantom Amulets to summon the event-exclusive shikigami and Souls from the Phantom Summon pool, and use them to build a lineup.

※ The shikigami in the Phantom Summon only include all the shikigami released before the SSR shikigami Tamamonomae, the SSR shikigami Yuki and the SR shikigami Dodomeki.

※ Every Onmyoji will receive 100 free Phantom Amulets upon entering the Phantom Summons page.

※ When the event is finished, unused Phantom Amulets and the event-exclusive shikigami and Souls will be removed.

【Matching and Score】

※ Matching time: at 2:00 EST - 23:00 EST daily

※ Matching will be available when you have at least 5 shikigami. Victory grants points and defeat deducts points.

※ Onmyoji with score below 2,400 have unlimited battle attempts. After reaching 2,400 points, matching won't be available after 10 daily defeats. 

※ When the event is finished, you will receive rewards based on the rankings via in-game mail.

【Battlefield Rules】

※ During the event, each week there will be a unique house rule, applied to all the shikigami and onmyoji in battles.

※ When the rules are changed, another 30 free Phantom Amulets will be issued upon entering the Phantom Summons page.

【Phantom Gift】

※ Complete daily quests of Phantom Gift to receive a random Grade 6 Soul, Phantom Amulets, and Phantom Pamphlets among other rewards. Rack up Phantom Pamphlets to unlock Phantom Pass rewards.

※ You can Purchase Fighter Pass and Premium Chest to additionally unlock more rewards, including Skill Daruma shards and a handful of Phantom Amulets among other rewards.

※ When the event is finished, unclaimed rewards (excluding event-exclusive items) will be reissued via in-game mail.

- The stocks will be refreshed daily at 0:00 EST.
