notes.title: Updates on May 18
notes.content:
Update Announcement
 
Dear Onmyoji,
 
In order to bring you a better gaming experience, the server will be shut down for maintenance from 2:00 - 4:00 EST on May 18. If it is not completed on time, the opening time will be postponed accordingly.
 
During the maintenance period, you will not be able to access the game from the server. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. Thank you for your support and understanding!
 
Important Updates
 
1. The Lotus Voyage Sign-In Event

The spring cherry blossoms are blooming. The King of the Celestials has come to the Courtyard for a reunion. Go on a fieldtrip with friends on a sunny day, and enjoy the flowers of the season.

※ Event duration: After the maintenance on May 18 - 23:59 EST on May 25

※ Level requirement: Lv. 15

※ During the event, complete daily quests to increase your event progress. The event-exclusive Immaculate Dream frame can be obtained in 6 days! 

2. The Board Brawl Event

※ Control characters to clear challenges and get Lotus to exchange rewards!

※ Level requirement: Lv. 15

※ Event duration: After the maintenance on  May 18 - 23:59 EST on May 24

※ Shop available: After the maintenance on  May 18 - 23:59 EST on May 31

※ Each day at 0:00 EST, a new stage will be unlocked. Spend Celestial Fans to challenge the stages.

※ Clear the stage and get Lotuses, which can be used to exchange rewards in the event shop.

※ Spend Skill Points to raise the skill level of the characters. Skill Points can be obtained by completing character quests. Skill level progress will be carried over to the next event.

※ Inferno Ibaraki Doji is released in this event and can be purchased from the event shop. Purchased characters will be carried over to the next event.

3. The Mirage Matchup Event

Enter the illusory realm for a game in the mirage!

※ Event duration: After the maintenance on May 18 - 23:59 EST on May 20

※ Event shop available: May 18 - 23:59 EST on May 31

※ The event is available to Onmyoji who reached lv.15 and owned at least 50 different shikigami of R or higher rarity in their Collection.

※ During the event, take part in the Mirage Matchup zone via the Jizo Statue in the Courtyard. Event is available from 10:00 - 12:00 and from 18:00 - 20:00 daily. It costs 400K M-Jade for each game.

Event rewards:

- The first 10 Mirage Matchup games grant rewards, regardless of the results. There's a chance of obtaining high grade Realm Cards and Mystery Amulets among other rewards.

- M-Jade gain/loss and Mirage Matchup Score will be calculated for each game. M-Jade can be purchased with Coins. It can also be converted into Coins at the cost of Spiritual Scrolls. 

- Onmyoji will be ranked based on the scores. Rewards will be issued to Onmyoji via in-game mail based on their Tier after the event has finished. 

- The Event-exclusive Frame: Mirage Matchup Frame will be issued to those who reach Tier 6, the frame expires in 1 week.

4. New Feature - Brawlroom

※ Brawlroom is an expansion zone where Onmyoji can create custom rooms for duels. Onmyoji who reach Lv. 12 can access the feature via the Duel page or the Team Creation feature.

※ You can create rooms with different rules, from normal rules such as normal duel and ban & pick duel, to entertainment rules, including Unlimited Orbs, Null Souls Stats, and Banned SSR/SP Shikigami among others.

※ You can take part in the duels or watch others as spectator.

5. Special skin Iridescent Dolls

※ After the maintenance on May 18, Hiyoribou's Special edition skin Iridescent Dolls will be available in the Skin Store at the price of 168 S-Jade. You can purchase it for 108 S-Jade in the first week!

※ The skin features the following:
- New actions and skill effects
- Exclusive frame
- Exclusive voice and sound effects
- Exclusive Bio.

※ Note: The first week discount doesn't stack with any other kind of discount.

6. Memory Summons Updated

※ Summoning duration: After the maintenance on May 18 - 23:59 EST on May 31

※ Chance Up shikigami for this update including Virtuoso Hana, Azurestorm Ichimokuren, Asura, Orochi, Takiyashahime, Aoandon.

※ Chance Up shikigami for the next update will include Lovebound Kiyohime, Divine Miketsu, Shokurei, Otakemaru, Miketsu, Ibaraki Doji.

※ The new Recollection Pack is now avaliable! They can be purchased in Shop > Pack.

※ For more details, please check on the event page.

7. Double Guild Medals from Demon Encounter

※ Event duration:  0:00 EST on May 18 - 23:59 EST on May 24

※ During the event, the Guild Medals obtained after challenging Demon Encounter will be doubled!

Improvement

1. Chat System Improvements

※ Opening the Chat page now shows the channel when the page was closed last time by default.

※ Upon receiving a tagged message, a red "@" will be displayed on the channel tab.

※ After tapping a message to bring up the copy feature, it can be canceled by tapping blank space.

※ Improved chat notifications for new players. Now it shows that Chat feature can be unlocked at Lv. 5.

2. Shikigami Menu Camera System Improvements

※ Improved how scenes are rendered after more shikigami have been added.

※ Fixed an issue where when a shikigami's skin is changed quickly, the action list was not updated in time.

3. Added Ban mode for Friend Sparring. Now players can choose the mode they wish to apply for the sparring practice between their friends.

4. Improved the display of SP shikigami Inaba Kaguya's Osmanthus Fairy skin.

5. Improved the idle animation of the SSR shikigami Susabi's Hanafuda Horizon skin. He now floats in the air instead of standing on the ground.

6. Improved the Auto Rotation switch setting in Exploration zones. Now the setting will remain unchanged even when players log off.

7. Implemented a balance change to some of the shikigami in Underworld Arena.

8. Added a threshold to Soul storage limit. When the number of grade 6 Souls the player has reached 2,000, they will increase their Soul storage limit to 6,500 (this doesn't change to the Soul storage limit increase for other amounts.)

9. Improved the enemy turn count display of the SP shikigami Ninja Yamausagi's Ninja Formation! skill. Now the turn count will be displayed at the top of the status bar.

10. Improved the Shikigami Summoning quest in Mentor's Guidance. Now summoning shikigami via Recollection Amulets can also complete the quest.

11. Improved the concept art of the SSR shikigami Mishige after her evolution.

12. Improved the page layout of the Merchant. Now the player's viewing position on each page is recorded separately.

13. Improved the Challenge Failed page in Area Boss, Evolution, and Secret zones, adding the Challenge Again option to the Sougenbi, Fallen Sun, Sea of Eternity, Area Boss, Evolution and Secret zones.

14. Guild Wish Improvement. The daily red dot notification has been removed for players who have entered the Guild > Wish page on the day.

15. Daruma Arena Improvements

※ Added the Skills buttom for the Trial Daruma to set the skills.

※ Trial Daruma's arsenal of skills includes Damage Boosters, Damage Buffers, and Specials. They can be configured freely based on the player's wishes.

16. Added the Search Shikigami feature to the Shikigami menu. Now players can search for the shikigami they're looking for on the Shikigami menu by tapping the Search button.

17. Added a summoning animation for the SSR shikigami Ryomen.

18. Improved the hair on the SSR shikigami Ootengu's special Astro Storm skin.

Fixed Issue

2. Fixed the issue where the daily auto wish-making feature was unable to complete the bio quests regarding making wishes. The quests can be completed by making wishes manually.

notes.title: Updates on May 11
notes.content:
[h1]Update Announcement[/h1]
 
Dear Onmyoji,
 
In order to bring you a better gaming experience, the server will be shut down for maintenance from 2:00 - 4:00 EST on May 11. If it is not completed on time, the opening time will be postponed. For details regarding the update, please check the update announcement which will be posted later, or the game login page after the maintenance.
 
During the maintenance period, you will not be able to access the game from the server. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. Thank you for your support and understanding!
 
[h1]Important Updates[/h1]
 
[h2]1. Yato no Kami Summnoning & Self-selected SP/SSR Chance Up[/h2]

※ The rules and summoning progress of the two events are independent of each other. You can freely switch between the two events at any time.

※ Event duration: After the maintenance on May 11 - 23:59 EST on May 22

[h2]Summoning Event 1:  Redmoon Revisit Summoning Event[/h2]

[h3]【Yato no Kami arrives】[/h3]

※ During the event, when summoning via a Mystery Amulet, Jade, or AR Amulet, there's a 1% chance of receiving a Crimson Edge. If Crimson Edge is not obtained in 39 consecutive summons, the next summon is guaranteed to grant one.

※ You can use 5 Crimson Edges to summon 1 Yato no Kami. After acquiring Yato no Kami, each Crimson Edge can be used to raise the skill level of Yato no Kami by 1.

[h3]【Summon Chance Up】[/h3]

※ During the event, when summoning using Mystery Amulets, Jade, or AR Amulets, the drop rate of SP/SSR Shikigami will be 2.5 times the normal rate. The summon rate will revert to the normal rate after you have summoned 3 SP/SSR Shikigami.

[h3]【Stage Rewards】[/h3]

※ Summon shikigami for a certain number of times to receive corresponding stage rewards, which contain a Skill Daruma, a handful of Mystery Amulets, Skin Tokens, Jade, SR shikigami of your choice among other rare items.

[h3]【Special Rewards】[/h3]

※ In Redmoon Revisit summoning event, you will obtain the event-exclusive Shiranui's Glamour Songbird skin at your 100th summon.

[h3]【Important Rules】[/h3]

- Shiranui's Glamour Songbird skin is the exclusive benefit of the Redmoon Revisit Summoning Event. Summoning attempts made from the Fateful Grthering Summoning Event won't be counted towards the summon progress of this skin.

- This is the last phase of the crossover event. When the event ends, each remaining Crimson Edge will be converted into 10 SSR Yato no Kami shards.

- For those who complete the All SSR Collected achievement before the maintenance on May 11, they will receive 1 free Crimson Edge when the summoning event begins (via in-game mail).

- All SSR Collected is defined as having all SSR shikigami lit up in your Collection (excluding Ryomen).

- All SSR Collected does not include the crossover event-exclusive shikigami.

- Onmyoji below Lv. 5 won't be able to enjoy the event bonuses. But their summoning attempts made during the event are still counted towards the Stage Rewards, allowing them to claim the rewards and enjoy the Chance Up bonus as soon as they reach Lv. 5 during the event.

[h2]Summoning Event 2: Fateful Gathering Summoning Event[/h2]

[h3]【Selected SP/SSR Shikigami Chance Up】[/h3]

※ Select 1 SP/SSR shikigami as the Main shikigami and 6 other SP/SSR shikigami as the Sub shikigami. When an SP/SSR shikigami is summoned, there's a total of 45% chance of it being one of the selected shikigami (15% for main shikigami and 5% for each sub shikigami) You can enjoy the Chance Up bonus once for the Main shikigami, and twice for Sub shikigami.

※ If you still have a Chance Up bonus after making 500 summons via Mystery Amulet, Jade, or AR Amulet, the remaining probability will be doubled, meaning it will be 30% chance up for the Main shikigami and 10% for each of the Sub shikigami.

[h3]【SP/SSR Guaranteed】[/h3]

※ SP/SSR Shikigami is guranteed within 60 summons, the counting resets when an SP/SSR is summoned. The SP/SSR shikigami summoned via this bonus will also enjoy the Selected SP/SSR Chance Up bonus.

※ The bonus will always trigger until the Chance Up bonuses for the selected shikigami are used up.

[h3]【Stage Rewards】[/h3]

※ During the event, you can perform summon for a number of times to receive stage rewards which includes: New SR Garuda, Mystery Amulets, Skill Daruma, Skin Tokens among other rare items.

[h3]【Important Rules】[/h3]

- This event is only available to Onmyoji above Lv. 5. For Onmyoji below Lv.5, their summon attempts made will be counted towards the Redmoon Revisit Event.

- During the event, you need to select your Main shikigami and your Sub shikigami before summoning.

- Once you've made your choices, you cannot change them.

- SSR Ryomen and crossover event-exclusive shikigami can not be chosen as Main shikigami and Sub shikigami. SSR Suzuhikohime and SSR Fukengaku can not be chosen as Main shikigami.

[h2]2. Underworld Rivulet Event[/h2]

By the dark stream of the Underworld River, the nightmare starts haunting again.

※ Event duration: After the maintenance on May 11 - 23:59 EST on May 20

[h3]【Earthly Dream】[/h3]

The volatile dreamland reappeared.

※ Follow a path while exploring the area and take steps to move forward. There will be battles, quizzes, and mysterious treasures along the road, among other things. Complete them for rewards.

[h3]【Withered Dream】[/h3]

The dreamland where red spider lilies no longer bloom is an extremely dangerous place, filled with surprising happenings.

※ Follow a path while exploring the area and take steps to move forward. There will be battles and mysterious treasures along the road. Complete them for rewards.

※ Random bonuses are granted along the path. Advance and choose the bonus you want and prove yourself in the Withered Dream!

[h3]【Underworld Pass】[/h3]

※ Complete quests to receive Netherworld Butterflies. Collect Netherworld Butterflies to unlock rewards in Underworld Pass.

※ Purchase the Awakened Pass to unlock Seimei's crossover-exclusive Demon Scrolls skin, Seimei's Nocturnal Fan: Star skill-casting effect, the animated Flower Buddies, and Skill Daruma shards.

※ The Underworld Pass will be available until 23:59 EST on May 24, after which unclaimed rewards will be reissued via in-game mail.
【Flower Dream】
Odokuro is collecting burning candles. Those who own them can exchange them for rewards.

※ Available: After the maintenance on May 11 - 23:59 EST on May 24

※ Obtain great rewards as well as the event-exclusive currencies Flower Candles and Odokuro's Letters in various zones and quests.

※ Collect Flower Candles and exchange them for SSR Yato no Kami's Final Act skin, the event-exclusive Nightveiled Range frame, Skill Daruma, and SSR/SP Summoning Scroll among other rewards.

※ Odokuro's Letters can be exchanged for Blades of Loyalty, for a better battle experience in the Earthly Dream zone.

[h2]3. FORTUNE! Discount and Free Refresh in Soul Shop[/h2]

※ Event duration: 0:00 EST on May 11 - 23:59 EST on May 17

※ Every day during the event, the first 10 purchases in the soul shop will have a 20% discount and the lineup can be refreshed 30 times for free.

[h2]Fixed Issue[/h2]

Fixed language and technical bugs.

tags.bug: Fixed language and technical bugs.

notes.title: Updates On May 6
notes.content:
Update Announcement
 
Dear Onmyoji,
 
In order to bring you a better gaming experience, the server will be shut down for maintenance from 2:00 - 4:00 EST on May 6. If it is not completed on time, the opening time will be postponed accordingly.
 
During the maintenance period, you will not be able to access the game from the server. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. Thank you for your support and understanding!
 
Important Updates
 
1. Battle Puzzles Limited Event

※ Event duration: After the maintenance on May 6 - 23:59 EST on May 12
※ Level requirement: Lv. 15
※ New shikigami with new challenges!

During the event, a puzzle with three difficulty levels will be unlocked for challenge each day. You will enter the battles with pre-configured shikigami and Soul sets. Use the skills wisely to solve the puzzle for rewards!

2. Underworld Arena Event

※ Event duration: 2:00 EST - 23:00 EST daily from May 9 - May 22
※ Level requirement: Lv. 15

During the event, you can access the Underworld Arena via the Jizo Statue in the Courtyard. Within the duration, battles in Underworld Arena from 11:00 to 14:00 and from 20:00 to 23:00 daily will be in 100-Player mode. The rest of the time will be in 16-Player mode.

Note: 

- The first 10 Underworld Arena challenges each week grant high-grade Realm Cards and Mystery Amulets among other rich rewards. From the 11th challenge onward, the arena only grants Coins as rewards. 

- Challenge attempts are shared between 100-Player mode and 16-Player mode.
- The 100-Player mode in Underworld Arena yields Underworld Arena Score in addition to the basic rewards. 

- Underworld Arena Scores are calculated each Monday. Rewards will be issued via in-game mail based on your tiers in Underworld Arena.

- The current highest tier of Underworld Arena is Tier 6. Underworld Arena Score and Duel Score share the same Score Rewards, which means the rewards will be issued based on the highest score reached in either zone. When you reach Tier 6 in Underworld Arena, you can receive the Underworld Arena frame which expires in a week.

- For more details, please check on the event page.

3. Talisman Pass (May)

※ Event duration: After the maintenance on May 6 –  before the maintenance on June 1

※ You can complete different missions to increase the Talisman level.

※ As the Talisman level increases, Onmyoji can obtain various rewards including the exclusive frame.

※ Purchase the Deluxe Talisman to unlock bonus rewards such as the exclusive animated frame, an exclusive illustration and Inaba Kaguya's Osmanthus Fairy skin!

※ Updated Legacy Talisman and related shop:

- You can purchase Legacy Talisman from the Talisman Pass - Shop page. Upon purchase, each Talisman Pass level you reached grants you a Talisman Coin. Each Talisman Pass grants up to 50 Talisman Coins.

- Talisman Coins can be used to purchase month-related skins from previous Talisman Passes. Spend Talisman Coins to purchase the Kinnara's return skin - Melodic Descant and Jr. Ootengu 's return skin - Angelic Feathers for the current Talisman Pass.

4. Paper Doll Skin Updated

※ New Paper Doll Skins are available after the maintenance on May 6 - 23:59 EST on May 31

※ Added Ninja Yamausagi, Inugami and Noble Violet Paper Doll skins which can be purchased in Paper Doll Shrine > Collection.

※ Improved the display of new skin notice for paper doll.

5. Memory Summons Updated

※ Summoning duration: After the maintenance on May 6 - 23:59 EST on May 17

※ Chance Up shikigami for this update including Void Menreiki, Crimson Yoto, Suzuka Gozen, Kidomaru, Shiranui, Onikiri.

※ Chance Up shikigami for the next update will include Virtuoso Hana, Azurestorm Ichimokuren, Asura, Orochi, Takiyashahime, Aoandon.

※ The new Recollection Pack is now avaliable, welcom to purchase in Shop > Pack.

※ For more details, please check on the event page.

6. Merchant Updated

※ The skins and frames available in the mystery bags will be refreshed after the maintenance on May 6.

※ Updates for Mystery Outfit Bag: Purchase to receive one of the following: Jade, AP, SP Skin Tokens, Koroka's Goldfish Kite skin, and Kujira's Deep-Sea Lava skin.

※ Udates for Mystery Crown Bag: Purchase to receive one of the following: AP, Coins, Skin Tokens, animated Sweet Seaside Dream frame, animated Drowned Sea frame, static Roaming Traveler frame.

※ Please note that the next update will be after the maintenance on June 15

※ For more details, please check on the Mystery Bag page.

7. New Scroll for shikigami

※ Added the Animation Scroll and the Animated Scroll to the SSR shikigami Taishakuten, Shokurei, Mishige, Yato no Kami, and Suzuhikohime, and the SP shikigami Void Menreiki, Virtuoso Hana, Inaba Kaguya, Ninja Yamausagi. Please check in Shikigami > Details > Bio > Scroll.

8. Selectable Soul Drop Event - New Souls Available!

※ Event Duration: 0:00 EST on May 4 - 23:59 EST on May 10

- During this event, you can choose the type of souls that drop in the Soul Zone.

- You can choose 4 types of souls. The same soul cannot be chosen more than once in any lineup. After you have selected a lineup, you can edit it at any time for free.

- Your selected lineup will be in effect for the first 200 challenges each day. After this, the soul lineup will return to normal.

※ Added 10 new souls for selection: Hyosube, Conch Blower, Nuribotoke, Leviathan, Oracle, Wispzoa, Aonyobo, Enshyoujo, Wisp, Merrow.

9. Fortune Bonus Event

※ Event Duration: 0:00 EST on May 4 - 23:59 EST May 10

※ During the event, players have a chance of obtaining Evo Drops, Soul Drops, EXP and Coin bonuses after battling in Exploration Zone, Soul Zone or Evo Zone.

※ The bonus duration for a bonus will be extended if the player has already obtained the same bonus.

Improvement

1. Improvements  for Battle Replay feature:

※ Added a feature in Replay to view the Soul details of the lineup under each replay entry (only available to replays posted after the maintenance on May 6; earlier replays will be reset and cleared.)

※ Added the Smart Filter list. The list will show the best suited battle strategies based on the player's Collection status.

※ Likes given to players via Replay are counted towards the Popularity of the players who posted the replays (each player can send up to one Like to up to one player daily, regardless of how many replays they have.)

2. Moved the description of the SSR shikigami Shokurei's [Feast] effect to the Dream Cuisine skill (this doesn't change the skill's effects.)

3. Lowered the level requirement for some of the Talisman Pass features from Lv. 15 to Lv. 1.

4. Lowered the level requirement for the Quick Promotion and the Gorging Ghoul features from Lv. 40 to Lv. 30.

5. Improved the Batch Upgrade logic. If there's only one eligible shikigami to be upgraded, the amount setting button won't be displayed.

6. Improved how Soul Profiles are edited. Now, after the Souls in a profile are edited, it will no longer scroll back to the top on the profile's list.

7. Improved how pets can be fed quickly in the Courtyard. Now, by tapping the pet in the Courtyard, all pets can be fed quickly.

8. Improved how some of the shikigami sit in the Quick Promotion page.

9. Improved the display effect of Guild Nameplate.

10. Improved the chat message display position on the Auto Rotation page in Exploration zones.

11. Improved the event portal and guides for the returning players' Lantern Relit event.

12. Improvements for Guild Wish:

※ When making a wish, players can now input the number of shards they want. Wishes are made automatically when players log in to the game every day until they receive all the shards they have wished for.

※ When a wish is changed, the new wish won't be made until the next day.

※ If a certain day's wish is not fully fulfilled, it will be carried over to the next day; then, when it's fully fulfilled, a new wish will be made automatically using the second day's attempt.

※ While auto wish-making is enabled, when a wish is changed, a new wish will be made immediately if the wish-making attempt for that day has not been used; a new wish will be made on the second day if the wish-making attempt of that day has already been used.

13. Adjustments for Draft Duel:

※ Added the SSR shikigami Fukengaku, the SR shikigami Garuda, and the R shikigami Kagewani to the Draft Duel for players to use.

※ The stats of some shikigami and the Soul set randomization rules have been changed.

14. Improvement on Camera Feature: Added new actions to some shikigami.

15. Improved the shikigami sorting on the shikigami list in Guild Feast.

16. Added the Duel Reserve Lineup usage rules to Duel.

17. Added a button to the top right corner of the Summon Room that allows players to quickly change their Summon Room skins.

18. Improved how players view the descriptions of shikigami skills.

Fixed Issue

1. Fixed the issue where the SSR shikigami Yato no Kami's [Sigil of the Night] was incorrectly triggering the Tree Nymph Soul's effect when its damage was triggered.

2. Fixed the issue where the SSR shikigami Onikiri's [Demonic Blade: Rajomon]'s additional strike damage inflicted was incorrectly triggering the Tree Nymph Soul's effect.

3. Fixed the issue with the SR shikigami Futakuchi where she was incorrectly displayed in Demon Parade.

4. Fixed a display issue on the SP shikigami Inferno Ibaraki Doji's hairs.

5. Fixed the adaptability issues of some devices when viewing Realm Raid replays.

6. Fixed the issue where the SSR shikigami Asura was unable to trigger the Aonyobo Soul's effect in some scenarios.

7. Fixed the issue where the SSR shikigami Enmusubi's avatar was too small when she's equipped with her Verdant Pinwheel skin.

8. Fixed the incorrect skill description of the SP shikigami Inaba Kaguya's [Reflected Devastation] skill when it's displayed in battles (this doesn't change the skill's effects)..

9. Fixed the display issue with the SP shikigami Inaba Kaguya's [Wish Power] that occurred in some scenarios.

10. Fixed an interaction error with the SP shikigami Frosty Yuki Onna's [Ice Nova] and Seimei's [Spell: Bind], where [Ice Nova]'s effect was incorrectly dealing damage to [Spell: Bind]'s effect, causing it to be removed.

11. Fixed the issue where the SR shikigami Kuro Mujou's [Necrosis] was not properly triggered.

12. Fixed an issue with the SSR shikigami Shokurei's [Feast] where it was incorrectly receiving damage boosts from sources other than Shokurei himself when triggered.

notes.title: Updates on Apr 27
notes.content:
[h1]Update Announcement[/h1]
 
Dear Onmyoji,
 
In order to bring you a better gaming experience, the server will be shut down for maintenance from 2:00 - 4:00 EST on Apr 27. If it is not completed on time, the opening time will be postponed. For details regarding the update, please check the update announcement which will be posted later, or the game login page after the maintenance.
 
During the maintenance period, you will not be able to access the game from the server. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. Thank you for your support and understanding!
 
[h1]Important Updates[/h1]
 
[h2]1. Vernal Bliss Summoning Event[/h2]

※ Event duration: After maintenance on April 27 - 23:59 EST on May 5

※ Level requirement: Lv. 15

[h3]【Selected SP/SSR Shikigami Chance Up】[/h3]

※ During the event, you can select a group of selected shikigami. When an SP/SSR is summoned, there is a 60% chance that it will be one of the selected shikigami.

※ Before the chance up bonus is used up, SP/SSR is guaranteed within 100 summons. The counting resets when an SP/SSR is summoned.

※ When one of the selected Shikigami is summoned, it will not be summoned again while the total chance up for other selected Shikigami remains 60%.

※ You can enjoy the chance up bonus for 3 times, it only counts when you summon one of the selected shikigami.

※ You can select one of the following groups:

- Group A: SP Frosty Yuki Onna, SP Monumental Otakemaru, SSR Suzuhikohime, SSR Shokurei, SSR Menreiki, SSR Ichimokuren.

- Group B: SP Nightveil Higanbana, SP Void Menreiki, SSR Asura, SSR Senhime, SSR Takiyashahime, SSR Higanbana.

- Group C: SP Inaba Kaguya, SP Lovebound Kiyohime, SSR Taishakuten, SSR Kinnara, SSR Orochi, SSR Tamamonomae.

[h3]【Surprise Rewards】[/h3]

※ During the event, you will have 3% chance to obtain a Skill Daruma from each summon. (Guaranteed within 100 summons, this benefit only apply once)

[h3]【Important Rules】[/h3]

※ The event benefit will not apply until you select a group of shikigami. 

※ You can change your selection before summoning any of the currently selected shikigami. Once you have summoned any of the selected shikigami, you cannot change your selection.

※ When the chance up bonus is used up, all event benefits will not apply.

※ For more details, please head to the event page.

[h2]2. Croaking Daruma Event[/h2]

Master Seimei has been kidnapped?! An unprecedented crisis! Base Daruma feels like he has to do something! Operation: Saving Master Seimei!

※ Event duration: After the maintenance on April 27 - 23:59 EST on May 5

※ Level requirement: Lv. 15

※ During the event, everyone will receive a free Roly-Poly Fan daily. Spend a Roly-Poly Fan to enter the challenge, clear the challenge and receive random grade 6 Souls and Orochi's Reverse Scale among other rare rewards.

※ During the event, Roly-Poly Pamphlets can be obtained via completing quests. Collect Roly-Poly Pamphlets to unlock various rewards. You can purchase the upgraded Roly-Poly Pass to unlock Base Daruma's Seimei Daruma skin and other rewards. Unclaimed rewards will be re-issued via in-game mail when the event is over.

[h2]3. Ibuki's Race Event[/h2]

On a fine spring day, come and accept Ibuki's invite. Take your little buddies to an exciting game!

※ Event duration: After the maintenance on April 27 - 23:59 EST on May 5, available at 2:00 - 23:00 daily.

※ Level requirement: Lv. 15

※ Each game will have 4 players. Bring eligible Souls to the game and race with other players in Ibuki's Race.

※ Ibuki will enhance the Souls submitted to the game, then give out ratings to rank them.

※ Participants will be rewarded based on the rankings in their first 10 games.

【Rift Realm】

Once upon a time when Ibuki was not yet an adorable cat... the current onmyoji didn't know how precious the taste of Fish Cakes could be.

Then a trial to find the best of the best changed everything.

※ Event duration: After the update on April 27 - 23:59 EST on May 5

※ Spend Fish Cakes to challenge Rift Realm and receive rewards based on the damage dealt in each battle.

※ For more details, please head to the event page.

[h2]4. New Dawn to Spring Break Recharge Rebate Event[/h2]

※ Event duration: After the maintenance on April 27 - 23:59 EST on May 10

※ Event details: Spend S-Jade and Jade to get points and unlock various rewards.

※ Players who have obtained all four seasons' frames are eligible to receive the Solar Term Specials Team Creation page frames and My Space frames.

※ For every 10 Jade or 1 S-Jade spent, 1 point is granted.

Notes:

- Only S-Jade or Jade spent in the Shop, Summon, Guild, events, etc. will be counted. Jade spent on purchasing Friendship Packs and S-Jade spent to send skins to friends will not be counted.

- You can only gain up to 300 points by spending Jades.

[h2]5. Ebisu's Boutique is available[/h2]

※ Event duration: After the maintenance on April 27 -  23:59 EST on June 21

※ Event details:

- During the event, you can obtain Ebisu's Fortune Shop exclusive frame Dazzling Gold by recharging in the game. You will have a chance to upgrade the frame by obtaining this the frame again from the future Ebisu's Boutique events.

- Recharge to certain amounts to receive the Verdant Springtime Courtyard skin, Seimei's Dark Seimei skin, Skill Daruma, and more!

- For some itmes, if you receive more than one, they will be converted in to other items as follows:

Verdant Springtime Courtyard skin → 1000 Jade

Seimei's "Dark Seimei" skin → "Lord of Kyoto" frame

Seimei's "Dark Seimei" skin + "Lord of Kyoto" frame → "Lord of Kyoto" frame (Gold Daruma version)

- For Players who already have the "Lord of Kyoto" frame (Gold Daruma version), they will gain the right to enter the Boutique, and receive 2 Boutique talismans when they receive the "Dark Seimei" skin again.

- Players who have obtained the Lord of Kyoto frame twice are eligible to receive the exclusive My Page skin Golden Glories.

[h2]6. Special discount in Soul Shop[/h2]

※ Event duration: After the maintenance on April 27 - 23:59 EST on May 5

※ Level requirement: Lv. 41

※ During the event, the souls in Soul Shop will all be grade 6. There will be a 30% discount when Super Lucky is triggered.

[h2]7. Realm Raid: Froglet Invasion Event[/h2]

※ Event duration: 0:00 EST on April 27 -  23:59 EST on May 1

※ During the event, after you refresh the Realm Raid, froglets will appear to take the place of a few random  realms. In these particular realms, the shikigami and the onmyoji will be replaced by froglets. You can challenge up to 3 froglet realms daily.

※ During the event, each day after you finish raiding froglet realms for 3 times and refreshing the page, Oboroguruma will appear to take the place of a realm, where the shikigami will be replaced by froglets and the onmyoji will be replaced by Oboroguruma. In the Oboroguruma realm, your own froglets will receive stats bonus. You can challenge up to 1 Oboroguruma realm daily.

※ Challenging froglet realms grants Medals and Froglet Medals as rewards, with a chance to grant Oboroguruma Realm Cards. If you deploy all froglets in   battle, you will receive extra rewards on victory. The Medal drop from this event is not affected by Medal Drop Bonus.

※ During the event, items that are exchangeable with Froglet Medals will be available in Shop > General > Medal. These items include: upgradable   animated Froglet Invasion frame and grade 5 Oboroguruma Realm Card among others. The event items will be removed from Shop after the event. The Froglet Medals you earn in the event will be kept for you to exchange for the   items available in future Realm Raid: Froglet Invasion events.

※ The first time you claim the highest level progress chest from Realm Raid each day, you will receive an extra random froglet shard.

※ The froglet realm, Oboroguruma realm respawning attempt and froglet shard claiming attempt can not be accumulated and will refresh at 0:00 EST each day. 

※ For more details, please head to the Realm Raid page.

[h1]Improvement[/h1]

1. Improvements for Camera feature:

※ Improved the head-turning action of some shikigami when the Camare is enabled.

※ Adjusted the available actions to some shikigami in Camera.

※ Adjusted shikigami default facing upon entering the scene, changing the lighting from backlighting to frontlighting.

[h1]Fixed Issue[/h1]

Fixed language and technical bugs.

※ The first time you claim the highest level progress chest from Realm Raid each day, you will receive an extra random froglet shard.
※ The froglet realm, Oboroguruma realm respawning attempt and froglet shard claiming attempt can not be accumulated and will refresh at 0:00 EST each day.

notes.title: Updates on Apr 20
notes.content:
[h1]Update Announcement[/h1]
 
Dear Onmyoji,
 
In order to bring you a better gaming experience, the server will be shut down for maintenance from 2:00 - 4:00 EST on Apr 20. If it is not completed on time, the opening time will be postponed accordingly.
 
During the maintenance period, you will not be able to access the game from the server. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. Thank you for your support and understanding!
 
[h1]Important Updates[/h1]
 
[h2]1. New shikigami - Kagewani Arrives in Heian-Kyo[/h2]

※ Brand new R shikigami Kagewani (VA: Minami Hinata) arriving in Heian-Kyo.

※ The Kagewani will not be added into shikigami summon pool, you can obtain Kagewani through collecting pact shards.  After the maintenance on April 20, you can obtain the pact shards of new R shikigami Kagewani via Merchant, Wanted Quests, wishing in the Guild, Demon Parade and Area Boss Challenge etc.

[h2]2. Treasure Trip Event[/h2]

※ Event duration: After the maintenance on April 20 - 23:59 EST on April 26

※ Level requirement: Lv. 15

※ You can btain 2 free Trekking Dice from Demon Encounter daily or purchase more Dices from Shop, roll the dice to move on the event map and pick up the rewards on the landing blocks.

※ Rewards on the map include: Treasured Sakura, Mystery Amulets. Skill Daruma shards, Jade, Demon Souls, and Orochi's Reverse Scale among other rare items.

※ You can Use Tracking Vouchers to roll specific numbers with Trekking Dice and claim rewards from the corresponding blocks.

※ Spend Treasured Sakura to exchange rewards from the Sakura Pavilion including the Moonlit Mountain Realm skin, Flavorful Summon Room, Sakura Swallows frame, Decoration: Inkworld Illusion, and Skill Daruma among other rare item rewards!

※ For more details, please head to the event page.

[h2]3 .New Skin - Aquatic Glaze[/h2]

※ Amezaiku's new skin - Aquatic Glaze will be available in the Skin shop after the maintenance on April 20, with a 20% off discount in the first week! Don't miss it!

[h2]4 .New Skin - Crimson Demon[/h2]

※ Ibaraki Doji's new skin - Crimson Demon will be available in the Skin shop after the maintenance on April 20, with a 20% off discount in the first week! Don't miss it!

[h2]5. New function - Daruma Arena[/h2]

Come and configure a daruma lineup and test your strength!

※ Zone portal: In Original Town, tap Daruma Arena to enter the zone. In New Town, enter the zone in Arena.

※ Level requirement: Lv. 15

※ In Daruma Arena, you can configure the darumas' stats and set the challenge time. When the time is over, the battle report will be displayed (including damage dealt, healing, damage taken, etc.).

[h2]6. New Feature - The Camera[/h2]

※ Added the Camera feature. Take some snap shots for your favorite shikigami in your favorite scenes!

※ Head to the Shikigami and tap the Display button, then tap the Camera button on the bottom left corner to enable the feature.

※ With the Camera feature, you can configure characters' actions, skins, scene effects, camera settings, positions.  Multiple shikigami are also supported.

※ Some of the shikigami, shikigami skins, shikigami actions are currently unavailable in the Camera feature.

[h2]7. Skill Tutorial Updated[/h2]

※ Added the last Battle Puzzles stages to Skill Tutorial. Head to the Shikigami menu and tap the Skill Tutorial button on the Details page of corresponding shikigami to experience the feature.

※ Added a Change button. Tap the button to switch between the shikigami available in Skill Tutorial.

※ Shikigami added to Skill Tutorial after this update: Maestro, Nyunai-suzume, Asura, Vengeful Hannya, and Taishakuten.

[h2]8. Memory Summons Updated[/h2]

※ Summoning duration: After the maintenance on April 20 - 23:59 EST on May 5

※ Chance Up shikigami including Vengeful Hannya, Jr. Ootengu, Taishakuten, Ungaikyo, Hana, Yoto Hime.

※ Chance Up shikigami for the next update will include Void Menreiki, Crimson Yoto, Suzuka Gozen, Kidomaru, Shiranui, Onikiri.

※ For more details, please check the event page.

[h2]9. Double Guild Medals from Demon Encounter[/h2]

※ Event duration:  0:00 EST on April 20 - 23:59 EST on April 26

※ During the event, the Guild Medals obtained after challenging Demon Encounter will be doubled!

[h1]Improvement[/h1]

1. Pet House Upgraded:

※ Removed the 4-pet requirement for Food Plate and Large Toy.

※ Added a Skip feature to Food Plate and Large Toy  animations.

※ Added pet-selecting options for Food Plate. When feeding all pets with Food Plate, pets can be selected or unselected.

※ Added pet-feeding feature in Orochi zones. Pets can now be fed in battles and grant Co-op Rewards upon victory.

※ Added the Hide/Display pet feature to hide certain pets.

※ Added a quick pet check feature to quickly find pets.

2. Improved the shikigami skin equipping rules. Now shikigami can equip obtained skins even before they evolve.

3. Added the Soul Detailed Stats setting option. Now a Soul's first two decimal places can be viewed by checking the Soul Detailed Stats option in Settings.

4. Improved the chat message display. Now messages from friends with Buddy level BFF will have a special display style.

5. Improved the shikigami viewing feature when selecting shikigami in Duel. Now shikigami's names can be viewed by tapping the shikigami's avatar.

6. Improved how Preset Shikigami are configured in Fellowship. Now after a shikigami's Souls are configured, tapping the Save button on the Preset Shikigami page can update the currently configured shikigami.

7. Improved the Mark system page display.

8. Improved Soul-sorting Profile sharing feature:

※ Added the bulk sharing feature. Now multiple Soul-sorting Profiles can be shared at a time.

※ Added the QR Code sharing feature. Tap Create Profile Code on the Soul-sorting Profile sharing page to generate an QR Code.

※ Added the import Profile Code feature. Tap Import Profile Code on the Souls > Sorting > Profiles page to scan the QR Codes shared by friends and obtain their Soul-sorting Profiles.

9. Improved lock Pre-Set Lineups feature:

※ Once a lineup is locked, the shikigami in the lineup cannot be changed. If shikigami need to be changed, the lineup must be unlocked first.

※ Souls can still be configured for the shikigami in a locked lineup.

10. Added the shards of the SR shikigami Garuda, Kawazaru and the SSR shikigami Suzuhikohime, Fukengaku as shikigami shard rewards in Area Boss and Wanted Quests.

11. Added a Skin tab to the Evolution page of N shikigami, EXP Daruma, Base Daruma, Grade Daruma, and Skill Daruma.

12. Improved the time when the Paper Doll Shrine notification bubble is prompted. Players below Lv. 20 who haven't yet unlocked the Paper Doll Shrine system will no longer receive such notifications.

13. Improved the skill description of the SSR shikigami Asura's [Annihilation Flames] skill (This doesn't change the skill's effects.)

14. Improved how Souls are upgraded, accelerated the animation playback speed.

15. Improved how Animation Scrolls and Animated Scrolls are played in the Shikigami menu.

16. Improved the screen adaption issue for Agent Summons.

17. Redid the SSR shikigami Onikiri's special Glorious Slayer skin concept art.

18. Improved the lighting, outlining, and texture of the SSR shikigami Shuten Doji's Blazin' Metal skin.

19. Improved the SR shikigami Yasha's Blood Thirst skin.

20. Improved the model for R shikigami Yamawaro before and after his evolution.

21. Improved the model for R shikigami Hitotsume before and after his evolution.

22. Improved the blurred background for the sub pages in Collection.

[h1]Fixed Issue[/h1]

1. SSR Shikigami Yoto Hime Fixes:

※ Fixed the issue that prevented her from entering the [Glorious Blade] state on her first action.

※ Fixed incorrect interactions between her [Dazzling Cleave] and the R shikigami Ushi no Toki's straw doll.

※ Fixed the incorrect skills of the SSR shikigami Yoto Hime in Heian Stories and raised the [Extra Slice] skill level to Lv. 5.

2. Fixed the missing audio issue for the SP shikigami Onikiri Reforged's Faithful Familiar skin.

3. Fixed the lagging background issue for the SSR shikigami Onikiri's special Glorious Slayer skin in some scenarios.

4. Fixed the display issue of the R shikigami Koi's [Bubble Cage] in some scenarios.

5. Fixed the cropped text issue on Guild Achievements.

6. Fixed the issue with the SP shikigami Virtuoso Hana's [Lifelike Image] skill where the image was not disappeared after a round ends in some scenes.

7. Fixed the issue where a Soul Configuration calculation result can be saved as multiple Profiles.

8. Fixed an issue with Area Boss where some of the bosses were unable to be challenged in some scenarios.

9. Fixed the issue where the shikigami skin equipping button was displayed on the Totem skin page.

notes.title: Updates on Apr 13
notes.content:
[h1]Update Announcement[/h1]
 
Dear Onmyoji,
 
In order to bring you a better gaming experience, the server will be shut down for maintenance from 2:00 - 4:00 EST on Apr 13. If it is not completed on time, the opening time will be postponed. For details regarding the update, please check the update announcement which will be posted later, or the game login page after the maintenance.
 
During the maintenance period, you will not be able to access the game from the server. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. Thank you for your support and understanding!
 
[h1]Important Updates[/h1]
 
[h2]1. Stealthy Shadow Event[/h2]

※ Event duration: 0:00 EST on April 14  - 23:59 EST on April 20

※ Level requirement: Lv. 15

※ Shadows are lurking in the dark. Enter the forest to follow their trails. The sound of a strange spirit seems both near and far. When you look close, you only see the traces of a wounded spirit. Kohaku can't ignore this, but where does this trail lead?

※ During the event, clear the Stealthy Bait zone once daily to increase event progress.

※ Please note that the R shikigami Kagewani from this event can only be claimed after the maintenance on April 20.

[h2]2. Easter Boss Challenge Event[/h2]

※Event duration: 0:00 EST on April 14  - 23:59 EST on April 17

※ Level requirement: Lv. 15

※ During the event, you can challenge SP Ninja Yamausagi, the Easter Boss on the map.

※ You have 5 challenge attempts each day.

※ Challenge the boss for a chance to get New Animated Frame: Jumping Daruma, other rare frames, AR Amulet, Jade etc.

[h2]3. New Skin - Crescent Steps[/h2]

※ Divine Miketsu's new skin - Crescent Steps will be available in the Skin shop after the maintenance on April 13, with a 20% off discount in the first week! Don't miss it!

[h2]4. FORTUNE! Discount and Free Refresh in Soul Shop[/h2]

※ Event duration: 0:00 EST on April 13 - 23:59 EST on April 19

※ Every day during the event, the first 10 purchases in the soul shop will have a 20% discount and the lineup can be refreshed 30 times for free.

[h1]Improvement[/h1]

1. Improved the description of SP Valiant Yamakaze's 2nd skill [Command] and the soul Tomb Guard's effect:

- For [Command], the description of the Lv.3 effect has been adjusted to: At the start of Valiant Yamakaze's turn, each 1 MP Briskey has amplifies his Crit DMG by 1% when he deals damage

- For Tomb Guard's effect, the description has been adjusted to: 'Amplifies Crit DMG by 0.5% for each 1% HP reduced.

This adjustment does not change the actual skill and soul effect. For example, if an SP Valiant Yamakaze has a starting Crit DMG of 200%, amplifying his Crit DMG by 1% makes his Crit DMG 202% (200+200*1%)

[h1]Fixed Issue[/h1]

Fixed language and technical bugs.

notes.title: Updates on Apr 06
notes.content:
[h1]Update Announcement[/h1]
 
Dear Onmyoji,
 
In order to bring you a better gaming experience, the server will be shut down for maintenance from 2:00 - 4:00 EST on Apr 6. If it is not completed on time, the opening time will be postponed accordingly.
 
During the maintenance period, you will not be able to access the game from the server. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. Thank you for your support and understanding!
 
[h1]Important Updates[/h1]
 
[h2]1. The Invisible Mountain Unveiled Summoning Event[/h2]

※ Summon period: After the maintenance on April 6 –  23:59 EST on April 19

Level requirment: Lv. 5

【Summon Chance Up】

※ During the event, when summoning using Mystery Amulets, Jade, or AR Amulets, the drop rate of SP/SSR Shikigami will be 2.5 times the normal rate. The summon rate will revert to the normal rate after you successfully summons 3 SP/SSR Shikigami.

【Fukengaku arrives】

During the event, when summoning via a Mystery Amulet, Jade, or AR Amulet, there is a chance of receiving a SSR Fukengaku! The chance of receiving a SSR Fukengaku will increase as more summons are made! The chance up bonus will be used up when SSR Fukengaku is summoned.

※ For those who have completed their SSR collection before the maintenance on April 6:

- the initial chance for the SSR Fukengaku will increase from 15% to 100% after 500 summons made!

※ For others:

- the initial chance for the SSR Fukengaku will increase from 4% to 20% after 500 summons made!

【Stage Rewards】

※Summon shikigami for a certain number of times to receive corresponding stage rewards, which contain a Skill Daruma, a handful of Mystery Amulets, Skin Tokens, Jade, SR shikigami of your choice among other rare items.

【Special Benefits】

※ If you fail to obtain the SSR Fukengaku in your first 599 summons:

- For those who complete the All SSR Collected achievement before the maintenance on April 6: Your 600th summon is guaranteed to grant you the SSR Fukengaku, plus an additional surprise gift.

- For others, the chance for the SSR Fukengaku will be increased to 30% after the 600th summon.

【Important Rules】

- All SSR Collected is defined as having all SSR shikigami lit up in your Collection (excluding Ryomen).

- All SSR Collected does not include the Crossover Characters.

- Players below Lv. 5 won't be able to enjoy the event bonuses. But their summoning attempts made during the event are still counted towards the Stage Rewards, allowing them to claim the rewards and enjoy the Chance Up bonus as soon as they reach Lv. 5 during the event.

- For players who have received the Bonded Amulet, they will receive the SSR Fukengaku when they first log in to the game after the maintenance on April 6. A SSR Fukengaku pact will be sent to the players via in-game mail, consuming their Bonded Amulet at the same time. The reward won't consume players' SP/SSR Chance Up bonus and SSR Fukengaku Chance Up bonus. Make sure you check your mailbox.

[h2]2. Elusive Peak Event[/h2]

Seimei and his friends embarked on a fieldtrip to find a concealed place — Mt. Fukengaku. The name of the mountain, Fuken, not only suggests that it's hard to find, but also that it's related to a story of the past.

※ Event duration: After the maintenance on April 6 –  23:59 EST on April 12

【Winding Path】

It's a long journey through the mountains. Walk the perilous and winding paths to discover the secrets hidden within these mountains.

※ Fukengaku will take the position of the onmyoji in battles.

※ Spend Memory Dews and AP to explore and battle on the mountain and find the entrance to the next stages.

※ Take shortcuts via Cloud Passages and collect the rewards.

【Promotion】

Carry the blessings of the spiritual tortoise with you as you walk the perilous path.

※ Collect Mountain Spirits to grant Stat Bonuses to shikigami allies.

※ Spend Mountain Spirits to promote and enhance Fukengaku's skills and stats, and unlock more special skills for allies.

【Ascend the Mountain】

The energy of the mountain is disordered and obscuring the path up the mountain. Drink the mountain's specialty Memory Dew to regain memories and forge ahead.

※ Ascend the Mountain will be available until 23:59 EST on April 19. Each Ascent unlocks over time. Let's challenge the stages and review the mountain's exclusive memories with the mountain god.

【Blossoming of Life】

Cherry blossoms bloom and wither as they witness the stories of Mt. Fukengaku every spring.

※ Collect Temporal Sakura to awaken the memories of the sakura tree and claim daily idle rewards based on the status of the tree.

※ Unlocked event stories will be included in Worldly Plays. Stories include Observations, Searches, and Artifacts.

※ As the sakura tree is awakened, the sound of instruments awaken as well. Each time the sakura tree is upgraded, an instrument can be unlocked in Ageless Chants.

【Fieldtrip Route】

※ Complete quests to receive Fieldtrip Pamphlets. Collect Fieldtrip Pamphlets to unlock rewards in Fieldtrip Route.

※ The Hiking Pass can be purchased to unlock Theme: Elusive Peak and Grade 4 Grade Daruma, among other rewards.

※ Fieldtrip Route will be available until 23:59 EST on April 19. Unclaimed rewards will be reissued via in-game mail by the end of the event.

【Field Shop】

※ Collect Cloud Feathers from various zones to exchange rewards at the Field Shop (available until 23:59 EST on April 19).

※ Rack up enough Cloud Feathers to exchange SR shikigami Kawazaru's Monsoon Mischief skin, exclusive Caped Hill frame, a Skill Daruma, and a Random SSR/SP Shikigami Summoning Scroll, among other rewards.

[h2]3. SSR Fukengaku Memory Scrolls Event[/h2]

※ Event duration: After the maintenance on April 6 –  23:59 EST on April 26

During the event, you can obtain scroll shards by participating in different in-game activities. For every scroll shard donated, you will receive 1 random reward. After the memory scroll has been repaired, you can view the corresponding story.

Rewards will be given out to players according to their donation ranking, including SSR Fukengaku shards, Mountain Drink frame, Skill Daruma, and more.

For players who rank top 1000 or those whose repair contribution is above 2000, they will receive the exclusive Frame Mountain Drink.

[h2]4. Talisman Pass (April)[/h2]

※ Event duration: After the maintenance on April 6 –  before the maintenance on May 6

※ You can complete different missions to increase the Talisman level.

※ As the Talisman level increases, Onmyoji can obtain various rewards including the exclusive frame.

※ Purchase the Deluxe Talisman to unlock bonus rewards such as the exclusive animated frame, an exclusive illustration and Azurestorm Ichimokuren's Sakura Breeze skin!

※ Updated Legacy Talisman and related shop:

- You can purchase Legacy Talisman from the Talisman Pass - Shop page. Upon purchase, each Talisman Pass level you reached grants you a Talisman Coin. Each Talisman Pass grants up to 50 Talisman Coins.

- Talisman Coins can be used to purchase month-related skins from previous Talisman Passes. Spend Talisman Coins to purchase the Seawatch Kingyo's return skin - Dawn Glory and Shiranui 's return skin - Dazzling Dancer for the current Talisman Pass.

[h2]5. Memory Summons Updated[/h2]

※ Summoning duration: After the maintenance on April 6 - 23:59 EST on April 19

※ Chance Up shikigami including Frosty Yuki Onna, Blazing Tamamonomae, Menreiki, Tamamonomae, Ichimokuren and Enma.

※ Chance Up shikigami for the next update will include Vengeful Hannya, Jr. Ootengu, Taishakuten, Ungaikyo, Hana, Yoto Hime.

※ For more details, please check the event page.

[h2]6. Bonding Shrine Updated[/h2]

※ The invisible mountain unveiled. After maintenance on April 6, the brand new SSR shikigami Fukengaku will be available in the Bonding Shop. Welcome to exchange the shikigami there.

[h2]7. Paper Doll Skin Updated[/h2]

※ New Paper Doll Skins are available after the maintenance on April 6 - 23:59 EST on May 5

※ Added Suzuka Gozen, Yuki Onna and Negi Paper Doll skins which can be purchased in Paper Doll Shrine > Collection.

[h2]8. Improvemet for Frame system:[/h2]

※ The configuration for Favorite Frames is now synched across devices (opening the Frames page first time after maintenance, the system will automatically synchronize the player's configuration of Favorite Frames stored locally).

※ Added a folding feature for the Type sub-page.

※ Frame display is now larger.

※ Added fuzzy search feature (search is no longer case-sentitive).

[h2]9. New feature - Soul Profile Group Management[/h2]

※ On the Soul Profiles page, enter the group management feature from the side bar to add, rename, and delete groups and adjust their orders.

※ While moving Soul Profiles, they can be moved individually or collectively by switching between Single and Multiple. In Multiple mode, Soul Profiles can be deleted or moved in batches.

※ Deleting a group will also delete all the Soul Profiles in the group. Please proceed with caution.

[h2]10. Good luck doesn't wait! - Selectable Soul Drop Event[/h2]

Not enough souls to get your Shikigami fully equipped? No worries, the Soul drop event is coming this weekend!

※ Event Duration: 0:00 EST on  April 9  - 23:59 EST on April 10

- During this event, you can choose the type of souls that drop in the Soul Zone.

- You can choose 4 types of souls. The same soul cannot be chosen more than once in any lineup. After you have selected a lineup, you can edit it at any time for free.

- Your selected lineup will be in effect for the first 200 challenges each day. After this, the soul lineup will return to normal.

[h1]Shikigami Improvement[/h1]

1. Skill Improvements  for SSR Shikigami Yoto Hime:

※ Changed the Ghostly Blade skill effect to:
Whenever her damage lands a critical hit, permanently increases her Crit DMG by 5% (max 100% Crit DMG increased). If her Crit DMG reaches 350%, she enters the Glorious Blade state.

※ Added level-up effect:
- Lv. 2: Increases the Crit DMG boost from critical hits to 6% and increases the Crit DMG boost limit to 120%.
- Lv. 3: Increases the Crit DMG boost from critical hits to 7% and increases the Crit DMG boost limit to 140%.
- Lv. 4: Increases the Crit DMG boost from critical hits to 8% and increases the Crit DMG boost limit to 160%.
- Lv. 5: Increases the Crit DMG boost from critical hits to 10% and increases the Crit DMG boost limit to 200%.

※ Added the Glorious Blade effect: Attacks ignore 50% of target's DEF. Each time 8 orbs are used by allies, if she's not under controlling effects or Banished, she uses Dazzling Cleave on a random enemy free of orb cost, prioritizing on the target she last actively attacked with Dazzling Cleave. The damage multiplier of the attack is halved. The skill's orb count resets after it's triggered.

※ Improved the Savage Combo skill effect to:
- Launches a 6-strike attack on 1 enemy, dealing damage equal to 50% of her ATK on each strike. If the enemy is KO'd before she finishes her 6 strikes, she changes her target to the enemy with the lowest HP. If she's in the Glorious Blade state, she gains Dazzling Cleave with its skill level equal to the skill level of Savage Combo.

※ Added the Dazzling Cleave skill: Launches a 6-strike attack on 1 enemy, dealing damage equal to 60% of her ATK on each strike.
- Lv. 2: Increases damage to 65%.
- Lv. 3: Increases damage to 70%.
- Lv. 4: Increases damage to 75%.
- Lv. 5: Increases damage to 80%.

[h1]Improvement[/h1]

1.  Improvements for Paper Doll Shrine:

※ Added Agent Summons Paper Doll and Fellowship Summons Paper Doll. Players can now exchange skins for these two paper dolls and view Agent Summons and Fellowship Summons records from their Paper Doll's Pamphlets.

※ Improved the layout and decorations for the Paper Dolls in the Paper Doll Shrine.

※ Added a blocking button on the top of the Paper Doll Shrine page. Tap the button to hide the name tag of Paper Dolls and the Paper Doll Skin access.

※ Improved the skin preview feature in the Paper Doll Skin. Tap the skin on the skin purchase page to view interactive effects.

2. Improvements for Spirit Plaza Fellowship:

※ Improved how players configure preset shikigami in Fellowship. As preset shikigami are now saved, all Souls currently used by the preset shikigami will be saved as well. Using Quicky Deposit no longer auto presets shikigami and no longer affects the Souls on the preset shikigami.

※ Added a feature to allow players to view the preset shikigami of their offline Fellowship teammates. If a player has an offline Fellowship teammate, you can tap the shikigami button on the right side of the teammate on the Fellowship Team page to view their preset shikigami.

3. Increased a feature to show the number of grade 6 Souls of Lv. 15 displayed. Players can check the details on the Soul Limit rules page.

4. Changed the SP shikigami Nightveil Higanbana's skill-casting logic in auto mode: If her HP is over 40% of her max HP, she prioritizes using Doom over Underworld and Fallen Flower; if her HP is below 40% of her max HP, she prioritizes using Withering Blooms. These changes won't affect her skill-casting logic when a certain Skill is locked.

5. Improved how players use the Pre-Set Lineups feature. Added a Lock feature to prevent misoperations.

6. Improved the battle preparation page interactions in Exploration zones and other zones. Now players can tap the Ready button to begin battles even when the shikigami's Soul panel is displayed on the screen.

7. Improved the assembly time of the second assembly for Demon Encounter bosses. If the amount of players required is reached within 150 seconds during the second assembly, the challenge can start straight away.

8. Improved the tap responsive range of turn order gauge for switching display mode for the gauge.

9. Improved the repetitive text notification prompts. Added an interval to the prompts.

10. Improved the character creation page. Added a Return button.

11. Duel Shikigami Default Display

※ The feature can now be enabled in Settings > Interact > Battle > Duel Shikigami Default Display.

※ After the feature is enabled, during the shikigami banning stage and selecting stage in Duel, the shikigami displayed in the roster will be equipped in their default skin with their default name.

※ The feature doesn't affect the model display and effect display in battles.

12. Improved the Soul Configuration. In exclude favorited Soul Profiles, the default sorting now displays recently edited Soul Profiles at the top if sort by Group is not selected.

13. Improved the skin gifting feature. If your friend already owns a certain skin, prompts will be displayed when you tries to gift a skin.

14. Improved the quick message button on the Team page.

15. Improved how players exchange Souls on the Sort Souls page. Now when a Soul is obtained via exchange, it will be displayed on the Unsorted page.

16. Improved how Talisman Pass rewards are claimed. After tapping the Claim All button, rewards of the same type from boxes of the same type can be claimed in batches.

17. Improved the display and sorting or some chat stickers.

18. Improved the summoning animation of the SSR shikigami Suzuhikohime.

19. Improved the in-battle status descriptions for bosses.

20. Summon Room Onmyoji Skin Customization feature:

※ The skin of the Summon Room will now be displayed in the skins players currently equipped with.

21. Improved Tide Soul Box's tap-responsive area while exchanging, reducing the chance of mistakes and page error.

22. Improved the blurred background for the sub pages in Collection.

23. Improved the position and size of Kagura's Graceful Serenity skin in battles, reducing the model's chance of blocking other shikigami models and their tap-responsive areas.

Fixed Issue

1. Fixed an issue on the SP shikigami Lovebound Kiyohime's Resentment where the effect failed in certain scenarios.

2. Fixed an issue on the SSR shikigami Ibaraki Doji's Demon Hand skin where the earring was inaccurate.

3. Fixed an issue on the SR shikigami Futakuchi where her arms were distorted in battles.

4. Fixed an issue on the Ultimate Orochi zone where the HP bar of the shikigami were incorrectly displayed on the battle preparation page.

5. Fixed an issue in the Boss Defense zone where the ghosts were difficult to select.

6. Fixed an issue on the Duel Reserve Lineup where a delete button was incorrectly displayed on the Soul Profile configuration page.

7. Fixed an issue on Themes where they weren't correctly displayed in some scenarios.

8. Fixed a display issue in players' signature on the Page.

9. Fixed an issue on the Grand Celebrity-exclusive accessories Silver Fan: Star and Silver Fan: Death where they weren't properly equipped in some scenarios.

10. Fixed an issue on the SSR shikigami Taishakuten where he was incorrectly creating a Ceremony of the King field in some scenarios.

11. Fixed the incorrect Upper Hand skill effect for the SSR shikigami Suzuhikohime, the SSR shikigami Ichimokuren, and the SR shikigami Nyunai-suzume in some scenarios.

12. Fixed an issue on the SR shikigami Garuda where the number of normal attack strikes he launched on the target with Valuable Feather was incorrect in some scenarios.

13. Fixed an issue on the SR shikigami Garuda where when his passive skill is sealed in some scenarios, the skill was still incorrectly triggered.

14. Fixed an issue on the SP shikigami Guardian Ubume where she was incorrectly able to launch multiple Ink-shadow Slashes during counter attacks in some scenarios.

15. Fixed a chat system issue in Royal Battle zone occurred in some scenarios.

16. Fixed the blank space error in Collection > Cos.

17. Fixed an issue on the SR shikigami Yumekui where the Daze and Taunt status icons were misaligned above him in battles.

18. Fixed an issue on the Onmyoji Seimei's Spell: Bind where it was ineffective against the SP shikigami Ninja Yamausagi and the SP shikigami Valiant Yamakaze's second strike of his normal attack.

19. Fixed some interaction issues between the SR shikigami Dodomeki's Cursed Eye and other shikigami.

20. Fixed an issue in Team mode where some of the shikigami names weren't correctly displayed in some scenarios.

notes.title: Updates on Mar 30
notes.content:
[h1]Update Announcement[/h1]
 
Dear Onmyoji,
 
In order to bring you a better gaming experience, the server will be shut down for maintenance from 2:00 - 4:00 EST on Mar 30. If it is not completed on time, the opening time will be postponed. For details regarding the update, please check the update announcement which will be posted later, or the game login page after the maintenance.
 
During the maintenance period, you will not be able to access the game from the server. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. Thank you for your support and understanding!
 
[h1]Important Updates[/h1]
 
[h2]1. SSR Fukengaku Assembly Event[/h2]

SSR Fukengaku will soon be available for summoning, stay tuned!

※ Assembly period:  0:00 EST on April 2 - 23:59 EST on April 5

※ Summoning period: After the maintenance on April 6 - 23:59 EST on April 19

※ During the Assembly period, you can watch the story and claim rewards on the summon page.

[h2]2. Battle Puzzles Limited Event[/h2]

※ Event duration: After the maintenance on March 30 - 23:59 EST on April 5

※ Level requirement: Lv. 15

※ New shikigami with new challenges!

※ During the event, a puzzle with three difficulty levels will be unlocked for challenge each day. You will enter the battles with pre-configured shikigami and Soul sets. Use the skills wisely to solve the puzzle for rewards!

[h2]3. Special discount in Soul Shop[/h2]

※ Event duration: After the maintenance on March 30 - before the maintenance on April 5

※ Level requirement: Lv. 41

※ During the event, the souls in Soul Shop will all be grade 6. There will be a 30% discount when Super Lucky is triggered.

[h2]4. Pack Shop Voucher available![/h2]

※ Event duration: After the maintenance on March 30 - 23:59 EST on April 5

※ During the event, Pack Vouchers will be available at the Fortune Cat in the Pack Shop. Spend 3 S-Jade (10 attempts) to receive a random Pack Voucher worth 3, 5, 10, 15, 20, 50, 100, 168, or 500 S-Jade. Pack Vouchers can be used when purchasing certain packs to receive a discount of equal value.

※ Pack Vouchers can only be used on Packs worth more than the discount and cannot be used to purchase the daily Blessing pack, Growth Invest and Returnee Pack.

※ When you purchase and draw the Pack Voucher, the value will always start with 3 S-Jade, each time you tap the screen, the voucher will have a chance to increase its value. Come and try your luck!

※ Vouchers obtained from the event will expire on April 5 at 23:59 EST. Please use them in time.

[h2]5. Updates for Merchant[/h2]

※ Updates for Mystery Outfit Bag: Purchase to receive one of the following: Jade, AP, SP Skin Tokens, Tesso's Tasty Takoyaki skin, and Divine Miketsu's Celebration Dance skin.

※ Udates for Mystery Crown Bag: Purchase to receive one of the following: AP, Coins, Skin Tokens, animated Bonded with You frame, animated Dawn at Last: Finale frame, Whale Bone and Seaside Dream frame.

※ The skins and frames available in the mystery bags will be refreshed at 0:00 EST on May 7.

[h2]6. Realm Raid: Froglet Invasion Event[/h2]

※ Event duration: 0:00 EST on March 30 - April 3 at 23:59 EST

※ During the event, after you refresh the Realm Raid, froglets will appear to take the place of a few random  realms. In these particular realms, the shikigami and the onmyoji will be replaced by froglets. You can challenge up to 3 froglet realms daily.

※ During the event, each day after you finish raiding froglet realms for 3 times and refreshing the page, Oboroguruma will appear to take the place of a realm, where the shikigami will be replaced by froglets and the onmyoji will be replaced by Oboroguruma. In the Oboroguruma realm, your own froglets will receive stats bonus. You can challenge up to 1 Oboroguruma realm daily.

※ Challenging froglet realms grants Medals and Froglet Medals as rewards, with a chance to grant Oboroguruma Realm Cards. If you deploy all froglets in   battle, you will receive extra rewards on victory. The Medal drop from this event is not affected by Medal Drop Bonus.

※ During the event, items that are exchangeable with Froglet Medals will be available in Shop > General > Medal. These items include: upgradable   animated Froglet Invasion frame and grade 5 Oboroguruma Realm Card among others. The event items will be removed from Shop after the event. The Froglet Medals you earn in the event will be kept for you to exchange for the   items available in future Realm Raid: Froglet Invasion events.

※ The first time you claim the highest level progress chest from Realm Raid each day, you will receive an extra random froglet shard.

※ The froglet realm, Oboroguruma realm respawning attempt and froglet shard claiming attempt can not be accumulated and will refresh at 0:00 EST each day. 

※ For more details, please head to the Realm Raid page.

Fixed Issue

Fixed language and technical bugs.

notes.title: Updates on Mar 23
notes.content:
[h1]Update Announcement[/h1]
 
Dear Onmyoji,
 
In order to bring you a better gaming experience, the server will be shut down for maintenance from 2:00 - 4:00 EST on Mar 23. If it is not completed on time, the opening time will be postponed accordingly.
 
During the maintenance period, you will not be able to access the game from the server. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. Thank you for your support and understanding!
 
[h1]Important Updates[/h1]
 
[h2]1. Rock Excavation Event[/h2]

The world changes, but mountains remain. The mountains that have witnessed everything stayed motionless. However, secrets lie within the heart.

The fire that forged the mountains, the sea that carved the mountains, the moon that cleansed the mountains, and the forest that remembers the mountains. What stories are told among the monsters and spirits in the mountains?

※ Event duration: March 24 - March 30 at 23:59 EST

※ Level requirement: Lv. 15

※ During the event, you can travel the mountains to find the stones left by the spirits and discover secrets among them.

※ Assemble the collected stones into rocks with special patterns to unlock the secrets buried in the rocks and receive rewards.

[h2]2. Coin Chaos Event[/h2]

※ Event Duration: After the maintenance on March 23 - April 5 at 23:59 EST

※ Event details:
- Collect Tesso's Coins to unlock stage rewards.
- Spending the required amount of Coins to receive Tesso's Gifts.

※ How to obtain Tesso's Coins:
– Clearing Orochi zones, Exploration zones, and Evo zones.
– Completing quests in Coin Chaos.

Note: When the event ends, excess Tesso's Coins will be converted into Coins.

[h2]3. New Skin - Cat Ninja[/h2]

※ Gaki's new skin - Cat Ninja will be available in the Skin shop after the maintenance on March 23, with a 20% off discount in the first two week! Don't miss it!

[h2]4. New Feature - Onmyoji Accessories[/h2]

※ Feature portal: Tap the onmyoji in the Courtyard > tap the Accessories to access the feature page.

※ On the Accessories page, you can view, equip and unequip onmyoji's accessories and skill-casting effects.

[h2]5. Memory Summons Updated[/h2]

※ Summoning duration: After the maintenance on March 23 - 23:59 EST on April 5

※ Chance Up shikigami including Seawatch Kingyo, Waverider Lord Arakawa, Enmusubi, Hakuzosu, Kaguya and Lord Arakawa.

※ Chance Up shikigami for the next update will include Frosty Yuki Onna, Blazing Tamamonomae, Menreiki, Tamamonomae, Ichimokuren and Enma.

※ For more details, please check the event page.

[h2]6. Duel Rewards Upgraded[/h2]

※ During the weekly Duel settlement, players who reached the Grand Celebrity tier will additionally receive Seimei's Silver Fan: Star and Silver Fan: Death skill-casting effects.

※ The skill-casting effects will be issued in the weekly duel mail and expire in 1 week.

※ You can tap the onmyoji in the Courtyard > tap the Accessories button to preview and replace accessories and skill-casting effects.

[h2]7. Draft Duel Updated[/h2]

※  SSR Suzuhikohime, SSR Yato no Kami and SP Ninja Yamausagi are avaliable in Draft Duel for Onmyoji to choose.

[h2]8. Demon Parade Chance Up![/h2]

※ Event time: 0:00 EST on March 23 - 23:59 EST on March 27

※During the event period, there will be an increased chance of obtaining Shikigami shards during the first 5 games each day! Onmyoji, have your beans ready!

[h1]Improvement[/h1]

1. Improved the lighting, outlining, and texture of the SSR shikigami Ibaraki Doji's Demon Hand, Maple Memories, Winter Bamboo and Hellfire Warlord skins.

2. Improvements of Paper Doll Shrine:

※ Improved the name tag display style for the Paper Dolls in the Paper Doll Shrine.

※ Fixed the issue on the Demon Parade Paper Doll pamphlet where the shards of some shikigami were not properly displayed.

※ Fixed the issue on the Login Paper Doll where some of the login text was unable to be viewed.

3. Improved the model for the SR shikigami Enenra's special edition Dark Blue skin.

4. Added a Skill button to the zone portal on the Orochi, Sougenbi, Fallen Sun, and Sea of Eternity zones for players to view all skills of the bosses in the zones.

5. Improved the purchasing experience of Mystery Amulets during Agent Summons Event. Now you can purchase Mystery Amulets in succession until you have a sufficient amount.

6. Improved the models for the SR shikigami Yumekui before and after evolution.

7. New Feature - Frame Preview

※ When you are viewing the personal info of other players, you can tap the frame or the button on the left to view the display effect of the frame and how it can be obtained.

8. Reduced the stats of R shikigami Karasu Tengu in Draft Duel and Underworld Arena.

9. Improved the Daruma animation play speed on the rewards calculation page.

10. Improved the purchase experience in Shops. Now the game won't return to the top after the player finishes a purchase.

11. Added the feature to unequip all Souls from all shikigami. Now by tapping and holding Unequip All button, players can unequip all Souls from all shikigami. To prevent players from making mistakes, the feature can only be used once in every 10 minutes.

12. Improved the damage calculation page for EXP Spirit and Coin Spirit zones. Now players can know clearly about the damage they dealt.

13. Improved the Realm Shikigami Promotion operations. Now players can tap a non-max leveled shikigami to directly replace a max leveled shikigami in promotion with it.

14. Added a notification when the player doesn't have enough Fellowship deposit. If the player has insufficient deposit, they will be notified the next time they open the game.

15. Improved the display of Rookie Tutorial quests. When the player has an unlocked Tutorial quest, they will be notified of the unlocking conditions of the next quest.

16. Improved Tide Soul Box's exchange experience. Removed the dot effect after a Soul is selected.

17. Improved the bubble notification on the Scroll menu in the Courtyard.

18. Improved the default shikigami deploying logic in Duel.

19. Added a Shikigami menu on Duel Lineup Pre-Set page.

20. Improved model size of Hiromasa's Myrtle Musician skin on the Team creation page.

21. Improved the model for the SSR shikigami Orochi's special edition Dark Blue skin.

22. Improved the models for SR shikigami Futakuchi before and after her evolution and her special edition Dark Blue skin.

[h1]Fixed Issue[/h1]

1. Fixed an issue on the SP shikigami Ninja Yamausagi's Ninja Mine where it was incorrectly triggering the SR shikigami Komatsu's Timid effect.

2. Fixed issue for the SP shikigami Ninja Yamausagi's Ninja Mine where the targets were not correctly selected.

3. Fixed issue for the SSR shikigami Suzuhikohime's Undying Flame where it was impossible for her Move Bar to be changed when she was in this state.

4. Fixed the issue in Draft Duel and Underworld Arena battles where the deployed SP shikigami did not appear to be selected.

5. Fixed incorrect skill logic of the SSR shikigami Takiyashahime.

6. Fixed an issue on the SSR shikigami Shuten Doji's special edition Royalty skin where it was unable to be viewed when zoomed in.

7. Fixed the adaptability of the Shikigami menu on some devices.

8. Fixed the offset camera angle of zooming in shikigami in the Shikigami menu.

9. Fixed the error description of Umbrella in the Wanted Quest.

10. Fixed the adaptability of the Collection menu on some devices.

11. Fixed the offset invite prompt when Guild activities are started for some devices.

12. Fixed the errors in Fellowship Deposit All Settings when the Bonus deposit time was set to 0, using Deposit All was still incorrectly depositing 1 hour of Bonus.

13. Fixed the incorrect text on the button that redirects the player to the Soul Shop when the player has used up their exchange attempts for Boss Soul Box and for the Soul Box in Shrine.

14. Fixed the camera angle issue in some battle scenes.

15. Fixed the adaptability of the skin purchasing page in the Skin shop on some devices.
