notes.title: Updates on Mar 16
notes.content:
[h1]Update Announcement[/h1]
 
Dear Onmyoji,
 
In order to bring you a better gaming experience, the server will be shut down for maintenance from 2:00 - 4:00 EST on Mar 16. If it is not completed on time, the opening time will be postponed. For details regarding the update, please check the update announcement which will be posted later, or the game login page after the maintenance.
 
During the maintenance period, you will not be able to access the game from the server. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. Thank you for your support and understanding!
 
[h1]Important Updates[/h1]
 
[h2]1. Spring Bond Summoning Event[/h2]

※ Event duration: After the maintenance on March 16 - 23:59 EST on March 27

【Selected SP/SSR Shikigami Chance Up】

※ Select 1 SP/SSR shikigami as the Main shikigami and 6 other SP/SSR shikigami as the Sub shikigami. When summoning an SP/SSR shikigami via Mystery Amulet, Jade, or AR Amulet, there's a 15% chance of it being the Main shikigami and a 5% chance of it being the Sub shikigami. All selected shikigami have a total of 45% chance of being summoned. You can enjoy the Chance Up bonus for the Main shikigami up to once, and twice for Sub shikigami.

※ If you still have a Chance Up bonus after making 500 summons via Mystery Amulet, Jade, or AR Amulet, the remaining probability will be doubled, meaning it will be 30% chance up for the Main shikigami and 10% for each of the Sub shikigami.

【SP/SSR Guaranteed】

- SP/SSR Shikigami is guranteed within 60 summons, the counting resets when an SP/SSR is summoned. The SP/SSR shikigami summoned via this bonus will also enjoy the Selected SP/SSR Chance Up bonus.

- The bonus will always trigger until the Chance Up bonuses for the selected shikigami are used up.

【Stage Rewards】

※ During the event, you can perform summon for a number of times to receive stage rewards.

※ Stage rewards includes New SR Garuda, Mystery Amulets, Skill Daruma, Skin Tokens among other rare items.

【Important Rules】

※ The event is only available to players who have reached Lv. 5.

※ Players who haven't reached Lv. 5 won't be able to enjoy the SP/SSR Chance Up bonus and other bonuses during the event when summoning shikigami. But their summoning attempts made during the event are still counted towards the Stage Rewards, allowing them to claim the rewards and enjoy the Chance Up bonus as soon as they reach Lv. 5 during the event.

※ During the event, you need to select your Main shikigami and your Sub shikigami before summoning.

※ Once you've made your choices, you cannot change them.

※ The SSR Ryomen , SSR Suzuhikohime, SP Ninja Yamausagi and crossover event-exclusive shikigami can not be chosen as your Main shikigami and Sub shikigami. But SSR Suzuhikohime and SP Ninja Yamausagi can still be summoned via this event. 

[h2]2. Spring Fest Event[/h2]

※ Event duration: After the maintenance on March 16 - 23:59 EST on March 29

※ Gain points from engaging in the battle of Exploration zones, Soul zones, Evo zones or using Amulets. Points can be exchanged for rewards.

※The event can be accessed from the Paper Doll on the right in the Courtyard.

[h2]3. Double Guild Medals from Demon Encounter[/h2]

※ Event duration:  0:00 EST on March 16 - 23:59 EST on March 22

※ During the event, the Guild Medals obtained after challenging Demon Encounter will be doubled!

[h1]Fixed Issue[/h1]

Fixed language and technical bugs.

notes.title: Updates on Mar 9
notes.content:
[h1]Update Announcement[/h1]
 
Dear Onmyoji,
 
In order to bring you a better gaming experience, the server will be shut down for maintenance from 2:00 - 4:30 EST on Mar 9. If it is not completed on time, the opening time will be postponed accordingly.
 
During the maintenance period, you will not be able to access the game from the server. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. Thank you for your support and understanding!
 
[h1]Important Updates[/h1]
 
[h2]1. The Onmyoji Call-up Event[/h2]

※ The onmyoji of the capital have set out to discover secrets, which will be passed on to the onmyoji of the three major clans who will review the rumors.

※ Event duration: After the maintenance on March 9 - 23:59 EST on March 15

※ You can select to help either the Minamoto Clan, the Kamo Clan, or the Fujiwara Clan daily to help them gather more rumors.

※ Seimei will start helping the three major clans in the last 3 days of the event to expedite the progress. All rumor stories will be unlocked by the end of the event.

※ You can receive rewards after unlocking rumor stories at certain milestones.

[h2]2. Sweet Roulette Event[/h2]

※ Event duration: After the maintenance on March 9 - 23:59 EST on March 15

※ During the event, Sweet Vouchers are available for purchase in the Pack shop. 1 Sweet Voucher will be rewarded for completing the Demon Encounter zone daily.

※ You can spend Sweet Voucher to roll Amezaiku's roulette. Each rolling has a chance of receiving an exclusive skin, the realm's Higanbana Sea skin, the Starry Tunes Summon Room skin, Jade, and Skill Daruma shards among other rare items.

※ If you fail to obtain an exclusive skin, the realm's Higanbana Sea skin or the Starry Tunes summoning place skin in the first 14 rolls, you're guaranteed to receive an exclusive skin, the realm's Higanbana Sea skin or the Starry Tunes summoning place skin in the 15th roll (You won't receive the skin you already owned).

※ When the event is over, the remaining Sweet Vouchers will be removed. Please use them in time.

[h2]3. The Floral Passage Event[/h2]

※ Event duration:  March 10 - March 18 at 23:59 EST

※ Level requirement: Lv. 15

※ During the event, you will only need to spend a small amount of time on daily quests to increase the progress. SR shikigami Kamaitachi's event-exclusive Winning Hand skin can be obtained in 7 days!

※ Play a game of Hanafuda along the floral passage and you will draw a winning hand. May all your wishes come true. Good times await, masters.

[h2]4. Underworld Arena Event[/h2]

※ Event duration: 2:00 EST - 23:00 EST daily from March 14 - March 27

※ Level requirement: Lv. 15

※ During the event, you can access the Underworld Arena via the Jizo Statue in the Courtyard. Within the duration, battles in Underworld Arena from 11:00 to 14:00 and from 20:00 to 23:00 daily will be in 100-Player mode. The rest of the time will be in 16-Player mode.

※ Note: 

- The first 10 Underworld Arena challenges each week grant high-grade Realm Cards and Mystery Amulets among other rich rewards. From the 11th challenge onward, the arena only grants Coins as rewards. 

- Challenge attempts are shared between 100-Player mode and 16-Player mode.

- The 100-Player mode in Underworld Arena yields Underworld Arena Score in addition to the basic rewards. 

- Underworld Arena Scores are calculated each Monday. Rewards will be issued via in-game mail based on your tiers in Underworld Arena.

- The current highest tier of Underworld Arena is Tier 6. Underworld Arena Score and Duel Score share the same Score Rewards, which means the rewards will be issued based on the highest score reached in either zone. When you reach Tier 6 in Underworld Arena, you can receive the Underworld Arena frame which expires in a week.

- For more details, please check the event page.

[h2]5. 2,000 Day Login Achievement Available![/h2]

We still feel the same, even after all this time. The snow in the Courtyard has melted and the cherry blossoms are slowly blooming. 

※ Available: After maintenance on March 9

※ Players who have logged in for 2,000 days can claim the following gifts from the Achievements page:

- Exclusive Gift 1: Gilded Sanctuary Scene for the Soul Zones 
- Exclusive Gift 2: Yao Bikuni's new exclusive skin: Heart of the Sea 
- Exclusive Gift 3: Golden Sanctuary Exclusive Frame Set (including an animated frame, team page frame, Page frame, chat bubble, and Page skin), exclusive Golden Sanctuary nameplate
- Exclusive Gift 4: Samurai Daruma upgrade for once
- Exclusive Gift 5: Special Skin Voucher x 1
- Exclusive Gift 5: Sakuramochi sharing gift

Times moves slowly and our bond deepens. Thank you for your support and company over the years. May we travel together into the future and build a beautiful Heian World. 

[h2]6. Memory Summons Updated[/h2]

※ Summoning duration: After the maintenance on March 9 - March 22 at 23:59 EST

※ Chance Up shikigami including Valiant Yamakaze, Onikiri Reforged, Suzuka Gozen, Otakemaru, Susabi and Shishio.

※ Chance Up shikigami for the next update will include Seawatch Kingyo, Waverider Lord Arakawa, Enmusubi, Hakuzosu, Kaguya and Lord Arakawa.

※ For more details, please check the event page.

[h2]7. Paper Doll Skin Updated[/h2]

※ New Paper Doll Skins are available after the maintenance on March 9 - 23:59 EST on April 5

※ Added Shiranui, Kusa and True Red Paper Doll skins which can be purchased in Paper Doll Shrine > Collection.

[h2]8. FORTUNE! Discount and Free Refresh in Soul Shop[/h2]

※ Event duration: 0:00 EST on March 9 - 23:59 EST on March 15

※ Every day during the event, the first 10 purchases in the soul shop will have a 20% discount and the lineup can be refreshed 30 times for free.

[h1]Improvement[/h1]

1. Improvements of Underworld Arena:

※ Improved players' chances of seeing orb-granting shikigami in Underworld Arena drafts. Now, on the first round of drafting, the first shikigami is guaranteed to be a shikigami who can grant orbs.

※ Improved the pace of the Underworld Arena. Now, if a player stalls twice during the shikigami deployment stage, Auto Deploy will trigger in half the time for future deployments.

2. Fixed some incorrect answers in the Demon Quiz.

3. Improved the model size of Valiant Yamakaze's Frost Feathers skin on the Duel Deployment page.

4. Improved reminder pop-up setting for the Auto Rotation feature. When players are feeding the substitute shikigami, the option  'Don't prompt today' has been changed to 'Don't prompt'. 

Notes: 
- The tips will no longer pop up after ticking the option.
- Switching devices and accounts and redownloading the game will reset this setting.

[h1]Fixed Issue[/h1]

1. Fixed incorrect interactions between the Ninja Yamausagi's 'Ninja Scurrying Steps' and the Suzuka Gozen's 'Obligated Duty'.
2. Added missing mouth movements and animation effects on Valiant Yamakaze when he's equipped with his Frost Feathers skin in the Shikigami menu.

3. Corrected the Cos. Score granted by the Billowing Floret frame by increasing the points granted from 10 to 15.

4. Added missing effect when switching the SP shikigami Seawatch Kingyo's skin to Dawn Glory in the Shikigami menu.

5. Fixed an issue in Guild Feast where Auto Preparation was configured, but the setting wasn't applied in some scenarios.

6. Fixed an issue in Fellowship Sakuramochi deposit where the slider could be dragged beyond the max limit in some scenarios.

7. Fixed issue on Soul Profiles where incorrect data prevented some of the profiles from displaying in the profile list.

8. Fixed incorrect description for the SSR shikigami Enmusubi's Shelter effect on the Simplified Battlefield Display page in battles.

9. Fixed display error for chat bubbles when a large image was sent.

10. Fixed issue on Buddies' Co-op Shikigami when they're deployed in the Ultimate Orochi zone.

11. Fixed issue on the model of the SSR shikigami Suzuhikohime's post-evolution skin where it wasn't moving after being switched to display in the Courtyard.

notes.title: Updates on Mar 2,2022
notes.content:
[h1]Update Announcement[/h1]
 
Dear Onmyoji,
 
In order to bring you a better gaming experience, the server will be shut down for maintenance from 2:00 - 4:00 EST on Mar 2. If it is not completed on time, the opening time will be postponed. For details regarding the update, please check the update announcement which will be posted later, or the game login page after the maintenance.
 
During the maintenance period, you will not be able to access the game from the server. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. Thank you for your support and understanding!
 
[h1]Important Updates[/h1]
 
[h2]1. Chiming Thoughts Event[/h2]

Bells chime loud with prayers and thoughts. Friends have gathered on the vast snowfield around the bonfire to listen to each other's stories.

Give Suzuhikohime Soulblades and she will give you Bells in return as rewards. 

When you give her a certain number of Soulblades, she will give you Chime Souls which can be exchanged for more rewards.

※ Event duration: After the maintenance on March 2 - 23:59 EST on March 15

※ Access portals: Jizo Statue and the Paper Doll in the Courtyard

※ Soulblades can be obtained by gaining 100 Talisman EXP via daily quests in Talisman Pass, challenging Demon Encounter bosses, and purchasing packs.

※ When all 24 bells are open, you can claim additional Chime Soul. When you open 24 bells for the first time, you can claim the event exclusive Chiming Thoughts frame.

※ Chime Soul can be exchanged for rare rewards in Snow Castle. Rewards include the event exclusive animated Burning Thoughts frame, Susabi's Golden Shrine skin, Courtyard's Melodic Pavilion skin, Courtyard's Hot Spring skin, and the Pavilion of Songs frame.

※ For more event rules, please head to the event page.

[h2]2. Paper Doll Wishes Event[/h2]

Come and make your Paper Dolls and enjoy the Anniversary alongside your shikigami!

※ Event duration: After the maintenance on March 2 - 23:59 EST on March 11

※ Level requirement: Lv. 15

[h3]【Making Paper Dolls】[/h3]

※ You will receive 2 Dream Papers daily. Customize your cute Paper Dolls with your unlocked elements. You can purchase more Dream Papers to make more Paper Dolls, up to 5 Dream Papers daily.

※ Each day, a Paper Doll will send you new elements and blessings. Paper Doll elements can also be obtained from Blessed Wish quests.

[h3]【Visiting Friends and Sending Paper Dolls】[/h3]

※ Visit the Wish Room of a friend/shikigami to view their Paper Dolls and blessings. 

※ After a Paper Doll is made, you can visit Wish Rooms belonging to friends or shikigami/onmyoji and dispatch your Paper Dolls to send them blessings!

※ A dispatched Paper Doll will gift a copy of itself to the receiver. Each player or shikigami/onmyoji can receive gifts this way up to 20 times daily.

※ Each day, the first Paper Doll to arrive at a Wish Room will be displayed in the receiver's Wish Room!

[h3]【Paper Wishes】[/h3]

※ Make and Send Paper Dolls, and collect Talisman Pass EXP to gain Blessed Wishes. 

※ You will receive rewards from Paper Dolls after collecting enough Blessed Wishes as well as the ultimate reward – Paper Dream Letter.

※ Paper Dream Letter can be exchanged for any 1 paper doll in the Wish Room as the exclusive Paper Doll Shrine skin.

※ Paper Dream Letter available: March 12 - March 18 at 23:59 EST

※ Please note that the Paper Doll skin obtained with the Paper Dream Letter cannot be applied to Fellowship Paper Dolls.

※ Players who have at least one Paper Doll by the end of the event will trigger the Paper Doll's surprise when entering the event from March 12 – March 18 at 23:59 EST. Don't miss out!

[h2]3. Realm Summons with Chance Up Bonus[/h2]

※ Event duration: After the maintenance on March 2 - March 13 at 23:59 EST

※ During the event, purchase the Realm Summoning pack to create a team or spend Jades to join others' team. The summonable SP/SSR shikigami will be defined by the daily selections.

※ The SP Inaba Kaguya will be added to the shikigami pool.

※ Exclusive benefit: Selected shikigami Chance Up: 

- During the event, each player can choose one shikigami for the Chance Up bonus from the daily selection. Shikigami summoned via the Leader's special benefit will also enjoy this Chance Up bonus. The bonus will expire when the selected shikigami is summoned.

- The selected shikigami can be changed anytime. During the event, when an SP/SSR is summoned, the chance of it being the selected SSR will increase from the initial 25% to 100% for 400 summons; The chance of it being the selected SP shikigami will increase from the initial 15% to 100% for 400 summons.

- When the daily selection refreshes, you will need to select a shikigami for the Chance Up bonus again. This won't reset the summons made.

※ For the detailed rules and shikigami selections of each day, please check the event page when the event is available.

[h2]4. Talisman Pass (March)[/h2]

※ Event duration: After the maintenance on March 2 - maintenance on April 6

※ You can complete different missions to increase the Talisman level.

※ As the Talisman level increases, Onmyoji can obtain various rewards including the exclusive frame.

※ Purchase the Deluxe Talisman to unlock bonus rewards such as the exclusive animated frame, an exclusive illustration and Suzuka Gozen's Supreme Season skin!

※ Updated Legacy Talisman and related shop:

- You can purchase Legacy Talisman from the Talisman Pass - Shop page. Upon purchase, each Talisman Pass level you reached grants you a Talisman Coin. Each Talisman Pass grants up to 50 Talisman Coins.

- Talisman Coins can be used to purchase month-related skins from previous Talisman Passes. Spend Talisman Coins to purchase the Kidomaru's return skin - Ashen Rain, Menreiki 's return skin - Opera Masks and the Legacy Box for the current Talisman Pass.

[h2]5. Good luck doesn't wait! - Selectable Soul Drop Event[/h2]

Not enough souls to get your Shikigami fully equipped? No worries, the Soul drop event is coming this weekend!

※ Event Duration: March 5 at 0:00 EST - March 6 at 23:59 EST

- During this event, you can choose the type of souls that drop in the Soul Zone.

- You can choose 4 types of souls. The same soul cannot be chosen more than once in any lineup. After you have selected a lineup, you can edit it at any time for free.

- Your selected lineup will be in effect for the first 200 challenges each day. After this, the soul lineup will return to normal.

[h1]Improvement[/h1]

1. External Chat Channel available for steam version: You can tap the icon at the bottom right of the Chat channel to switch between Internal/External Chat Channel.

[h1]Fixed Issue[/h1]

Fixed language and technical bugs.

notes.title: Onmyoji Guardian! | Updates on December 18th
notes.content:
Dear Onmyoji,
 
In order to bring you a better gaming experience, the server will be shut down for maintenance [b]from 2:00 - 6:00 EST on Dec 18th[/b]. If it is not completed on time, the opening time will be postponed. For details regarding the update, please check the update announcement which will be posted later, or the game login page after the maintenance.
 
During the maintenance period, you will not be able to access the game from the server. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. Thank you for your support and understanding!
 
Important Updates
 
1.    Onmyoji Guardian
 
After the battle of Land vs Sea, the armies of Sealand has been forced to retreat. In the meantime, Seimei has called upon the three largest Onmyoji clans to have a meeting, and have decided to utilize the power of Ungaikyo to strengthen the defenses of Kyoto, to defend against the next wave of attack.
 
Dear Onmyoji, please help Seimei and his party to set up the defense realm!
 
How to participate:
 
- Event time: After the update on December 18th - December 29th, 23:59 EST
 
- During the event, players of level 15 or above can tap on the Ungaikyo in the courtyard to access the event map.
 
Event details:
 
- The story of "Onmyoji Guardian" consists of a total of 7 chapters, with a new chapter being unlocked per day. Players can revisit chapters that they have cleared on the event page, as well as Onikiri's memories.
 
- The realm of Kyoto will be unlocked as the story progresses. The three clans will cooperate to fix the realm as soon as possible. Deploying Shikigami will help speed up the repair process, and the player will earn rewards and contributions in exchange.
 
- During the event, players can participate in "purification" by exploring Kyoto's surroundings and help to purify and to cleanse the demon force to receive rewards. When exploring, players move forward on a fixed route, with a chance to encounter events such as facing demon force, receiving help to move forward faster or discover treasures.
 
- Aside from "purification", players can proceed to the realm and accept challenges. The rules of the realm are basically the same as "purification", and players have a chance to obtain random buffs that are exclusive to this mode and the realm boss at the end.
 
- Clearing "Purification" mode for a number of times and players will earn the right to challenge the Sealand Boss! Defeat the Sealand boss within the time limit for the first time to earn rewards!
 
Event Rewards:
 
- Participate in the event to earn rewards and exclusive event tokens "Spiritual Orb" and "Guardian Coins". Spiritual Orb can be used to redeem various items from the event shop, while Guardian Coins can be used to redeem "Boss Challenge Blessings". Stack up on "Boss Challenge Blessings" for a better advantage when challenging the Sealand Boss.
 
- The event shop will be closed on January 5th, 23:59 EST. After the event shop closes, unused Spiritual Orb and Guardian Coins will disappear.
 
For more details please refer to the instructions with the event page.
 
Dear Onmyoji, let us protect Heian-Kyo together!
 
2.    SP Onikiri Reforged Summon Event!
 
SP Onikiri Reforged (VA: Mitsuki Saiga) has arrived in Heian-Kyo! Various summon events will be held to welcome this new Shikigami!
 
Summon Period: After the update on December 18th – December 30th, 23:59 EST
 
【All SP/SSR Shikigami chance up】
 
- During the event, the appearance rate for SP/SSR Shikigami will be 2.5 times the normal rate. The summon rate will revert to the normal rate after the player successfully summons 3 SP/SSR Shikigami.
 
【SP Onikiri Reforged chance up】
 
- During the event, when summoning using Mystery Amulets, Jade, or AR Amulets, the rate to obtain SP Onikiri Reforged when an SP/SSR Shikigami appears will increase according to the number of times summon is performed! Please note that after SP Onikiri Reforged is summoned, players can no longer benefit from the rate up for SP Onikiri Reforged.
 
- For players who have completed their SSR collection before the update on December 18th, the appearance rate for SP Onikiri Reforged when an SP/SSR Shikigami is summoned will initially be 10%, and will continue to increase as the players continue to summon, ultimately reaching 100% at 500 summons.
 
- For other players, the appearance rate for SP Onikiri Reforged when an SP/SSR Shikigami is summoned will continually increase from 3%, up to a maximum of 15% when the player has performed 500 summons.
 
【Stage Rewards】
 
- During the event, summon using Mystery Amulets, Jade, or AR Amulets a specific amount of times to receive the corresponding stage rewards, including Mystery Amulets, Skill Daruma, Skin Tokens, Jade, “SR Choice” etc.
 
【Special Summon Bonus】
 
1. For players who have completed their SSR collection before the update on December 18th:
 
- During the event, if the player performs 699 summons but did not obtain SP Onikiri Reforged, SP Onikiri Reforged will appear on the 700th summon and a surprise pack will be presented to the player as a reward. Please note that after SP Onikiri Reforged is summoned using this method, the player can no longer benefit from the rate up for SP Onikiri Reforged.
 
2. For players who have not completed their SSR collection before the update on December 18th: When players summon for the 700th time during the event, the rate to obtain SP Onikiri Reforged when an SP/SSR Shikigami appears will be further increased by 10%, up to a total of 25% (In addition to the 15% from " SP Onikiri Reforged chance up").
 
Note:
 
- The summon events above only apply to players who are lvl 15 or higher.
 
- Only Shikigami that are lit up in the SSR Shikigami Collection will be counted for completion. (Ryomen and Crossover Characters excluded)
 
3.    SP Onikiri Reforged Memory Scroll Event!
 
After the update on December 18th – January 7th 23:59 EST
 
How to play:
 
- Players can obtain scroll shards by participating in various activities in the game.
 
- Donate scroll shards to help repair the memory scrolls. Players will obtain a random reward for every donation.
 
- After a memory scroll has been fully repaired, players will receive corresponding rewards according to their donation ranking.
 
- For each memory scroll, players rank 200 or higher will receive SP Onikiri Reforged shards. Players rank 500 or higher will receive the “Flaming Onikiri" Frame.
 
- After all memory scrolls have been repaired, players can no longer obtain or donate scroll shards.
 
4.    Atop the Peak
 
Climb atop and earn rewards!
 
Event period: After the update on December 18th - December 30th, 23:59 EST
 
- All players who purchase the "Atop the Peak event pack" will be counted towards the number of climbing players
 
- When the number of players reaches the Stone Tablet and Torii, all players who are level 15 or above that have purchased the pack will be able to claim plenty of rewards.
 
- When the number of players reaches the Top, all players who purchased the pack can claim extra Furoshiki rewards.
 
Note: Items in the event pack include Oitsuki's "Moonlit Sea frame".
 
5.    Decorate Christmas Tree Event
 
Christmas is coming! It's time to decorate a Christmas tree in the Courtyard!
 
Event Period: After the update on December 18th - December 30th, 23:59 EST
 
How to participate: During the event, you can obtain points in the following ways:
 
- Purchase a daily-limited Christmas pack (Xmas Tree Pack I II or III, purchasable up to 5 packs) to receive 30 points.
 
- Receive 9 points each time you summon using a Mystery Amulet, AR Amulet, or Jade.
 
- Each victory in the Exploration Zone gains you 3 point.
 
- Each victory in the Evo Zone gains you 6 points.
 
- Each victory in the Soul Zone gains you 6 points.
 
- Each Realm Raid victory gains you 6 points.
 
The points can be exchanged for decorations including Christmas Daruma, Christmas Lucky Bag, Christmas Bell, Christmas Box, Gingerbread, and Christmas Candy.
 
- Each time you attach these decorations onto the Christmas tree, you will receive a random reward.
 
- When you use up all the decorations given, you will receive a Christmas gift that can be opened from Christmas Eve (Dec. 24th 21:00 EST) until the end of the event!
 
- The more people finished decorating the Christmas tree, the more rewards you will get!
 
- When 2,000, 5,000, or 10,000 people on the server finished decorating the tree, everyone who participated in the event (using at least one decoration) will receive the corresponding rewards.
 
For more details please refer to the instructions with the event page.
 
Note:
 
- The unused event points will be voided when the event ends, so please claim the rewards in time！
 
6.    7-day Christmas Login Bonus！
 
Event Period: After the update on December 18th - December 30th, 23:59 EST
 
During the event period, players can obtain 1 mystery amulet daily by simply logging in the game, players can gain at most 7 mystery amulets from this event! Onmyoji, Merry Christmas in Heian-Kyo!
 
Note: Players have to reach at least lv.10 and finish all the Tutorial Quests to participate in this event.
 
Fixed Issues
1. Fixed language and technical bugs.

notes.content:
Dear Onmyoji,
 
In order to bring you a better gaming experience, the server will be shut down for maintenance [b]from 2:00 - 6:00 EST on Nov 27th[/b]. If it is not completed on time, the opening time will be postponed. For details regarding the update, please check the update announcement which will be posted later, or the game login page after the maintenance.
 
During the maintenance period, you will not be able to access the game from the server. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. Thank you for your support and understanding!
 
[h1]Important Updates[/h1]
 
[h1]1.    LBS Boss for Thanksgiving Day![/h1]
 
Dear Onmyoji, Thanksgiving Day is coming! Let's team up and challenge Miketsu for rich rewards!
 
Time: November 28th, 0:00 - November 28th, 23:59 EST
 
How to play:
 
- During the event, players can challenge Miketsu, the Thanksgiving Boss in Fushimi Inari-taisha.
 
- When the event is available, each player has initial attempts to start a challenge or join a team.
 
- Every hour attempt is recovered. Challenge the boss for rich rewards and the chance to receive surprise rewards including rare avatar frames, AR Amulet, Special Realm Card etc.
 
Note: During the event, players who are level 12 or above can challenge the Thanksgiving boss!
 
[h1]2.    Showdown Bidding![/h1]
 
The Showdown Bidding will once again open! Think you know your Shikigami well? Place a bet on these exciting battles!
 
Tap on Jikikaeru in Town to bet on a team!
 
Event period: November 27th, 11:00 – November 30th, 23:00 EST
 
The deadline for claiming your rewards is December 3rd 23:00 EST.
 
Remember to collect all of your rewards before the deadline, as the event interface will not be accessible after the event ends.
 
[h1]3.    Daruma Wish[/h1]
 
Running out of Daruma to upgrade your Shikigami? Don't worry! The Daruma Wish event is on the way!
 
Event Period: After the update on November 27th - December 10th, 23:59 EST
 
How to play:
 
During the event, players who clear Soul Zones, Evo Zones or Wanted Quests will have a chance to obtain different types of Daruma Cards:
 
- Soul Zone: Red Daruma Card
- Evo Zone: White Daruma Card
- Wanted Quest: Black Daruma Card
 
Spend Daruma cards to redeem the corresponding Daruma!
 
Note: Daruma cards are only valid during this event, and will become void once the event ends.
 
[h1]4.    Shopkeeper's Benefit[/h1]
 
Shopkeeper is giving out discount vouchers! Get the discount vouchers and check out the Pack Shop!
 
Event period: November 28th 0:00 - November 30th 23:59 EST During the event, players can obtain a random pack shop discount voucher every day!
 
Note:
 
- Every day during the event, players will have a maximum of 3 chances to draw a discount voucher. The discount voucher with the biggest discount drawn for that day will be awarded to the player.
 
- The Discount Voucher will be available for 7 days. It can be applied to all packs which can be purchased using S-Jade.
 
[h1]5.    Black Friday Packs On Sale！[/h1]
 
During the period from November 28th 0:00 to November 29th 23:59 EST, Black Friday Special packs are available in store! Dont’t miss out!

[h1]6.    Ritual Flame[/h1]
 
As night falls upon the Ominous Land, the fox fire emits a dim glow, spreading with the blowing wind, and illuminating the darkness.
 
After the update on November 27th, SP Blazing Tamamonomae’s new skin “Ritual Flame” will be added to the Skin Shop with a 20% discount for the first two weeks!
 
[h1]7.    Deadly Cyan[/h1]
 
This little girl was once adored by her parents, and used to love to eat stir-fried beef and perilla leaves. But she has undergone an enormous transformation.
 
Blood has become her only source of sustenance. She now feeds on the blood of her prey as she desires, and will not stop until her purple garment is dyed in red.
 
The new skin of Vampira “Deadly Cyan” will be available after the maintenance on November 27th. Plus, it will be 20% off during the first two weeks!

1. Improved the way tagging works in the chat channel.
 
2. Improved the text and voiceover of Demoniac Shuten Doji's bio.
 
Fixed Issues
 
1. Fixed the issue of occasional glitches in the shikigami cards' dynamic effects when a Special skin is selected.
 
2. Fixed the issue where trying to switch from purchasing skins to gifting skins may not let the player switch to the skin they want to gift.

notes.title: War of Mt. Oe continues! | Updates on November 20th
notes.content:
Dear Onmyoji,
 
In order to bring you a better gaming experience, the server will be shut down for maintenance [b]from 2:00 - 6:00 EST on Nov 20th[/b]. If it is not completed on time, the opening time will be postponed. For details regarding the update, please check the update announcement which will be posted later, or the game login page after the maintenance.
 
During the maintenance period, you will not be able to access the game from the server. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. Thank you for your support and understanding!
 
[h1]Important Updates[/h1]
 
[h1]1.    War of Mt. Oe continues![/h1]
 
- The battle in Demon Throne Showdown grows fierce. Shuten Doji regains his true power, and completely awakens.
 
- As the war progresses, the Sealand army is gradually weakening. Onmyoji, the buff for the Sealand army, “Sealand Tenacity” will disappear after maintenance. It’s time to turn the tables！

[h1]2.    SP Demoniac Shuten Doji Summon Event![/h1]
 
SP Demoniac Shuten Doji (VA: Shuhei Sakaguchi) and SR Shikigami Hoshiguma Doji (VA: Yuki Kaji) are coming to Heian-Kyo! To welcome the two new Shikigami, we are holding summon events!
 
Please note that the summon events will start after Otakemaru's HP in the ”Demon Throne Showdown” event drops below 50%, and will last until November 30th at 23:59 EST
 
【Defeat Bonus and Summon events】
 
When Otakemaru’s HP in the ”Demon Throne Showdown” event drops below 90%/70%/50%, players will receive Mystery Amulets as rewards.
 
The summon event starts after Otakemaru’s HP drops below 50%.
 
【All SP/SSR Shikigami chance up】
 
- During the event, the appearance rate for SP/SSR Shikigami will be 2.5 times the normal rate. The summon rate will revert to the normal rate after the player successfully summons 3 SP/SSR Shikigami.
 
【SP Demoniac Shuten Doji chance up】
 
- During the event, when summoning using Mystery Amulets, Jade, or AR Amulets, the rate to obtain SP Demoniac Shuten Doji when an SP/SSR Shikigami appears will increase according to the number of times summon is performed!
 
- For players who have completed their SSR collection before the update on November 20th, the appearance rate for SP Demoniac Shuten Doji when an SP/SSR Shikigami is summoned will initially be 10%, and will continue to increase as the players continue to summon, ultimately reaching 100% at 500 summons.
 
- For other players, the appearance rate for SP Demoniac Shuten Doji when an SP/SSR Shikigami is summoned will continually increase from 3%, up to a maximum of 15% when the player has performed 500 summons.
 
【Gift from Hoshiguma Doji】
 
During the event, summon using Mystery Amulets, Jade, or AR Amulets 100 times to obtain the new SR Shikigami Hoshiguma Doji.
 
【Stage Rewards】
 
- During the event, summon using Mystery Amulets, Jade, or AR Amulets a specific amount of times to receive the corresponding stage rewards, including Mystery Amulets, Skill Daruma, Skin Tokens, Jade, “SR Choice” etc.
 
Notes:
 
The summon events above only apply to players who are lvl 15 or higher.
 
To provide a better experience to players who have performed summons many times, an additional summon bonus will be added to this summon event:
 
1. For players who have completed their SSR collection before the update:
 
- During the event, if the player performs 699 summons but did not obtain SP Demoniac Shuten Doji, SP Demoniac Shuten Doji will appear on the 700th summon and a surprise pack will be presented to the player as a reward.
 
- This summon does not apply to players who obtained SP Demoniac Shuten Doji before the 700th summon.
 
- This summon counts towards the "SP Demoniac Shuten Doji chance up".
 
2. For players who have not completed their SSR collection before the update:
 
- When players summon for the 700th time during the event, the rate to obtain SP Demoniac Shuten Doji when an SP/SSR Shikigami appears will be further increased by 10%, up to a total of 25% (In addition to the 15% from "SP Demoniac Shuten Doji chance up").
 
- Only Shikigami that are lit up in the SSR Shikigami Collection will be counted for completion. (Ryomen and Crossover Characters excluded)
 
[h1]3.    SP Demoniac Shuten Doji Memory Scroll Event![/h1]
 
The event will start after Otakemaru's HP in Demon Throne Showdown drops below 50%, and will last until December 11th at 23:59 EST
 
How to play:
 
- The memory scroll of SP Demoniac Shuten Doji consists of 6 chapters, each chapter needs to be repaired separately. The ranking rewards are also individually calculated for each chapter.
 
Rewards:
 
- Players will obtain a random reward every time they donate a scroll shard.
 
- Players will earn rewards according to their donation ranking, those with the top rankings will receive SP Demoniac Shuten Doji shards, the “Blazin' Drink Frame" animated frame, Skill Daruma and more!
 
The array of the five-point star descends, amulets fly through the air, flames rain down, and there is a flash of golden light, as a large figure emerges from within...
 
Onmyoji, prepare for the return of the demon king!
 
[h1]4.    Atop the Peak[/h1]
 
Time: After the update on November 20th - December 3th 23:59 EST
 
How to play:
 
-All players who purchased the Atop the Peak event pack will be counted towards the Climbing Players.
 
-The more Climbing Players there are, the higher Seimei would reach in the event page.
 
-When reaching special spots along the mountain, all players (≥15 levels) will receive rich rewards including mystery amulets and etc.
 
-When reaching the peak, all players who purchased the pack can claim extra Furoshiki rewards.
 
[h1]5.    Fortune Temple[/h1]
 
Fortune Temple is back! Onmyoji, receive a blessing from the Fortune Temple by redeeming items!
 
Event Time: After the update on November 20th - November 26th 23:59 EST
 
Note:
 
1. During the event, players can exchange coins, jade, medals, etc. for other items in the Fortune Temple.
 
2. Each item can only be purchased once per day, resetting at 0:00 EST.
 
3. The lineup will refresh every day.
 
[h1]6.    Coin Chaos![/h1]
 
Complete missions to obtain coins!
 
Time: After the update on November 20th - December 3th 23:59 EST
 
During the event, players can obtain coins by completing the following missions:
 
- Summon 3 times with Mystery Amulets, AR Amulets or Jade
- Complete Daily Quests
- Participate in 5 Duels
 
Note: The missions reset daily at 0:00 EST, and any unclaimed rewards will be lost. So please remember to claim your rewards before they disappear!
 
[h1]Fixed Issues[/h1]
 
Fixed language and technical bugs

notes.title: Frost Summon event! | Updates on November 13th
notes.content:
Dear Onmyoji,
 
In order to bring you a better gaming experience, the server will be shut down for maintenance [b]from 2:00 - 6:00 EST on Nov 13th[/b]. If it is not completed on time, the opening time will be postponed. For details regarding the update, please check the update announcement which will be posted later, or the game login page after the maintenance.
 
During the maintenance period, you will not be able to access the game from the server. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. Thank you for your support and understanding!

[h1]Important Updates[/h1]

[h1]1. War of Mount. Oe[/h1]
The fire of vengeance, conviction and death are flowing under the tidal wave. The sad songs of fate are ushered in a strong chapter. Different forces have been involved in the fight. Strategists and warriors have been gathered in Mt. Oe.
After the update on November 13th, War of Mount. Oe will begin.
The first phase of this epic battle will begin after the update on November 13th, and will last until November 18th, 23:59 EST.
During this period, players can challenge "Sealand Defense" by tapping on the Minamoto Clan or the Demonship, and enter the "Asura Battlefield".
Also during this period, players can participate in "Battle of Armies" between 9:00- 12:00 and 20:00 - 23:00 EST of each day.
※The event will enter the "Demon Throne Showdown" phase on November 19th.
※During the event, players can rewatch the story by tapping on "battle reports" → "battle results" and selecting the story segment they wish to watch.
※There will be pickets monitoring the battlefield out of battle time.
Event details:
【Asura Battlefield】:
- There are 4 difficulty levels in "Asura Battlefield". Clearing different levels will reward the player with different "Forging Materials".
- "Forging Materials" can be used in "Minamoto Armory" to upgrade weapons or refresh the stats of weapons. They can be used to support allies in "Battle of Armies" as well.
- Players can also obtain Karatamba Sake, Souls, Evo materials, etc. by challenging Asura Battlefield.
- Players can redeem various items by using Karatamba Sake in the Mt. Oe Treasury.
【Sealand Defense】：
- Battles have a time limit of 3 minutes, and will end when the time is up or the player's team is defeated.
- After the battle, players will receive a score based on their performance.
- The highest score achieved each day will be added to the player's total score for the event, and rewards will be presented to players based on their Score Ranking after the event.
【Battle of Armies】：
- During the event, not only can players attack the enemy, but also support their allies by using "Forging Materials".
- Also, players can complete "strategic objectives" to increase the damage dealt by all players during the "Demon Throne Showdown" phase. Players who have participated in the battle will also be randomly chosen to receive additional rewards.
【Demon Throne Showdown】：
Challenge Time: From November 19th, 0:00 until all of Otakemaru's generals have been defeated.
- The damage dealt by players will increase according to the number of "strategic objectives" completed during the first phase.
- The battle lasts 5 minutes and ends when the time is up or the player's team is defeated. After the battle, players will receive a score based on their performance, as well as "Karatamba Sake". The score achieved during this phase will not be counted towards the ranking.
- When Otakemaru's HP drops below 50%, Demoniac Shuten Doji will join the battle and fight alongside the player. After this, Demoniac Shuten Doji will become available through summoning!
- When Otakemaru's HP drops below 10% for the first time, Otakemaru will enter Furious rage. If players can defeat all of his generals within 120 minutes, all players will receive a special frame "Demon Throne Showdown" as a reward. However, if players fail to defeat the enemies in time, Otakemaru will trigger the power of "Jade of Yasakani" and his HP will recover to the 10% mark.
- Once Otakemaru has triggered the power of "Jade of Yasakani" once, it will no longer trigger. However, even if players defeat Otakemaru after this, they will not receive the special frame.
Onmyoji, please stand together with the armies of Mt. Oe and the Minamoto clan to fend off Otakemaru's Sealand army!
Note: After the battle with Otakemaru has ended, players will still be able to access the event page to redeem rewards up until November 26th, 23:59 EST. Please remember to claim your rewards by then!

[h1]2. Frost Summon event![/h1]
We have scheduled a summon event for the arrival of the new SR Shikigami Kamimai (VA: Sumire Uesaka) !
Event time: After the update on November 13th - November 19th, 23:59 EST
During the event, when summoning with Jade, Mystery Amulets or AR Amulets, if an SR Shikigami is summoned, the chances of Kamimai appearing will increase to 25%! (The increase only applies for the first 5 SR Shikigami.)
Note: This event only applies to all Onmyoji of level 15 or above.

[h1]3. Ebisu's Boutique[/h1]
Event period: After the update on November 13th - December 3th 23:59 EST
Event details:
- During the event, players can obtain Ebisu's Fortune Shop exclusive frame "Dazzling Gold" by recharging in the game. Players will have a chance to obtain this exclusive frame again during future Ebisu's Boutique events. And if players receive the frame more than once, the frame will be upgraded!
- Recharge to certain amounts to receive the "Moonlight" courtyard skin, Seimei's "Dark Seimei" skin and more!
- Players who have already received the rewards will be compensated as shown below.
Surplus "Moonlight" Courtyard skin →　1000 Jade
Surplus Seimei's "Dark Seimei" skin　→　"Lord of Kyoto" frame
Surplus "Lord of Kyoto" frame　→　"Lord of Kyoto" frame (Gold Daruma version)
Surplus "Lord of Kyoto" frame (Gold Daruma version)　→　the right to enter the Boutique, and 2 Boutique talismans instead!

[h1]4. Drunken Melody[/h1]
"My blood is boiling for battle. As the most powerful demon, my limit is the sky! "
After the update on November 13th, Shuten Doji's new special skin "Drunken Melody" will be available in the Skin Store. The new special skin will be sold with a 40% discount, selling for only 126 s-jades for the first two weeks.
After the maintenance on November 27th, the selling price will get back to 210 s-jades.
The skin "Drunken Melody" features the following:
New actions and skill effects
Exclusive frame
Exclusive voice and sound effects

[h1]5. New Accessories and Skill-casting Effects added![/h1]
※ Added new bio stories to some of the shikigamis. Updated in this patch: Ibaraki Doji, Onikiri, Shuten Doji, Yamakaze, Yuki, Yoto Hime, and Ichimokuren... More fascinating shikigami stories are being brewed up. Stay tuned.
※ When players unlock shikigamis' new bios, they will also unlock new Accessories/Skill-casting Effects. Players can freely change the look of their shikigami by changing their weapons and accessories, and change the display actions of their shikigami by changing their Skill-casting Effects. More features will become available in the future.
※ Unlocking new bios require players to raise their Affection level with their shikigami. Send gifts on the Bios page to add Affection points. New bios will be unlocked when the Affection requirements are met.　
※ Ryomen's Thunder Daredevil skin, Yamakaze's Blazin' Will skin, and Susabi's Summer Night Sky skin and Golden Shrine skin now support Accessories and Skill-casting Effects.
　
※ Accessories are not yet supported for Ibaraki Doji's Winter Bamboo skin and Hellfire Warlord skin, Shuten Doji's Drunken Melody skin, and Onikiri's Flaming Banner skin. The Accessories will be added in later updates.

[h1]6. Maple Dance[/h1]
The maple forest is aflame with the colors of autumn, while a gentle breeze creates a beautiful melody. Stepping through the rustling fallen leaves, the slender figure of a woman slowly fades away in this world of red and yellow.
After the update on November 13th, Momiji's new skin "Maple Dance" will be added to the lineup in the Skin Store, with a 20% off discount during the first two weeks!

[h1]7. Martyr Warrioress[/h1]
A shrill wail suddenly breaks the silence, and in the darkness the ghost fires emit a dim glow.
Wrapped up in bandages, the lady in purple holds a blade in hand, standing in this forgotten place.
The lives of all those that dare draw near shall be extinguished…
After the update on November 13th, Hone Onna's new skin "Martyr Warrioress" will be added to the lineup in the Skin Store, with a 20% off discount during the first two weeks.
Improvements
1. Iterated the display style of the top-page resource bar to make them look consistent across pages.
2. Improved players experience when they review stories via Retrospect. Players will no longer return to the main page when they complete a chapter, they will now return to the scroll page.
3. Improved the position of the Soul details window, which is prompted when tapping on a Soul on the left in the Soul Feed page, thus preventing it from blocking other Souls.
4. Changed the color of Co-op Quests in the Wanted Quests page to red.
5. Added a second confirmation to the Request All option to the join guild request function to prevent players from accidentally operating it.
6. Added a progress display to Login: Blessing achievement series.
7. Corrected the incorrect text in the claiming window that pops up when players claim the free Soul Bonus and Evo Bonus granted on weekends.

[h1]Fixed Issues[/h1]
1. Fixed the display error on the Mentor reservation page in Mentor's Guidance.
2. Fixed the issue where players cannot complete Accompany quests if they didn't open the Group Quests page on the day they joined a new guild.
3. Fixed the issue where Shiranui can sometimes be KO'd immediately when she takes lethal damage, without entering her Silhouette of Sorrow state.
4. Fixed the issue when Shiranui is in her Silhouette of Sorrow state where she can deal damage to units protected by Seimei's Spell: Protect.
5. Fixed the issue on multiple shikigami, namely Otakemaru and Hannya, where their follow-up normal attacks granted by Blazing Sky field are aimed at a new target.
6. Fixed the rare issue where a Blade Prison is not ended early when the only unit a player has is a unit Banished by Unlimited Blade Prison.
7. Fixed the issue when multiple Otakemaru are in a lineup in Co-op Duel where they can use the Unlimited Blade Prison skill respectively.
8. Fixed a bug regarding Azurestorm Ichimokuren's Wind Amulet: Shield where the skill cooldown is triggered even when Azurestorm Ichimokuren failed to use Wind Shield due to being under a controlling effect.
9. Fixed the occasional display error of the default minimized prompt that appears when players are queuing.
10. Fixed the issue where the Friends donation sub-page is not timely refreshed when players switch to the page to view their donation record in the guild Wish page.
11. Increased the Duel Reserve Lineup capacity from 50 to 100. Fixed the issue where some grade 6 shikigami are listed at the bottom of the selection area on the left.
12. Fixed the issue where the players' avatar frames are sometimes obscured on the Page screen.

notes.title: Halloween Boss Ibaraki Doji! | Updates on October 30th
notes.content:
Dear Onmyoji,

In order to bring you a better gaming experience, the server will be shut down for maintenance [b]from 2:00 - 6:00 EST on Oct 30th[/b]. If it is not completed on time, the opening time will be postponed. For details regarding the update, please check the update announcement which will be posted later, or the game login page after the maintenance.

During the maintenance period, you will not be able to access the game from the server. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. Thank you for your support and understanding!

Important Updates

[h1]1. Onmyoji and Ibuki[/h1]

"Meow~~ 

Onmyoji, quickly take this ball away from me. 

Huh? What do you mean, 'Why am I doing here?' 

Foolish Onmyoji, feed me some dried fish and I'll consider answering your question. Meow!" 

Event period: After the maintenance on October 30th – November 22nd 23:59 EST 

How to play: Complete various quests to obtain bells and increase intimacy with Ibuki.

Rewards: When the intimacy with Ibuki reaches certain levels, players can receive various rewards, including Skill Daruma, Mystery Amulet, SP Skin token, frames and more！！ 

[h1]2. Halloween Boss Ibaraki Doji![/h1]

Dear Onmyoji, team up and challenge the Halloween Boss Ibaraki Doji! 

Time: October 31st 2:00 - November 1st 22:00 EST 

How to play: 

- During the event, players can challenge Ibaraki Doji, the Halloween Boss in Mount Ooe. 

- When the event is available, each player has initial attempts to start a challenge or join a team. 

- Every hour attempt is recovered. Challenge the boss for rich rewards and the chance to receive surprise rewards including rare avatar frames, AR Amulet, Special Realm Card etc. 

Note: Players have to reach lv.12 to take part in this event.

[h1]3. Halloween Demon Parade[/h1]

Event Time: After maintenance on October 30th - 23:59 on November 4th 

How to play:

- During the event, pumpkin paper dolls will appear in Demon Parades. 

- Random SR shards or SP/SSR shards can be obtained by successfully hitting the pumpkin paper dolls. 

Note: It is effective only for the first five times each day.

[h1]4. Rainbow Dream[/h1]

On this day of celebration, the street where the festival is held is filled with laughter and joy. 

There is a stall with all manner of weird and funny masks, and a stall that sells delicacies and delicious festival food... 

As Hakuzosu walks pass the numerous stalls, he can no longer withhold his excitement, wanting to join in the fun! 

After the update on October 30th, Hakuzosu's new skin "Rainbow Dream" will be added to the store, with a 20% discount for the first week!

[h1]5. Bamboo Wishes[/h1]

Moonlight shines through the bamboo forest, illuminating a girl and her owl within. 

The hooting sound of the owl keeps the girl company, while she writes her wishes on numerous slips of paper and ties them to the bamboo tree, praying they will all come true. 

After the update on October 30th, Kaoru's new skin "Bamboo Wishes" will be added to the store. There will be a 20% discount for the first week, so don't miss out!

[h1]6. Halloween Fanart Event[/h1]

The special Halloween Fanart Event of Onmyoji - Halloween Wonderful Night has arrived!

Submission Period: Oct.20th, 0:00 - Nov.19th, 23:59 PST.

Winner Announcement: Nov 30th, 23:59 EST

How to join:

1. Sign in to your Facebook account

2. Follow the official Onmyoji Facebook account @onmyoji

3.Post by @Onmyoji with an image or video of your original fanart related with Halloween Night, including hashtag #OnmyojiHalloween at the end of your post.

Prize: 

Master Award * 1 - Yoto Hime Figure

Creativity Award *20 - Special Official Goods for Halloween

For more details please go check the official Facebook account @Onmyoji!!

[h1]Improvements[/h1]

1. Adjusted some of the incorrectly displayed pages.

2. Revamped the Merchant page.

[h1]Fixed Issues[/h1]

1. Fixed the shikigami actions in story chapter cinematics.

2. Fixed the issue where the damage dealt by nagas summoned by Orochi in Ghostly Songstress battles was incorrect.

3. Fixed language and technical bugs

notes.title: SSR Takiyashahime Assembly Event! | Updates on October 16th
notes.content:
Dear Onmyoji,

In order to bring you a better gaming experience, the server will be shut down for maintenance [b]from 2:00 - 6:00 EST on Oct 16th[/b]. If it is not completed on time, the opening time will be postponed. For details regarding the update, please check the update announcement which will be posted later, or the game login page after the maintenance.

During the maintenance period, you will not be able to access the game from the server. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. Thank you for your support and understanding!

Important Updates

[h1]1. SP Blazing Tamamonomae, SSR Takiyashahime Assembly Event![/h1]

Dear Onmyoji, to welcome SP Blazing Tamamonomae and SSR Takiyashahime arriving in Heian Kyo, we will be holding an Assembly event! 

Assembly period: October 19th 0:00 – October 22nd 23:59 EST

- During assembly period, players can watch the story and claim rewards on the summon page each day.

- Players can get rewards when a certain number of players have assembled.

[h1]2. The Castle of The Sun – Prologue[/h1]

Glowing like the sun, an old castle appears within the sea mist. According to the legends, the ship’s destination is the land of the “Divine Artifact.” When the mist fades, what truth will be revealed? 

Event period: October 20th, 18:00 – before the update on October 23rd EST

The whereabouts of the Sealand army remains unknown. Seimei understands that only by using the “Divine Artifact”, can they stand against the enemy. However, little did they know what surprise laid in wait them... 

[h1]3. Scarlet Beauty[/h1] 

Underneath the starry sky, the waves reflect the glow of falling embers. Serving as a prelude to her performance, Shiranui elegantly walks on stage accompanied by an enchanting melody. 

From the moon overhead to the calming sea surface below, everything is a part of her performance. 

After the update on October 16th, Shiranui's new skin "Scarlet Beauty" will be added to the store, so don’t miss out! 

Furthermore, this skin will be 40% off until the maintenance on October 30th, selling for 126 S-Jade only! 

After the maintenance on October 30th, the skin will be sold for 210 S-Jade!

The skin "Scarlet Beauty" features the following: 

-New actions and skill effects 

-Exclusive frame "Scarlet Beauty" 

-Exclusive voice and sound effects

[h1]4. Higanbana Realm Skin – Underworld River[/h1] 

Event period: After the update on October 16th – November 15th 23:59 EST 

How to play: 

- Players have a chance to obtain Realm Skin Puzzle Pieces from battles in the Soul zone, Evolution zone, Realm Raid and Exploration zone. 

- Puzzle pieces can be used to unlock the puzzle on the event page. 

- Players can gift up to 3 Realm Skin shards to friends per day.  

[h1]5. Reunion in Heian-Kyo[/h1]

Event Time: After maintenance Oct 16th - Oct 22nd, 23:59 EST  

Event details: 

- During the event, players who meet the following requirements and log in the game will get the comeback rewards – 100% EXP bonus, 100% Coin bonus and Mystery Amulets!

1) The last login time before the event starts is 7 days ago. 

2) The in-game level is not less than lv.15. 

- For all players during the event, reaching 80 courage in Kimodameshi every day will grant a player one more Mystery Amulet! 

[h1]6. Good luck doesn’t wait![/h1] 

Not enough souls to get your Shikigami fully equipped? No worries, the Soul drop event is coming this weekend! 

Time: October 19th 0:00 - October 20th 23:59 EST 

How to play: 

- During this event, you can choose the type of souls that drop in the Soul Zone. 

- You can choose 4 types of souls. The same soul cannot be chosen more than once in any lineup. After you have selected a lineup, you can edit it at any time for free. 

- Your selected lineup will be in effect for the first 200 challenges each day. After this, the soul lineup will return to normal.

[h1]7. Feathered Wanderer[/h1] 

The sound of rain echoes through the valley, as water droplets fall endlessly on an abandoned road. Only a feathered figure wearing a conical straw hat, with her hair in a long ponytail could be seen walking through. 

Only Ubume can hear the faint sound of weeping masked by the pouring rain... 

After the update on October 16th, Ubume's new skin "Feathered Wanderer" will be available for purchase in the skin store with a 20% off discount during the first week. 

[h1]Improvements[/h1]

1. New UI, new graphic style. Everything's new!

※ Iterated on the UI of multiple zone pages, including: the Courtyard, the Guild, the Team-up page, the Shop, the Friends page, and more.

※ More detail improvements are waiting for you to explore!

New visuals and shikigami skill visual effects that will surely amaze all!

※ Improvements to multiple shikigami skill visual effects, including Ichimokuren, Ootengu, Ibaraki Doji, Yoto Hime, Aoandon, Shuten Doji, Enma, Lord Arakawa, and SR shikigami including Hakuro, Ubume, etc.

※ New skill visual effects are sure to bring new life to shikigami. Come and check out what's new!

※ Shuten Doji's Drunken Shanty skin and Ubume's Golden Crane, Craven Girl, and Daruma Raven skins are not yet improved in this update.

Neatly illustrated new scenes reveal all the details to you!

※ 7 battle scenes have had their quality improved in this update: Umbrella Sanctuary, Ocean Nirvana, Tranquil Forest, Goldfish Oasis, Underworld Expanse, Inferno Plane, and Peach Forest.

※ There are Easter eggs hidden in each scene waiting for players to discover!

2. Improvements to Group:

※ Messages in the Group channel now can be liked.

※ Fixed the issue where messages sometimes overflowed when players used the tagging feature in the channel.

※ Fixed the issue where the Bond prompt sometimes appeared twice.

※ Fixed the issue that led to a page crash when players create groups in Friends page.

3. Improved some of the message prompts from friends.

※ The notice message that appears when a friend obtains a rare shikigami via summoning of combining shards has now been moved to the News system on the top left of the Friends page from private chat. Likewise, blessings from friends are now also part of that system.

※ When players receive thank you gifts from granting a wish in their guilds, the notice messages will now go to Wish - Record in the Guild system.
 
4. Improved how EXP is calculated when feeding Souls. After the update, when players use Gluttony Ghoul and Souls to feed Souls, the EXP overflow will be greatly reduced.
 
5. Added a Request All option to the join guild request function to facilitate players joining guilds.

6. Improved the visuals of special edition skin card, added a Special tag.
　　 
7. Added new voice-over and exclusive bio for Tamamonomae's special edition Lotus Dream skin.
　　 
8. Improved the notice description on the Skin gifting page.
　　 
9. Fixed the shikigami position next to the table in the Courtyard in the summer themed skin, to prevent them from blocking the pet.

[h1]Fixed Issues[/h1]

1. Fixed the issue where, when a target was banished by Otakemaru's Unlimited Blade Prison skill, the target could still be affected by Waverider Lord Arakawa's River's Fury skill.

2. Fixed the issue with Kikyo's Soul Barrier skill, where the barrier would disappear after the second attack granted by Shiranui's Blazing Sky effect.

3. Fixed the issue with Kujira's Whale Bone: Station skill where it could be triggered during an enemy's counter attack.

4. Fixed the issue where the Graceful Agility skill icon was prompted when Chocho was KO'd.

5. Fixed the issue with Ushi no Toki's Cursed Fire skill where it could be activated even when Ushi no Toki was KO'd.

notes.title: SP Waverider Lord Arakawa Summon Event! | Updates on September 25th
notes.content:
Dear Onmyoji,

In order to bring you a better gaming experience, the server will be shut down for [b]maintenance from 2:00 - 6:00 EST on Sep 25th[/b]. If it is not completed on time, the opening time will be postponed. For details regarding the update, please check the update announcement which will be posted later, or the game login page after the maintenance.

During the maintenance period, you will not be able to access the game from the server. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. Thank you for your support and understanding!

[h1]Important Updates[/h1]

[h1]1.    SP Waverider Lord Arakawa Summon Event[/h1]

Dear Onmyoji, to welcome SP Waverider Lord Arakawa arriving in Heian Kyo, we will be holding an Summoning event! 

Summon Event period: After the maintenance on September 25th – October 1st 23:59 EST 

Event details: 

- When summoning using Mystery Amulets, Jade, or AR Amulets during the event, the appearance rate for SP/SSR Shikigami will be 2.5 times the normal rate. The summon rate will revert to the normal rate after the player successfully summons 3 SP/SSR Shikigami. 

- During the event, the chances of SP Waverider Lord Arakawa appearing when an SP/SSR Shikigami is summoned will increase according to the number of times summon is performed. Please note that the player will no longer benefit from this chance up after SP Waverider Lord Arakawa has been summoned for the first time. 

- Players who have completed their SSR collection before the update on September 25th, the chances of SP Waverider Lord Arakawa appearing when an SP/SSR Shikigami is summoned will be initially 10%, and this chance will continue to increase as the players continue to summon, ultimately reaching 100% at 500 summons. 

- Players who have not completed their SSR Collection before the update on September 25th, the chances of SP Waverider Lord Arakawa appearing when an SP/SSR Shikigami is summoned will have a maximum of 15%. 

- Players who summon for a specific amount of time during the event will receive corresponding rewards, including SR Shikigami “Kanihime”, Mystery Amulets, Skill Daruma, Skin Tokens, Jade, “SR Choice”, and more.

[h1]2.    Waverider Lord Arakawa Memory Scroll[/h1] 

Waves crash while the battle ensues upon the surface. Standing upon the waves, he single-handedly fends off hordes of enemies to protect his land and his people. 

Dear Onmyoji, repair the memory scroll and witness the battle of Arakawa! 

Event period: After the update on September 25th – October 16th 23:59 EST 

How to play: 

- Players can obtain scroll shards by participating in various activities in the game. - Donate scroll shards to help repair the memory scrolls. Players will obtain a random reward for every donation. 

- After a memory scroll has been fully repaired, players will receive corresponding rewards according to their donation ranking. 

- For each memory scroll, players rank 200 or higher will receive SP Waverider Lord Arakawa shards,. Players rank 500 or higher will receive the“Roaring Waves" animated frame. 

- After all memory scrolls have been repaired, players can no longer obtain or donate scroll shards. 

[h1]3.    Battle of Arakawa[/h1]

Commanding the waves alongside his fearful army, Otakemaru invades the waters of Arakawa River, wreaking havoc as he passes through locations such as Akakumo, Kingan, Aouna and Kikushima. 

Dedicated to protecting his land and his people at all costs, Waverider Lord Arakawa puts on his armor, preparing for a bloody battle. 

Dear Onmyoji, please help fend off the invaders of Arakawa River! 

Time: After the update on September 25th - October 1st 23:59 EST 

Event details: 

- When participating in the battle against the demonships, the highest damage dealt in a single battle, on each day, will be recorded as that day's score. These daily scores add up to the total score for the event. 

- After the event has ended, players will be ranked according to their total score and receive corresponding rewards. 

- Players who fend off the demonship at each area for the first time will receive a reward for that area. 

- Players can also challenge "Wave zones" to earn "Sea Tokens", which can be used to redeem precious items such as Jade, Skill Daruma, and a Grade 6 Realm Card.

[h1]4.    Adventure story “Sealand: Nobody”[/h1]

Event Period: After the update on September 25th – October 8th 23:59 EST

During the event, players can access the event page by tapping on the Jizu Statue in the lobby → Event → Sealand: Nobody.

The event consists of 4 stages, the content of each stage will be unlocked on following dates:

1st stage: September 25th 

2nd stage: September 27th

3rd and 4th Stage: October 1st

How to play:

- players have to collect event items by going through the story

- After players have collected 5 event items, they can redeem the reward in the final stage: AR Amulet*1 and have a chance to obtain an SP shikigami Waverider Lord Arakawa. (for the luckiest player!)

- Players who want to collect all the event items, please try out different choices in the story!

Note:

- Please fill in your correct digital game ID in the event page. Players who fill in their digital game ID incorrectly may have their save data lost and fail to receive their reward.

- Rewards will be issued from Oct 9th to Oct 10th.

[h1]5.    Ebisu’s Boutique[/h1] 

Event period: After the update on Sep 25th – Oct 16th 23:59 EST 

Event details: 

- During the event, players can obtain Ebisu’s Fortune Shop exclusive frame “Dazzling Gold” by recharging in the game. Players will have a chance to obtain this exclusive frame again during future Ebisu’s Boutique events. And if players receive the frame more than once, the frame will be upgraded! 

- Recharge to certain amounts to receive the “Moonlight” courtyard skin, Seimei's "Dark Seimei" skin and more! 

- Players who have already received the rewards will be compensated as shown below. 

“Moonlight” Courtyard skin →　1000 Jade 

Seimei's "Dark Seimei" skin　→　"Lord of Kyoto" frame 

Seimei's "Dark Seimei" skin + "Lord of Kyoto" frame　→　"Lord of Kyoto" frame (Gold Daruma version) 

- Players who already have the "Lord of Kyoto" frame (Gold Daruma version) will gain the right to enter the Boutique, and receive 2 Boutique talismans instead!

[h1]6.    Lotus Dream[/h1]

Under the beautiful moonlight, accompanied by the lotus flowers, Tamamonomae drifts off to sleep. Dreaming of the past, and recalling days from long ago... 

After the update on September 25th, Tamamonomae’s Premium skin “Lotus Dream” will be available in the skin store! 

Skin details: 

- Price: 128 S-Jade 

- By equipping this Premium skin, Tamamonomae will have an exclusive motion and skill visual effect. Also, players who purchase this skin will receive the exclusive frame “Lotus Dream” as a reward. 

- For further details, please refer to the in game information.

[h1]7.    Seven Seas Voyager[/h1]  

It is a hot summer night in the Arakawa River, Lord Arakawa takes a walk on the shores and enjoys the night breeze. Lord Arakawa is careful not to wake up his people, as they sleep peacefully under his protection, to the soft lullaby of the river. 

After the update on September 25th, Lord Arakawa's new skin "Seven Seas Voyager" will be available for purchase in skin store with a 20% off discount during the first week!

[h1]8.    Lost Dream[/h1]

From afar, the sound of a bell rings out through the air, while only a glimpse of a slim figure in a white skirt can be seen in the purple mist. 

Surrounded by purple mist, Kiyohime holds white lilies, as if waiting for someone's return. The bell has rung once more. Perhaps it's trying to awaken Kiyohime from her dream of love?

After the update on September 25th, Kiyohime's new skin "Lost Dream" will be available for purchase in the skin store with a 20% off discount during the first week! 

[h1]Improvement[/h1]

1.    Fully upgraded chat channels

※ Added the new Group channel

- Moved the Group feature to chat channels.

- Adjusted the Group player limit to 200 players.

- Iterated on the avatars in Group.

- Added functions to Administrator.

- Added confirmation to Group invites.

- Added recommended Groups feature.

- Added report function to Group.

※ Added the Buddy channel to allow players to chat with their online friends. Players can choose to block the channel if they feel bothered by it.

※ Added notification function to tagging players. Players can tap and hold a player's avatar to tag that player and notify them of a message.

※ Improved the chat experience. When players switch scenarios while they're chatting, the chat box will remain fixed to the page.

※ Improved the message prompts of the Nearby channel. Players can see messages when they log in to the game.

2.    Sharing the Merchant to the same player repeatedly no longer costs extra sharing attempts.

3.    Improved the default display rules in some parts of the Collection.

4.    Improved the display of special edition skins in the Skin Shop, added a reminder of the bonus Avatar Frame included.

5.    Added the Bond requirement reminders to the Merchant.

[h1]Fixed Issues[/h1]

1.    Fixed issues in Co-op Duels

※ Fixed the issue where players could deploy Totems to battle.

※ Fixed the issue where Hiyoribou's revival effect would sometimes trigger incorrectly.

2.    Fixed the display inconsistency in the descriptions of Kainin, Azurestorm Ichimokuren, and Sesshomaru's skills after they've evolved.

3.    Fixed some of the missing special effects on SP shikigami avatars on the guild Make Wish page.

4.    Fixed the issue with Shiranui where, after entering the Silhouette of Sorrow state while an enemy Vengeful Hannya's Sealing Field was active, the icon of her passive skill Song of Sorrow would be displayed incorrectly.

5.    Fixed the issue with Kujira where, when he was battling in the Orochi of the Maidens: Moans zone, the orb reduction effect would fail to trigger correctly.

notes.title: Activate! Summon Circle! | Updates on September 18th
notes.content:
Update Announcement

Dear Onmyoji,

To ensure a better game experience, we will perform an update on Sep 18th 00:00 EST. The server will not go down for this update, so just enjoy it :)

[h1]Important Updates[/h1]

[h1]1. Activate! Summon Circle![/h1] 

Time: September 18th 00:00 - September 24th 23:59 EST 

How to play: 

- During the event, players can gain points by summoning Shikigami. 

- Players can redeem rewards and activate the Summon Circle by spending points 

- Activate Summon Circle to obtain Kusa’s skin “Treasure-bringer” and Skill Daruma! 

Note: 

- Points gained are only valid during this event and will become void once the event ends. 

- Delivery of rewards may be delayed. If you do not properly receive your rewards, please re-login and check again.

[h1]2. Autumn Fest: Score to obtain rewards![/h1]

As Autumn is just around the corner, Heian-Kyo is also preparing for the Autumn Fest! Onmyoji, receive rewards by joining the Autumn Fest! 

Time: Sep 18th 00:00 - Oct 1st 23:59 EST 

How to play: 

- Players can gain points after battling in Exploration Zone, Evo Zone, Soul Zone, Realm Raid, and Duel. 

- Players can also gain points by summoning with Mystery Amulets, Jades, AR Amulets and Broken Amulets. 

- Scores can be used to exchange for valuable rewards. For the rewards lineup, please refer to the in-game details. 

Notes:

- After the event ends, the unused points will become void. 

- Please note that players can only gain points by winning battles. No points will be awarded for losses in battle. 

[h1]3. As chic as ever![/h1]

New SP skins for Futakuchi, Shiro, Hannya, and Yumekui are coming! Onmyoji, please take a look and see if they tickle your fancy! 

Time: Sep18th 0:00 - Sep 24th 23:59 EST 

SP Skins lineup: 

Futakuchi - Dark Blue

Shiro - True Red 

Hannya - Negi 

Yumekui - Noble Violet

How to get the SP skins: 

※ By using Mystery Amulets, AR Amulets or Jade to summon, players will have a chance to receive 1 SP skin. You can choose which SP skin you would like from the 4 above. 

※ Players can also redeem 1 SP skin using Gold Talismans in the event page, up to one time. 

※ Players can receive a total of 2 SP skins at most from this event. 

Friendly Reminder: 

-If the player forgets to pick up his or her skin when the event ends, a random SP skin not in the player's possession will be picked from the lineup and be delivered through in-game mail. 

[h1]4. SP Waverider Lord Arakawa Assembly Event[/h1]

Dear Onmyoji, to welcome SP Waverider Lord Arakawa arriving in Heian Kyo, we will be holding an Assembly event! 

Assembly Event period: September 21st 00:00 A.M – September 24th 23:59 EST

- During assembly period, players can watch the story and claim rewards on the summon page each day.

- Players can get rewards when a certain number of players have assembled.

[h1]5. Shopkeeper's Benefit[/h1]

Shopkeeper is giving out discount vouchers! Get the discount vouchers and check out the Pack Shop! 

Event period: Sep 18th 00:00 - Sep 20th 23:59 EST 

During the event, players can obtain a random pack shop discount voucher every day! 

Note: 

- Every day during the event, players will have a maximum of 3 chances to draw a discount voucher. The discount voucher with the biggest discount drawn for that day will be awarded to the player.

- The Discount Voucher will be available for 7 days. It can be applied to all packs which can be purchased using S-Jade.

[h1]Fixed Issues[/h1]

1. Fixed language and technical bugs.
