notes.title: Kyoto Reunion! | Updates on September 11th
notes.content:
Dear Onmyoji,

In order to bring you a better gaming experience, the server will be shut down for maintenance [b]from 2:00 - 6:00 EST on Sep 11th[/b]. If it is not completed on time, the opening time will be postponed. For details regarding the update, please check the update announcement which will be posted later, or the game login page after the maintenance.

During the maintenance period, you will not be able to access the game from the server. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. Thank you for your support and understanding!

[h1]Important Updates[/h1]

[h1]1. Kyoto Reunion[/h1]

Event period: After the update on September 11th – September 24th 23:59 EST 

Event details: 

- During the event, active players can participate in the event by inviting old players to return. 

- Returned players can link to an active player (You may link to a player who is not in your friend list) and complete missions during the event period to gain return points. 

- Active Players can gain Recall points when the returned players they link to complete quests during the event. - Returned players can also link to an active player randomly assigned by the system. 

- Points can be used for redeeming rewards, including a random SSR Shikigami, Skill Daruma, and more! 

Notes: 

The random SSR Shikigami will be chosen from one of the Shikigami below: Ootengu, Shuten Doji, Arakawa. Enma, Shishio, Ibaraki Doji, Aoandon, Yoto Hime, Ichimokuren, Hana, Kaguya, Susabi, Higanbana, Yuki, Tamamonomae, Miketsu, Yamakaze, Menreiki, Onikiri, Hakuzosu

[h1]2. Indigo Moon[/h1]

As the season of the Mid-Autumn Festival approaches, Heian-Kyo is preparing a Mid-Autumn special event – “Indigo Moon”! 

Event time: After the update on September 11th – September 24th 23:59 EST 

Location: players can access the event page by tapping on the little rabbit or the Jizo statue in the courtyard. 

How to play: 

- During the event, players who reach 100 courage or more can obtain a daily reward. Players can obtain this reward once per day. 

- During the first 5 days of the event, each day, one Shikigami will come to visit and tell an event story. Players can tap on the “Moon Tale” button in the event page to view the story. 

- Receive the daily reward and unlock a puzzle piece of the illustration. During the event, with dedication, you can complete the illustration in 7 days! 

- Receive the daily reward 7 times to obtain Vampira’s new skin “Chilling Seafair”! 

- After the illustration is complete, players can share the illustration with others through various social networking platforms.

[h1]3. Guaranteed SSR Shikigami for beginners[/h1] 

Big news!! A new beginner activity “Guaranteed SSR Shikigami for beginners” will be implemented into Onmyoji! If you have considered starting to play Onmyoji but you worry that you wouldn't be able to summon powerful Shikigami, this could be your chance!! 

Time: After the update on September 11th EST 

Event details: After the update on September 11th, a free 10x summon will be added to the tutorial, which is guaranteed to include an SSR Shikigami!

The guaranteed SSR Shikigami in the 10th summon will be chosen from one of the Shikigami below: Yamakaze, Yuki, Ichimokuren, Yoto Hime, Shishio, Enma, Lord Arakawa, Aoandon 

Friendly reminder: Players who have started the game before the update on September 11th can still obtain a random SSR Shikigami through the "Kyoto Reunion" event! Don’t miss out!

[h1]4. A new game for Showdown Bidding![/h1]

Jikikaeru is starting a new game for thrill-seekers! Onmyoji, will you dare to join his game? Tap on Jikikaeru in Town to bet on a team! 

Event period: September 11th 11:00 – September 14th 23:00 EST 

The deadline for claiming your rewards is September 17th 23:00 EST. Remember to collect all of your rewards before the deadline, as the event interface will not be accessible after the event ends.

[h1]5. Updates on Co-op Duel![/h1]

※New Battle Rules:  

- For each battle, each player needs to select 6 unduplicated shikigami: 3 Battle Shikigami and 3 Backup Shikigami. Backup Shikigami may replace Battle Shikigami during battle. 

※Adjusted the matchmaking and scoring mechanism. Removed the restriction of level and score difference in team-up.

※Tier-buffer will be applied to players who achieved Tier 4, Tier 6 and Tier 8 each week (they will not go to lower tier until the end of the week)

※Rules for Tier 1 is consistent with Duel: Players with Co-op Duel Score below 1,000 will no longer lose points from a Co-op Duel defeat. Players with Co-op Duel Score over 1,000 are eligible to receive the Tier 1 weekly rewards

※Availability time has been changed to everyday at 20:00 to 23:00 EST

※After maintenance on Sep 11th, Co-op Duel Score will be reset to 1000 for every Onmyoji (only this once), and will revert to normal scoring mechanism after this week.

※For more details, please refer to the Co-op Duel tips in game.

※We will continually pay close attention to Onmyojis' feedback and improve the Co-op Duel accordingly. 

[h1]6. Limited Packs On Sale![/h1]

※Daily Summon Pack I

Price：10 S-Jade
What it contains：Mystery Amulet ×1, Grade 2 Moon×1, Coins ×5000
Limited purchase time：After maintenance on Sep 11 - Sep 17th 23:59 EST 
purchase limit: 1 per day

※Daily Summon Pack II

Price：20 S-Jade
What it contains：Mystery Amulet ×2, Grade Daruma×1, Sakuramochi ×10
Limited purchase time：After maintenance on Sep 11 - Sep 17th 23:59 EST 
purchase limit: 1 per day

※Special Soul Pack

Price：50 S-Jade
What it contains：Grade-5 Seductress Full Set ×1, Grade 5 Cyan Imp ×5
Limited purchase time：After maintenance on Sep 11 - Sep 24th 23:59 EST 
purchase limit: 1 per account

[h1]7. Night Blossom[/h1]

Song of bell resonates in the clear dark sky. A cool breeze blows, the cherry blossom petals scatter in the air. Under the cold blue moonlight, Miketsu gently sits on her fox, spreading her blessings to the mortal world. 

After the update on September 11th, Miketsu’s “Night Blossom” will be available for purchase in skin store with a 20% off discount during the first week!

[h1]8. White Serpent[/h1]

As the curtain of night falls, the figure in white robe becomes the only light in the dark. With a skeleton head on the waist, white snakes from sleeves, the fierce scarlet eyes of Orochi as if telling he shall erase all the enemy on his way. 

After the update on September 11th, Orochi’s skin “White Serpent” will be available for purchase in skin store with a 20% off discount during the first week!

[h1]Improvement[/h1]

1. Adjustment has been made on the “Come on SSR” Event (for beginner only), now beginners can obtain one of the following shikigami from “Come on SSR”: Shuten Doji, Ootengu, Ibaraki Doji, Hana, Kaguya, Susabi, Tamamonomae, Higanbana.

Players who have completed “Come on SSR” before the update on Sep 11th will receive a Mystery Amulets and 10x Skill Daruma shards.

Notes:

- The Mystery Amulets and 10x Skill Daruma shards will be sent to players in 1 day after maintenance via mails.

- The mails will be valid for 15days. 

2. Adjusted the UI in courtyard: the “Collection” has been moved from courtyard to Town.

3. Added a function to allow players to adjust the order of their pre-set lineups.

4. Moderately increased the efficiency of players earning Honor in the Celebrity Tier.

5. When players tap and hold a Soul on the Soul-releasing page to select multiple Souls, Souls of different grades will no longer be selected.

6. Iterated on the text display in the chat box in the chat channel and the downloaded emoji manage icon display.

[h1]Fixed Issues[/h1]

1. Fixed the display error in the recommendation list in Mentor's Guidance.

2. Fixed the incorrect skill icon position with Kujira when he's affected by an enemy Vengeful Hannya's Deep-rooted Grudge.

3. Fixed the issue where, when a player leaves and rejoins a guild, his/her total Feats record is sometimes lost.

4. Fixed the progress bar display errors on the Battle Stats page.

5. Fixed the issue where, when Hako Shoujo uses Retrace to protect Shiranui, the protection sometimes prevents Shiranui from entering the Silhouette of Sorrow state normally.

6. Fixed the issue where the 4-piece Set Effect of Tree Nymph still triggers in battle when no actual damage is dealt.

7. Fixed the issue where, when a shikigami is affected by both Vengeful Hannya's Deep-rooted Grudge and Otakemaru's Unlimited Blade Prison, the two effects would cause the shikigami to lose all their Soul effects and passive skills indefinitely.

notes.title: Vote for SP/SSR Shikigami Chance Up! | Updates on September 4th
notes.content:
Dear Onmyoji,

In order to bring you a better gaming experience, the server will be shut down for maintenance [b]from 2:00 - 5:00 EST on Sep 4th[/b]. If it is not completed on time, the opening time will be postponed. For details regarding the update, please check the update announcement which will be posted later, or the game login page after the maintenance.

During the maintenance period, you will not be able to access the game from the server. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. Thank you for your support and understanding!

[h1]Important Updates[/h1]

[h1]1. Vote for SP/SSR Shikigami Chance Up[/h1] 

Chance up Event period: After the update on September 4th - September 17th 23:59 EST 

Dear Onmyoji, We are glad that so many players have participated in the event! The top 8 popular shikigami that received most votes are: Onikiri , Shiranui, Inferno Ibaraki Doji, Orochi ,  Otakemaru, Tamamonomae, Crimson Yoto, Vengeful Hannya.

During the event, the summon rate of the abovementioned SSR and SP Shikigami will be 2.5 times the normal rate!

Notes: the summon chance will revert back to the normal rate after you’ve summoned SP/SSR shikigami 3 times during the event.

It's time for you to summon your favorite Shikigami!

[h1]2. Daruma Wish[/h1]

Running out of Daruma to upgrade your Shikigami? Don't worry! The Daruma Wish event is on! 

Event Period: September 4th 00:00 – September 17th 23:59 (EST) 

How to play: During the event, players who clear Soul Zones, Evo Zones or Wanted Quests will have a chance to obtain different types of Daruma Cards: - Soul Zone: Red Daruma Card - Evo Zone: White Daruma Card - Wanted Quest: Black Daruma Card Spend Daruma cards to redeem the corresponding Daruma! 

Note: Daruma cards are only valid during this event, and will become void once the event ends.

[h1]3. Good luck doesn’t wait![/h1] 

Not enough souls to get your Shikigami fully equipped? No worries, the Soul drop event is coming this weekend! 

Time: September 7th 00:00 – September 8th 23:59 (EST) 

How to play: 

- During this event, you can choose the type of souls that drop in the Soul Zone. 

- You can choose 4 types of souls. The same soul cannot be chosen more than once in any lineup. After you have selected a lineup, you can edit it at any time for free. 

- Your selected lineup will be in effect for the first 200 challenges each day. After this, the soul lineup will return to normal.

[h1]Fixed Issues[/h1]

1. Fixed language and technical bugs.

notes.title: Orochi arrives in Heian-Kyo! | Updates on August 28th
notes.content:
Update Announcement

Dear Onmyoji,

In order to bring you a better gaming experience, the server will be shut down for maintenance from [b]2:00 - 6:00 EST on Aug 28th[/b]. If it is not completed on time, the opening time will be postponed. For details regarding the update, please check the update announcement which will be posted later, or the game login page after the maintenance.

During the maintenance period, you will not be able to access the game from the server. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. Thank you for your support and understanding!

[h1]Important Updates[/h1]

[h1]1. Heian Stories: Orochi arrives in Heian-Kyo![/h1]

※ Introducing the new Platform Attack game mode. Experience a new kind of battle with Onmyoji Spells and your shikigami.

Intense and exciting real-time battle mode!

※Hiromasa, Little Kagura, Maiden, and Minamoto no Yorimitsu... Discover the truth behind the battle where Orochi broke free from different perspectives.

Little Kagura and Young Minamoto no Yorimitsu are here for the first time!

※ You can choose the rewards you want to receive from a selection. Manage your resources wisely to build a powerful lineup!

Enhance your shikigami and configure Soul sets freely!

※ Game progress is saved each chapter to give players the chance to try different tactics.

You can quit mid-battle if you're losing. No penalties applied!

※ Tap the Daruma after completing a chapter to unlock shikigami available for the zone and rewards, including Mystery Amulets!

Complete achievements for a Skill Daruma reward!

※ During the game cycle, characters will recover to their best form at midnight each day until you've completed all the stories.

※ Game progress resets and rewards are refreshed between 2:00-5:00 on Wednesdays, during which no players can take part in the zone.

[h1]2. Vote for SP/SSR Shikigami chance up![/h1] 

Dear Onmyoji, We have prepared a new event for you! Vote for the SP/SSR Shikigami that you would like to receive a chance up! 

Voting period: After the update on August 28th - September 1st 23:59 EST 

Event rule: Each Onmyoji can vote for at most 3 SP/SSR Shikigami. After the voting period has ended, the 8 Shikigami that received the most votes will have their summon rates increased to 2.5 times the normal rate in the next SP/SSR chance up event! 

How to vote: 

Method 1: Access the event page through the banner in-game 

Method 2: Vote via the following link  https://forms.gle/hfktjG9ioNF9YS2AA (players can access the link from the Onmyoji's facebook post)

Every vote counts!

[h1]3. Weekend SR Shikigami Special[/h1] 

Is there a certain SR Shikigami that you would love to have, but haven't had much luck summoning so far? Well, here's your chance! 

Time: August 31st 0:00– September 1st 23:59 EST 

During the event, the first 10 SR Shikigami that are summoned will be from the following list: Kujira, Bake-kujira, Okuribito, Ittan-momen, Okikumushi, Nekomata, Kisei, Kaoru, Oitsuki, Dodomeki, Bukkuman, Chin. 

Also, performing summon during the event period will have a chance to obtain a skill daruma as a surprise present! 

*The SR Shikigami listed above all have an equal chance of appearing. 

*This event is only available for Onmyoji lvl 15 or above.

[h1]4. Exploration Monster Bonus-Up Event![/h1]

It’s time to visit the Explore Zone for rewards!

Event time: After the update on Aug 28th - Sep 3rd 23:59 EST

During the event, enemies in the Exploration Zone will have two reward bonuses at the same time, allowing you to earn more EXP, coins, or loot per battle!

[h1]5. Demon Parade Chance Up![/h1]

Onmyoji, get your beans ready, as the Demon Parade Chance Up has come! 

Time: After the maintenance on August 28th – September 3rd 23:59 EST 

During the event period, there will be an increased chance of obtaining Shikigami shards for the first 5 games each day!

[h1]6. Prodigy Painter[/h1]

As the wind breezes through the bamboo forest, Shishio takes out his brush, transferring his thoughts into beautiful ink paintings. 

Looking at the butterfly that has landed on his fingertips, he greets the little stranger with a bright smile. 'Would you like to be my friend?'

After the update on August 28th, Shishio’s new skin “Prodigy Painter” will be available in the Skin Store, with a 20% discount on the first week! 

[h1]7. Faces of Shogun[/h1] 

As if controlled by an invisible thread, seven ferocious masks hover and rotate in the air. Among the whirling masks is a fragile girl with long black hair, like a purple bellflower hiding in the darkness of the night. 

After the update on August 28th, Menreiki’s new skin “Faces of Shogun” will be available in the Skin Store, with a 20% discount on the first week!

[h1]Improvement[/h1]

1. Improved the scoring system in Duel. Now the discrepancies between the points gained from winning and the points lost from duel defeat for tier 7, tier 8 and tier 9 has been narrowed down.

2. When players place their Realm Cards in the Realm Entrust system, the system will remember their previous settings for the two slots, making the process more convenient.

3. Added rules to the Merchant. Complete Daruma will no longer be issued via shards, so players won't need to combine them manually.

4. Added detailed rules to Duel Rules. Updated wording on the existing descriptions to make them consistent with the current rules.

5. Added an Unequip All button, which allows players to unequip all Souls from a shikigami, to the Soul section of the Shikigami page. Also, re-sorted the actions in Soul Profiles, adding the currently equipped Souls as a profile option. An Equip button has also been added to the bottom right corner of the page, making the interface more logical to use.

6. Improved how players can select skills to use in auto battle mode in some zones. Added setting options to allow players to prioritize using a certain skill (This feature needs to be enabled in Settings - Interactions).

7. Added a 1 minute interval to sharing the Guild Nameplate.

8. Duel Celebrities no longer has a Duel Star cap. Celebrities of 101 Stars or above will have their Stars partially reset when the weekly results are published.

9. To relieve the burden on servers caused by ranking calculation for rankings including Likes, characters who have not logged in for several consecutive months will no longer appear on the rankings.

10. Fixed the issue where Grade 5 Grade Daruma were deployed by default when players were spectating a duel.

11. Added a "Shards to offer" option when players are making a wish in the guild, to help players trade their shards with other members. Players can show the shikigami shards they can offer via Wish - Make Wish - Available.
 
[h1]Fixed Issues[/h1]

1. Fixed an issue where units with Freeze could be triggered to launch an assisting attack under rare circumstances.

2. Fixed an issue that caused Hiyoribou to look abnormal when she was banished by Otakemaru's Unlimited Blade Prison.

3. Fixed an issue that caused Kanko to look abnormal when he was banished by Otakemaru's Unlimited Blade Prison.

4. Fixed an issue with Hiyoribou where she could still revive an ally at the end of the turn after being returned from banishment from Otakemaru's Unlimited Blade Prison skill.

5. Fixed an issue with Aoandon's Lantern Support where the skills that were not yet in effect could not be triggered when multiple Aoandon were on the battlefield.

6. Fixed an issue with some buttons in the gift sending feature in the Shop page, where incorrect button layers were displayed.

7. Fixed an issue causing some of the illustrations to appear blurry.

8. Fixed an issue with Dodomeki where her Evil Light skill was regarded as a normal attack when she was not yet evolved.

tags.feature: 2. When players place their Realm Cards in the Realm Entrust system, the system will remember their previous settings for the two slots, making the process more convenient.
3. Added rules to the Merchant. Complete Daruma will no longer be issued via shards, so players won't need to combine them manually.
4. Added detailed rules to Duel Rules. Updated wording on the existing descriptions to make them consistent with the current rules.

5. Added an Unequip All button, which allows players to unequip all Souls from a shikigami, to the Soul section of the Shikigami page. Also, re-sorted the actions in Soul Profiles, adding the currently equipped Souls as a profile option. An Equip button has also been added to the bottom right corner of the page, making the interface more logical to use.

6. Improved how players can select skills to use in auto battle mode in some zones. Added setting options to allow players to prioritize using a certain skill (This feature needs to be enabled in Settings - Interactions).
7. Added a 1 minute interval to sharing the Guild Nameplate.

tags.balance_change: 8. Duel Celebrities no longer has a Duel Star cap. Celebrities of 101 Stars or above will have their Stars partially reset when the weekly results are published.
9. To relieve the burden on servers caused by ranking calculation for rankings including Likes, characters who have not logged in for several consecutive months will no longer appear on the rankings.

tags.bug: 10. Fixed the issue where Grade 5 Grade Daruma were deployed by default when players were spectating a duel.

tags.feature: 11. Added a "Shards to offer" option when players are making a wish in the guild, to help players trade their shards with other members. Players can show the shikigami shards they can offer via Wish - Make Wish - Available.

tags.bug: 1. Fixed an issue where units with Freeze could be triggered to launch an assisting attack under rare circumstances.
2. Fixed an issue that caused Hiyoribou to look abnormal when she was banished by Otakemaru's Unlimited Blade Prison.
3. Fixed an issue that caused Kanko to look abnormal when he was banished by Otakemaru's Unlimited Blade Prison.
4. Fixed an issue with Hiyoribou where she could still revive an ally at the end of the turn after being returned from banishment from Otakemaru's Unlimited Blade Prison skill.
5. Fixed an issue with Aoandon's Lantern Support where the skills that were not yet in effect could not be triggered when multiple Aoandon were on the battlefield.
6. Fixed an issue with some buttons in the gift sending feature in the Shop page, where incorrect button layers were displayed.
7. Fixed an issue causing some of the illustrations to appear blurry.
8. Fixed an issue with Dodomeki where her Evil Light skill was regarded as a normal attack when she was not yet evolved.

notes.title: Otakemaru Summon Event! | Updates on August 14th
notes.content:
Dear Onmyoji,

In order to bring you a better gaming experience, the server will be shut down for maintenance [b]from 2:00 - 6:00 EST on Aug 14th[/b]. If it is not completed on time, the opening time will be postponed. For details regarding the update, please check the update announcement which will be posted later, or the game login page after the maintenance.

During the maintenance period, you will not be able to access the game from the server. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. Thank you for your support and understanding!

[h1]Important Updates[/h1]

[h1]1. New updates are coming to Duel![/h1]

※ Added 3 new Duel tiers: Tier 9, Celebrity, and Grand Celebrity.

-Tier 9 (Duel Score 2,700 - 2,999). Duel rules of Tier 9 are the same as in Tier 1 through Tier 8.

-When the player's Duel Score reaches 3,000, their Tier will be directly promoted from Tier 9 to Celebrity.

-Starting from the Celebrity tier, a brand new Duel Star scoring system will be implemented, and the special scoring algorithm applied to players of 2,800 Duel Score or above is canceled at the same time.

-Celebrity tier will use the Pick and Ban Battle mode. Both players in a battle can select a shikigami to ban them before the battle. Banned Shikigami cannot be used by either player in the battle.

-The three newly added tiers have better weekly result rewards. New weekly limited items have been added to the Honor Shop for players of the newly added Celebrity tiers. 

-The skin reward: Kagura's Valiant Maple skin will be available in the Honor Shop with a purchase requirement of Tier 9.

-Duel sceneries will be changed with the update as follows: Tier 8: Heavenly Drums, Tier 9: Sky Terrace, Celebrity and Grand Celebrity: The Pinnacle.

- The Pick and Ban battle mode will not be applied to Tier 8 and Tier 9

※ Added Support page, recording players weekly/history Support stats. Players who take part in supporting other players can receive weekly rewards and complete co-related achievements. (Support page can be accessed from the Support button on the main Duel page.)

Players who likes to spectate Duel battles can support the players they like via the new support feature.

※ Players whose Duel Score has already reached 3,000 when the maintenance is complete will have their Duel Score converted to Duel Stars based on the conversion rate (one time only). Weekly results will resume to the normal process afterwards.

Changes made to the original Duel tier:

※ Only players with Duel Score over 1,000 are shown on the World/Server ranking.

※ Players with Duel Score over 1,000 are eligible to receive the Tier 1 weekly rewards. Also, Tier 1 weekly rewards is increased from 60 Jade to 80 Jade.

※ Players with Duel Score below 1,000 will no longer lose points from a Duel defeat.

(For detailed rules on Duel and Celebrity tier, please refer to the rules in the Duel page.)

[h1]2. Otakemaru Summon Event[/h1] 

The Lord of Sealand “Otakemaru” is coming! To help players better welcome this new SSR Shikigami, we have prepared an Otakemaru Assembly Summoning event!

Assembly Event period: August 17th 0:00 – August 20th 23:59 (EST) 

[h1]3. Co-op Combat![/h1]

Fight alongside your friends to win numerous rewards! 

Time: After the update on August 14th - August 25th 23:59 EST 

How to play: Courtyard → event → Co-op Combat Event Here, players can team up with other players to gain points, which can be exchanged for valuable rewards. 

Rewards: Jade, Mystery Amulet, Evo drop rate buff, and more. 

Note: 

- Points gained during the event are only valid during the event period, and will become void afterwards. 

- When exchanging points, points are automatically deducted, and the rewards are delivered to the user directly

[h1]4. Fortune Temple[/h1]

Fortune Temple is back! Onmyoji, receive a blessing from the Fortune Temple by redeeming items!

Event Time: After the update on August 14th - August 20th 23:59 EST 

Note: 

- During the event, players can exchange coins, jade, medals, etc. for other items in the Fortune Temple. 

-Each item can only be purchased once per day, resetting at 0:00 EST. 

-The lineup will refresh every day.

[h1]5. Collect Intel Shards to reveal the truth![/h1]

With a sense of unease, an Onmyoji of the Fujiwara Clan sets foot into Seimei’s courtyard, seeking the help from Seimei and his party... 

Event period: August 17th 0:00 – August 20th 23:59 (EST) 

How to play: 

- During the event, by taking part in Exploration Zones, Soul Zones, Evo Zones, and Totem Zones, players will have a chance to obtain Intel shards. 

- Intel shards can be used to unlock corresponding map pieces. Collect all the Intel Shards to expose the hidden plot!

[h1]6. Flaming Banner[/h1] 

On a silent night, the cold moon hides behind the clouds, as the flag in the courtyard blows in the wind. From within the house, the light from a dim lantern reveals a mysterious shadow on the paper window. As the shadow unsheathes his blade, a silver light flashes, and the lantern is extinguished. 

The figure with the blade slips into the darkness, leaving the cries of crows echoing through this dark, unsettling night. 

With the flaming banner of the Minamoto Clan waving behind him, he shall never let his enemies escape, not a single one. Onikiri is reminiscent of a blade, as he dons darkly-hued armor, gripping his long blade, he silently assaults his enemies… 

After the update on August 14th, Onikiri’s new skin “Flaming Banner” will be available in the Skin Store! 

[h1]7. Feel the Blazin' Will of Yamakaze[/h1]

Legend has it that deep in the forest where the moonlight cannot reach, there is a spirit who wears the fur of a beast, wielding his two deadly blades. He may seem young but he is a being to be feared. 

The blade in his left hand is enchanted with the power of the woods, a symbol of vitality and the forces of nature. The blade in his right is enchanted with flame, hot as the sun and can slice anything in half. 

"It is hunting time." 

After the update on August 14th, Yamakaze's new skin "Blazin' Will" will be available in the Skin Store! 

[h1]Shikigami Skill Improvements[/h1]

[h1]1. Azurestorm Ichimokuren[/h1]

※ Wind Amulet: Shield: Fixed an issue where the skill sometimes failed to protect an ally with less than 30% HP in time.

[h1]2. Inugami and Mannendake[/h1]

※ Fixed an issue where, when an ally protected by Inugami's Protection Mark or Mannendake's Leaf Barrier took damage, the skill's counter-attack effect would fail to trigger for certain types of damage.

[h1]3. Hakuro[/h1]

※ Meditation's skill effects after the update: At the end of her turn, if Hakuro is not in a recharging state, she enters a meditative state. While in the meditative state, her Crit DMG is increased by 20% until the end of her next turn. Also creates a shadow double that cannot be attacked. The shadow double has a 30% chance of preventing Hakuro from taking any damage.

※ Non-Self's skill effects after the update: Channels all of her energy into an arrow, increasing the Crit of the attack by 30% before dealing damage equal to 237% of her ATK to 1 enemy. Also lowers their Move Bar by 20%, or by 50% instead if she\'s in a meditative state. If their Move Bar is lowered to zero, 1.5x the damage is dealt instead. She then enters a recharging state, reducing her SPD by 40%.

※ After-evolution skill effects after the update: If the enemy is KO\'d, raises her Move Bar by 90%.

Designer's note: 

We noticed that Hakuro, one of the most iconic single damage dealers from the early stage of the game, hasn't been performing that well in various scenarios in the current metagame. So we made some improvements to her skills for this update. We hope to improve the stability of Hakuro's chance of entering the meditative state, as well as her chances of survival once she enters the meditative state, to solve the problem of her lack of versatility as a pure damage dealer. We've also improved her Non-Self skill by adding a Move Bar-lowering effect and explosive damage in order to increase her power and attack tempo.

[h1]4. Okikumushi[/h1]

※ Cocoon Burst's skill level-up effects after the update:

Lv. 3: After the explosion, inflicts another Poison of 1 grade higher, lasting 1 more turn.

Lv. 5: Increases Okikumushi\'s SPD by 10 for each enemy with Poison.

※ Caterpillar Venom's skill level-up effects after the update: Also inflicts Bug\'s Grudge on the target she stared at, dealing indirect damage equal to 105% of her ATK, and copies the Poison effect on another enemy she caused to explode during the attack. Has a 100% base chance of inflicting this copy on the target she stared at, lasting 2 turns.

※ Effects of Bug\'s Grudge: Inflicts indirect damage at the end of the turn.

Designer's note: 

When designing Okikumushi, we tried to make her a support shikigami who can help by inflicting Poison, and who focuses on inflicting Poison quickly on a single enemy to deal indirect damage, giving her a place among the damage dealers. There were problems with her passive skill Cocoon Burst when the skill caused a Poison explosion – the newly created Poison had a chance of being negated and its duration could be too short to take effect. These problems are solved with this update.

In addition, we improved her Caterpillar Venom skill after her evolution. The skill used to deal direct damage that was affected by all layers and grades of Poison. Now the skill inflicts indirect damage (at the target's turn end). This works better with her own ability to inflict Poison, and the indirect damage can effectively lower the target's HP.

[h1]5. Kusa[/h1]

※ Flower Power's skill effects after the update: When attacked, heals her HP by 15% of her ATK. Triggers only once for a single attack. If the source of the damage has a lower ATK than Kusa\'s, reduces the damage taken by Kusa by 30%.

※ Healing Light's skill effects after the update: Effective exclusively. Carries 2 Blessed Seeds at the start of battle. Each Blessed Seed increases her own ATK by 60%. Active skill: Grants a Blessed Seed to an ally before healing the HP of all allies by an amount equal to 87% of her ATK. Also grants them Photosynthesis lasting 2 turns, healing their HP by 22% of her ATK on each turn.

※ Blessed Seed's skill effects: When Kusa has a Blessed Seed, each Blessed Seed increases Kusa's ATK by 60%. When Kusa receives healing, the HP of the ally with a Seed will be recovered by an equal amount.

※ The effects of Photosynthesis remains the same after the update.

※ Kusa will prioritize using Healing Light when the player selects Skill for her in Auto mode.

Designer's note: 

Relating the ATK stat to the healing amount is an exclusive design choice for Kusa. We hope players can increase Kusa's ATK to improve her overall power through Blessed Seed, and come up with different Soul set configurations to ensure she is seen more in different scenarios.

[h1]Game Experience Improvements:[/h1]

1. Mentor's Guidance system co-op quest improvements:

※ When the Mentor publishes a co-op quest, if the quest is not completed on the same day, the Souls that would be sent to their Apprentice will be refunded, but the AP spent will not.

※ Completing the Entrusting quest no longer requires the Apprentice to entrust their shikigami in their Mentor's Realm for 6 hours before claiming the rewards. The quest is completed as soon as the Apprentice entrusts their shikigami.

2. Improved the notification position where the Friend Gift Bag is shown and the redirect logic when the player taps on the Gift Bag.

3. Improved the visual display of the onmyoji when they're playing with the pet in the Courtyard. Fixed the incorrect action display.

4. Improved the rolling message location in the Hunt assembly page to prevent the message from blocking the timer.

[h1]Fixed Issues[/h1]

1. When the field created by Vengeful Hannya's Deep-rooted Grudge skill is active, and the passive skills of enemy shikigami are substituted with Grudge Forsaken, the Grudge Forsaken skill icon will appear where the original passive skills were shown, and will not mistakenly appear in the same place as their third skills.

2. Fixed an issue in Realm Raids where the lineups players see in the preview are inconsistent with the actual lineups.

3. Fixed an issue in the Oboroguruma challenge battle where the straw doll created by Ushi no Toki is sometimes removed by mistake due to a change in battle phase.

4. Fixed an issue with the incorrect bust display of Seimei's Wise Scholar skin to make it consistent with the concept art.

5. Fixed an issue causing some of the illustrations to appear blurry. Players need to download the illustrations again.

6. Fixed an issue in AR Summon where the special effect is displayed in an incorrect position.

7. Fixed an issue on some devices where the player cannot drag displayed shikigami.

8. Fixed an issue affecting units protected by Divination Sigil while the field created by Shiranui's Blazing Sky is active, where the unit is unable to benefit from the field's effect upon revival.

9. Fixed an issue where the position of the shikigami may be displayed incorrectly when the player drags the slides before battle.

10. Fixed an issue in Area Boss where the area names in the player's personal record don't change as they change areas.

11. Fixed an error with the display of the Friends and Realm pages under poor network connection.

notes.title: Cat-loving Shikigami Chance up! | Updates on August 7th
notes.content:
Dear Onmyoji,

To ensure a better game experience, we will perform an update on Aug 07th 00:00 EST. The server will not go down for this update, so just enjoy it :)

[h1]Important Update[/h1]

[h1]1.Cat-loving Shikigami Chance up![/h1]

Event period: August 7th 0:00– August 13th 23:59 EST 

During the event, the summon rate of cat-loving SSR and SP Shikigami will be 2.5 times the normal rate! 

Note: after the player has summoned 2 cat-loving SSR or SP Shikigami during the event, the summon rate will revert back to normal. 

The lineup of cat-loving Shikigami who will have their summon rates increased is as follows: Shuten Doji, Enma, Ibaraki Doji, Yoto Hime, Hana, Kaguya, Yuki, Shiranui, Shishio, Inferno Ibaraki Doji, Crimson Yoto, Vengeful Hannya, Hakuzosu.

[h1]2. Shopkeeper's Benefit[/h1]

Event period: August 7th 0:00 - August 9th 23:59 EST 

During the event, players can obtain a random pack shop discount voucher every day! 

Note: 

- Every day during the event, players will have a maximum of 3 chances to draw a discount voucher. The discount voucher with the biggest discount drawn for that day will be awarded to the player. 

- The Discount Voucher will be available for 7 days. It can be applied to all packs which can be purchased using S-Jade.

[h1]3. Showdown Bidding![/h1]

Bid on the team that you think is best, and earn numerous rewards! Tap on Jikikaeru in Town to bet on a team! 

Event period: August 7th 11:00– August 10th 23:00 EST 

The deadline for claiming your rewards is August 13th 23:00 EST. Remember to collect all of your rewards before the deadline, as the event interface will not be accessible after the event ends.

[h1]4. Good luck doesn’t wait![/h1] 

Not enough souls to get your Shikigami fully equipped? No worries, the Soul drop event is coming this weekend! 

Time: August 10th 0:00 - August 11th 23:59 (EST) 

- During this event, you can choose the type of souls that drop in the Soul Zone. 

- You can choose 4 types of souls. The same soul cannot be chosen more than once in any lineup. After you have selected a lineup, you can edit it at any time for free. 

- Your selected lineup will be in effect for the first 200 challenges each day. After this, the soul lineup will return to normal.

[h1]Fixed Issues[/h1]

1. Fixed language and technical bugs.

notes.title: Summon in Summer! | Updates on July 10th
notes.content:
Dear Onmyoji,

In order to bring you a better gaming experience, the server will be shut down for maintenance from 2:00 - 5:00 EST on July 10th. If it is not completed on time, the opening time will be postponed. For details regarding the update, please check the update announcement which will be posted later, or the game login page after the maintenance.

[h1]Important Updates[/h1]

[h1]1. Onmyoji and Ibuki[/h1]

“Here I am! Meow. Where is my lovely dried fish?”

“I am not here to look for food and drink but bells!”

“Give me bells. In return, I will tell you a story.”

Onmyoji, collect bells to obtain various rewards and listen to the story told by Ibuki!

Event period: After the maintenance on July 10th – August 4th 23:59 EST

How to play: Complete various quests to obtain bells and increase intimacy with Ibuki.

Rewards: When the intimacy with Ibuki reaches certain levels, players can receive various rewards, including Skill Daruma, Mystery Amulet, SP Skin token, frames and more

[h1]2. Summon in Summer![/h1]

Event period: After the maintenance on July 10th – July 16th 23:59 EST

During the event, the summon rate of SP/SSR Shikigami will be 2.5 times the normal rate!

Note: The summon rate will revert back to the normal rate after the player successfully summons 1 SP/SSR Shikigami. *Please note this summon event is only available for players who are level 15 or above.

[h1]3. New SR Shikigami Kainin[/h1]

Answering the summons of the mortal world, Kainin is making her appearance in Heian-Kyo! With her powerful skills, Kainin could make for a great damage-dealer in your team.

After the update on July 10th, new SR Shikigami Kainin will be available in Shrine! Onmyoji, why not summon her and consider adding her to your lineup?

[h1]4. Shikigami Rapid Promotion[/h1]

In order to assist players easily upgrading the new Shikigami Kainin, we have prepared a Shikigami Rapid Promotion event!

Event period: After the maintenance on July 10th – July 24th 23:59 EST

How to play: During the event, the Kainin that players upgrade for the first time can receive rapid promotion effect. The numbers of materials required for upgrading this Kainin will be reduced by 1, and 1 random skill of Kainin will be leveled up with each upgrade.

Note: Please note that the rapid promotion effect will only apply to the Kainin that was upgraded for the first time, and the effect can only be applied once for each upgrade (Downgrading the Kainin with Exchange Ticket won't make the effect trigger again). If this Kainin was released or used to level up other Shikigami, any other Kainin that players obtain will not be able to receive the rapid promotion effect again.

[h1]5. Lithe Maiden[/h1]

Seems like Tenjo-kudari also needs a change of pace. Tying up her long hair, and changing into a red shrine maiden dress, Tenjo-kudari is once again waiting for someone. After the maintenance on July 10th, Tenjo-kudari’s new skin “Lithe Maiden” will be available for purchase in the Skin Store, with a 20% off discount during the first week!

[h1]6. Chief Adviser[/h1]

Donning a red and white robe, Hangan gently wields a brush in his hand, slowly exterminating lives in the mortal world. All the names written on his white paper shall never escape from the destiny he wrote for them. After the maintenance on July 10th, Hangan’s new skin “Chief Adviser” will be available in the Skin Store! It is 20% off for the first week!

[h1]7. Good luck doesn’t wait![/h1]

Onmyoji, it’s time to select your favorite soul lineup again! Get ready for the soul drop event this weekend!

Time: July 13th 00:00 - July 14th 23:59 EST

How to play: - During this event, you can choose the type of souls that drop in the Soul Zone. - You can choose 4 types of souls. The same soul cannot be chosen more than once in any lineup. After you have selected a lineup, you can edit it at any time for free.

Your selected lineup will be in effect for the first 200 challenges each day. After this, the soul lineup will return to normal.

[h1]Improvements[/h1]

1. Skin Shop Improvements

※ To improve players' experience of purchasing skins with S-Jade, now all skins that are available for purchase with Skin Tokens can be purchased directly with S-Jade. Also, if the player has insufficient Skin Tokens when purchasing a skin, an option is provided for the player to make up the difference with S-Jade.

※ With the improvements made to the Skin Shop, Skin Token-related packs are no longer available. (Players can still obtain Skin Tokens in the game through different means.) The cost for sending skins as gifts has been adjusted as well.

※ We will be issuing compensation to players who have purchased Skin Token packs or have gifted skins from the midnight of June 1st to 23:59 (EST) on July 10th based on the following rules:

For each Skin Pack II purchased, 120 Skin Tokens will be issued in compensation.

For each Skin Pack III purchased, 220 Skin Tokens will be issued in compensation.

For players who have gifted skins, an amount of Skin Tokens equal to about 1.2x of the S-Jade difference will be issued in compensation.

※ Compensations will be issued together a while after the new Skin Shop is implemented.

2. Mentor's Guidance System Improvements:

※ Improvements have been made to the Entrusting quest in the co-op quests. The quest cannot be selected after 17:00 EST each day.

※ Each Mentor-Apprentice pair can only post and complete up to 30 co-op quests. No new co-op quests can be posted when the limit is maxed out.

※ Fixed the issue where the Mentor's Guidance System page was overlapped by other pages.

※ Improved the position of the paper doll that indicates Mentor's Guidance when the Courtyard skin: Hot Spring is applied.

※ Improved the related descriptions of co-op quests.

3. When a new co-op shikigami is set, the Souls currently equipped will be locked. Further Soul adjustment made to the shikigami will not affect your buddies from borrowing the shikigami. Locked Souls cannot be abandoned, released, gifted, or fed to other Souls.

4. Added the pre-set lineup feature to Area Boss.

5. Added the SR shikigami Bake-kujira to the shikigami gift list.

6. Improved the animated effects of the Wishes Granted frame, added a smoke effect.

7. Improved the options provided to players who have two slots for players to entrust their shikigami. Now when the players place a high grade Realm Card, they can set the permissions and the invite lists of the two slots separately.

8. Improved the animation displayed when the player increases their Affection level with their shikigami.

10. The amount of skins left to be gifted is displayed on the Skin page or the top right corner of a skin on the Shikigami page.

[h1]Shikigami Improvement[/h1]

1. Divine Miketsu

Sunlit Fox Realm

Now the effect works exclusively.

The Move Bar-raising effect now correctly works on the target appears "at the top of the turn order" instead of the next target bywho would take the next turn order.

The Move Bar-raising effect now correctly works on "another ally". A target will no longer receive multiple Move Bar-raising effects granted this way.

Lv. 3 level-up effects improved

Before: Increases dispelling chance to 80%.

After: Increases dispelling chance to 60%.

Lv. 4 level-up effects improved

Before: Increases debuffs to be dispelled to 2.

After: Increases dispelling chance to 80%.

Moonlit Fox Realm

The debuff that lasts 2 turns inflicted by Fox Bell when the enemy ends their turn will no longer be replaced by the debuff that lasts 1 turn inflicted by her normal attack.

We will be issuing compensations to all players who have a Divine Miketsu for this improvement:

For each grade 6 Divine Miketsu owned, a Grade 6 Shikigami Exchange Amulet will be issued in compensation

For each grade 5 Divine Miketsu owned, a Grade 5 Shikigami Exchange Amulet will be issued in compensation

For each Divine Miketsu owned who had her skill leveled up, regardless of her grade, a Skill Daruma will be issued in compensation for each skill leveled up, up to a maximum of 3 Skill Daruma.

For example, if a player has a grade 6 Divine Miketsu (skill levels at 5/5/5) and a grade 5 Divine Miketsu (skill levels at 1/2/1), the total compensation for them will be one Grade 6 Shikigami Exchange Amulet, one Grade 5 Shikigami Exchange Amulet, and 4 Skill Daruma.

Compensation claiming time: After maintenance on Jul 10th to Aug 10th, 23:59, 2019

In the meantime, we're setting the rules for compensation for SP shikigami:

For each grade 6 SP shikigami owned, a Grade 6 Shikigami Exchange Amulet will be issued in compensation

For each grade 5 SP shikigami owned, a Grade 5 Shikigami Exchange Amulet will be issued in compensation

For each SP shikigami owned who had their skill leveled up, regardless of their grade, a Skill Daruma will be issued in compensation for each skill leveled up, up to a maximum of 3 Skill Daruma.

2. Kosodenote

Threads Connection

The needle and thread summoned that inherits HP from the target now has an HP limit equal to 300% of Kosodenote's max HP.

3. Sakura's AI improved

Recovery

Now, when she has the Dance of Recovery status, she will no longer use the skill again.

[h1]Fixed Issues[/h1]

1. Fixed the issue where, when a shikigami equipped with a Scarlet Soul set or a Nightwing Soul set was KO'd while their Soul effects were sealed, their Soul set effects would sometimes fail to take effect even if they were revived.

2. Fixed the issue of Secret zones sometimes costing an incorrect amount of AP to challenge.

3. Fixed the issue of the model display of some shikigami and summoned entities missing actions or showing incorrect actions when they're inflicted with Daze.

4. Fixed the incorrect description and display error of Mio's skills.

5. Fixed the skill effect display error of Jr. Ootengu's passive skill Growing Feathers in the Shikigami Index.

6. Fixed the issue where opening and closing the Test of Courage page too frequently could cause the page to appear abnormally.

7. Fixed the skill description error of Hiyoribou's Sunny skill by changing "when an enemy ends their action" to "when an enemy ends their turn" to better reflect how the skill works in the game.

8. Fixed the issue of a disordered friends list appearing when the player tries to entrust their shikigami to a friend's realm.

notes.title: Join Kyohara Tea House Event! | Updates on July 3rd
notes.content:
Dear Onmyoji,

To ensure a better game experience, we will perform an update on Jul 03rd 00:00 EST. The server will not go down for this update, so just enjoy it :) 

[h1]Important Update[/h1]

[h1]1. Event - Kyohara Tea House[/h1]

As a bright light emanates from the Kyohara Tea House, beautiful music and an attractive singing voice resonate through the air. The villagers' curiosity is piqued. Where could this song be coming from? Onmyoji, please follow the singing voice and visit the Kyohara Tea House! 

Event period: After the maintenance on July 3rd, until July 16th 11:59 P.M. (EST) 

How to play: - During the event, players can present the Songstress with a “Flower”. In return, the Songstress will randomly flip a Koi-Koi and grant players a corresponding reward. When the number of “Flower” presented reaches a certain amount, players can receive “Tune Token”, which can be used to redeem additional event rewards.

※ “Flower” can be obtained by achieving 100 courage in Kimodameshi, challenging Assembly Bosses, purchasing Packs from the Pack Shop, etc. 

※Card Pool can be manually refreshed once 24 hours. If players flipped all 24 Koi-Koi, the lineup will be refreshed immediately. 

※By tapping/clicking on the Koi-Koi wall located on the left-hand side, players can select Golden Koi-Koi themselves. At first, Players can select up to 6 Golden Koi-Koi, and the selection limit will be increased as the number of flipped Koi-Koi reaches a certain amount. Eventually, players can select at most 9 Golden Koi-Koi rewards. 

※Reward: - Players can obtain various rewards by flipping Koi-Koi and can redeem rare items in the event shop, including an exclusive animated frame “Triste Soul”, Susabi’s exclusive skin “Golden Shrine”, Courtyard skin "Summer Night", and more! Onmyoji, are you able to reveal the identity of the Songstress? 

[h1]2. Demon Parade Chance Up![/h1]

Event Time: Jul 3rd after update - Jul 9th, 23:59 EST
During the event period, there will be an increased chance of obtaining Shikigami shards during the first 5 games each day! Onmyoji, have your beans ready!

[h1]3. Summer Festival: Earn Points and Get Prizes![/h1]

Event time: After the maintenance on July 3rd - July 16th 11:59 P.M. EST

How to play: 
- Players can gain scores after battling in the Exploration Zone, Evo Zone, Soul Zone, Realm Raid or Duel. 
- Players can also gain scores by summoning with Mystery Amulets, Jade, AR Amulets or Broken Amulets.
- Scores can be used to redeem lots of rewards including SSR Shikigami Shards.

Notice 

※After the event ends, the unused points will become void. 

※ Please note that players can only gain points by winning battles. No points will be awarded for losses in battle. 

※ Players who perform summons using Jade will not be granted points.

[h1]4. It's Time to Fight Together![/h1]

Event time: Jul 3rd after update - Jul 14th, 23:59 EST

How to play:
Courtyard → event → Co-op Combat Event
Here, players can team up with other players to gain points, which can be exchanged for valuable rewards.

Rewards:
Jade, Mystery Amulet, Soul drop rate buff, and more.

Note:
※Points gained are only valid during this event and will become void once the event ends.
※When exchanging rewards, points are directly deducted, and the item is directly awarded.

[h1]5.Shiranui Boss Challenge![/h1] 

Shiranui Boss will appear for players to challenge! 

Event period: July 3rd 08:00 A.M. - July 4th 10:00 P.M. EST 

Players can challenge Shiranui between 08:00 A.M. - 12:00 A.M. each day, with the highest damage dealt on each day being counted towards the ranking. The higher the rank, the better the rewards! After the event ends, players can continue to access the event page until July 9h 11:59 P.M. to redeem rewards.

Fixed Issues

Fixed language and technical bugs.

notes.title: New SSR Shiranui is coming! | Updates on June 26th
notes.content:
Dear Onmyoji,

In order to bring you a better gaming experience, the server will be shut down for [b]maintenance from 2:00 - 6:00 EST on June 26th[/b]. If it is not completed on time, the opening time will be postponed. For details regarding the update, please check the update announcement which will be posted later, or the game login page after the maintenance.

During the maintenance period, you will not be able to access the game from the server. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. Thank you for your support and understanding!

[h1]Important Update[/h1]

[h1]1. New Shikigami Info - SSR Shiranui![/h1]

※ Flame diva invites you to dance with fire! Brand new SSR shikigami Shiranui (VA: Nao Toyama) has arrived in Heian-Kyo!

※ After the maintenance on June 26th, summon via Mystery Amulet, Jade, or AR Amulet for a chance to form a pact with Shiranui!

[h1]2. Flame diva invites you for a dance with fire! Shiranui summoning event has begun![/h1]

※ Summoning Event: After maintenance on June 26th - July 2nd 23:59 EST

※ SSR shikigami Shiranui arrives in style, increasing your chance of summoning SP/SSR! Five great offers to reward players for summoning. May you be blessed by luck and summon some rare shikigami!

(The summoning event is available to all players who have reached Lv.15)

※ Important Rules:

All SSR Collected counts the SSR shikigami lit up in the Collection (excluding Ryomen).

All SSR Collected includes the SSR shikigami Shiranui that's being released in the current version, but does not include the limited-edition crossover SSR Medicine Seller, Hozuki, Inuyasha, Sesshomaru, and Kikyo.

Offer No.1: SP/SSR Chance UP event!

※ When summoning, players' chances of summoning SP/SSR shikigami will be increased by 2.5x! Each player can enjoy this SP/SSR Chance Up offer up to 3 times.

Offer No.2: SSR All Collected benefit has arrived!

Players who have completed the SSR All Collected achievement before the maintenance on June 26th can enjoy an extra bonus: When a rare shikigami (SP/SSR) is summoned, the SSR shikigami Shiranui's chance of being summoned is increased to 20%! After the SSR shikigami Shiranui is summoned, the chance is restored to normal.

※ Important Rules:

All SSR Collected counts the SSR shikigami lit up in the Collection (excluding Ryomen).

All SSR Collected does not include the limited-edition crossover SSR Medicine Seller, Hozuki, Inuyasha, Sesshomaru, and Kikyo.

Offer No.3: End Your Unlucky Streak!

※ Players who use Mystery Amulets, Jade, or AR Amulets to summon 10 times without summoning an SP/SSR shikigami during the event will receive 1 Mystery Amulet to help them end their unlucky streak!

Offer No.4: 10 R shikigami great reward pay out!

※ During the summoning event, the first time you summon with a Draw x10 and receive all R shikigami, you will be sent a Mystery Blessing!

(Note: Summoning with Draw x1 does not apply. Only applicable with summoning using Draw x10.)

Offer No.5: SR Choice Reward!

※ During the summoning event, for each 100 summons performed via Mystery Amulets, Jade, or AR Amulets, you will receive 1 SR shikigami of your choice.

[h1]3. Event - Shiranui Memory Scrolls[/h1]

※ Shiranui Memory Scrolls event starts.

※ Event Time: After maintenance on June 26th to July 16th 23:59 EST

※ During the event, take part in different zone challenges to receive Memory Scroll shards.

※ Donate shards to repair the Memory Scrolls. Each shard donated will grant you random rewards.

※ When a scroll is repaired, rewards for all players in a server will be issued based on their contributions.

※ The top 200 players in each server for each chapter will receive a SSR Shikigami Shiranui pact shard reward, and the top 500 players will each receive a Fire & Water avatar frame reward.

※ Once all Memory Scrolls are repaired, you won't receive any more Memory Scroll shards and will no longer be able to repair Memory Scrolls.

※ When all scrolls are unlocked, players can watch the short music animation, Tune of Sorrow, on the Memory Scrolls page.

[h1]4. New Demon Encounter Boss - Ghostly Songstress has arrived![/h1]

※ During the Demon Encounter, players have a chance to discover the large assembly boss: Ghostly Songstress.

※ Songstresses stands at the pinnacle of Yoshiwara, a prestigious position only few can achieve. They are the driving force for countless girls living in Yoshiwara.

Songstresses are embraced with treasures and praise, yet they cannot pursue the happiness of common people. Youth is always too short for them to find the one they want to live the rest of their life with. What awaits them is a life of hard labor when they're old, watching the young generations following their lives, watching the tragic circle continue before their life comes to an end in deep depression.

When songstresses and their maids pass away, most of them are buried collectively in the Temple of Cleansing without any rituals. No one cares about them.

The vengeful souls of those many songstress who died have now taken a new form. A giant vengeful soul dressed in a kimono in the Temple of Cleansing wails day and night. Sometimes it sounds as if they're reminiscing upon their good times, walking the flower walk, and sometime it sounds as if they're thinking about the passing of their youth.

※ Special Note: During the Isle of Sorrow event, all Demon Encounter bosses in the Demon Encounter event will be substituted by the Ghostly Songstress. She grants random Demon Encounter Boss Souls. Drop rate of the Demon Encounter Souls during the Isle of Sorrow event from Ghostly Songstress is doubled.

[h1]5. Listen to Song of the Isle of Sorrow echoing in the night[/h1]

Tamamonomae puts on his best dress and leads us to the legendary city of endless night life - Yoshiwara!

The legend of the great spirit Shiranui prevails in the city. However, the untold truth about the legend is hidden in the mist on the sea at nighttime.

※ Event Time: June 26th 08:00 - July 4th 23:59 EST

※ Starting from Day 2 of the event, one of the clues about Shiranui will be discovered daily. Complete story quests to collect all 6 clues to unravel the secret of Shiranui.

※ During the event, players will enter the commercial street of Yoshiwara where multiple gameplay features are available. Take part to receive all sorts of rewards. Take a stroll around the street and enjoy yourself.

※ Take part in the event to receive Courage from the commercial street.

[h1]6. Shiranui's Dance[/h1]

The legendary songstress arrives in the Isle of Sorrow at last. Shiranui Boss Defense event has begun!

※ Event Time: July 3rd 08:00 - July 4th 22:00 EST

※ Daily opening time: 08:00 - 24:00. The highest damage of the day will be counted towards the score of the day. Rewards are issued based on the total score.

※ When the event ends, the event access will still be open until July 11th 23:59 EST to help players exchange rewards.

[h1]7. Mentor's Guidance system updated, adding the Bond feature and co-op quests![/h1]

※ Added Mentorship Notice and co-op quests. Improved the current requirements to be a Mentor/Apprentice.

※ Mentorship Notice

In the Mentor's Guidance system, players can input their detailed info in the Mentorship Notice and post it. The Onmyoji Team will suggest Mentors/Apprentices that are most suitable for you based on the content posted.

※ Co-op Quests

When a Guidance relationship is established, the Mentor can spend 60 AP to issue a quest to their Apprentice every day. When both players complete the quest, sizeable rewards will be issued.

Mentor Rewards: 10 Orochi's Reverse Scales, a grade 2 Lightning Drum Realm Card, and a Co-op Quest Box for Mentor (Randomly grants Jade, Mystery Amulet, Skill Daruma Shard, and other such rewards)

Apprentice Rewards: 60 AP and a Co-op Quest Box for Apprentice (Randomly grants Grade Daruma Shard, 100% EXP Bonus, Lightning Drum III, and other such rewards)

Reminder: When the Mentor posts a quest, they can put 2 Souls of grade 5 or below into the box for their Apprentice. When the quest is completed, the Apprentice can receive the Souls given by their Mentor.

※ Requirements Adjusted

The Onmyoji Team has adjusted the requirements for Mentors and Apprentices.

Requirements for Mentors are now adjusted to Level ≥ 45 and ≥ 2,500 Achievement points.

Requirements for Apprentices have now been adjusted to one of the following:

1. Level < 45 and sign-in days ≤ 100

2. Level < 45 and grade 6 shikigami owned ≤ 4

The Onmyoji Team would like to express our sincere gratitude to players who actively help new players in the Heian world. We hope the improvements made in this update will help more new players in Heian-Kyo to find Mentors.

[h1]8. New additions - Skin shop updated[/h1]

※ Lord Arakawa's Azure Coral skin and Hako Shoujo's Origami Heart skin are now available in the Skin shop at a 20% discount for the first week. Players are welcome to head there and purchase them!

[h1]9. Illustration Shop updated![/h1]

※ New illustrations are available in the Mystic Shop - Illustration Shop. Players who are interested can head to the shop to purchase them.

Improvements

1. Improved guild leader dismissal rules

※ When the leader of a guild is offline for over 7 days, the leader dismissal function will become available at 00:00 the next day.

※ The dismissal procedure has two stages. If the guild has an officer who is offline for over 7 days, the first stage begins. Only officers can request to take leadership during this stage. If all officers in a guild are offline for over 7 days, the second stage starts. All common members who meet the requirements are eligible to request to dismiss the current leader and become the new leader.

※ Request requirements for common members: Has a higher total Feat than the leader and the weekly Feat gained from the previous week is over 400.

※ 3 days after the first request submitted, the Onmyoji Team will choose one person from all the members who requested to be the new leader (priority for officers) or the member who has the highest total Feat if the requested members have the same title.

※ During the dismissal procedure, if the leader logs in to the game, the dismissal ends. During the second stage, if an officer logs in to the game, the dismissal continues and the officer is also eligible to request for the leadership.

2. Improved the Shikigami Shard rewards players can receive from Wanted quests:

※ Froglet Shards are added to rewards that grant random N shikigami shards.

※ Mushishi Shards are added to rewards that grant random R shikigami shards.

※ Okikumushi, Ittan-momen, Nokanshi, and Bake-kujira Shards are added to rewards that grant random SR Shikigami Shards.

※ Higanbana, Menreiki, Onikiri, and Orochi Shards are added to rewards that grant random SSR Shikigami Shards.

※ R Shikigami Shards are removed from rewards that grant random shards III.

※ Slightly increased players chance of receiving SSR Shikigami Shards from rewards that grant random shards III.

3. Improved the model display of Hakuzosu by adding bells to one of his tails, making it consistent with his concept art.

4. Improved the name display of the zone names on the Secret Zone pages, making them clearer.

5. Improved the long delay of the system prompt that appears when the player summoned an SP/SSR shikigami via Draw x10.

6. Improved the appearance of the recommended graphics page. Now, when a player launches Onmyoji for the first time, they can choose a graphics setting from the recommendation page.

7. Added a head-turning effect to the Verdict Boss in Duel, allowing him to observe the battle progress with more attention.

8. The passive skills of Jikikaeru are removed from stage 3 of the Soul Zone and the Shikigami Shard Zone of Jikikaeru.

9. The event access paper doll on the top right of the Courtyard realized that he failed to get the attention of many players. Now whenever there's a new event, his sign will shine with a dynamic glow. He hopes this can grab the attention of all players.

[h1]10. Visual Updates[/h1]

※ Updated the in-battle model of Shishio before and after his evolution and his special edition Bleached Silk skin.

※ Updated the model display of Shishio's Violet Snow skin, Sea Dragon skin, and his special edition Bleached Silk skin, and Susabi's special edition Royalty skin.

※ Updated the summoning animations of Shishio and Susabi.

[h1]Fixed Issues[/h1]

1. Fixed the issue of the voice volume being too low when the player taps on the Hakuzosu on the Shikigami page.

2. Fixed the icon display error regarding Miketsu's Accessory.

3. Fixed the error where the part of Itsumade's Golden Feather's effect - "When dealt damage, transfers 1 layer of the mark (stacks up to 3 layers) onto the damage dealer" - still takes effect even when she's inflicted with a Seal.

4. Fixed the eye display error regarding some of the skin models of Ichimokuren.

5. Fixed the issue where ending the auto team up can sometimes affect the lineup lock status. Now the lock status will be returned to its original status before the auto team up.

6. Fixed an issue that caused Ichimokuren's Dark Memories skin to look abnormal.

Best,

Larry

notes.title: A new game for Showdown Bidding! | Updates on June 19th
notes.content:
Dear Onmyoji,
 
To ensure a better game experience, we will perform an update on June 19th  00:00 EST. The servers will not go down for this update, so just enjoy it :)
 
[h1]----Update Content----[/h1]
 
[h1]1. A new game for Showdown Bidding![/h1]

Event Time: June 19th 11:00 - June 22nd 23:00 EST
The deadline for claiming your rewards is June 25th 23:00 EST. Remember to collect all of your rewards before the deadline, as the event interface will not be accessible after the event ends.
 
[h1]2. As chic as ever![/h1]
 
New SP skins for Momo, Mouba, Zashiki, and Puppeteer are coming!
Onmyoji, please take a look and see if they tickle your fancy!
Event time: June 19th 00:00 - June 25th 23:59 EST
 
SP Skins lineup:
Momo - Bamboo Green
Mouba - True Red
Zashiki - Dark Blue
Puppeteer - Pale
 
How to get the SP skins:
- By using Mystery Amulets, AR Amulets or Jade to summon, players will have a chance to receive 1 SP skin. You can choose which SP skin you would like from the 4 above.
- Players can also redeem 1 SP skin using Gold Talismans in the event page, up to one time.
- Players can receive a total of 2 SP skins at most from this event.
 
Note: If the player forgets to pick up his or her skin when the event ends, a random SP skin not in the player's possession will be picked from the lineup and be delivered through in-game mail.

[h1]3. Exploration Monster Bonus-Up Event![/h1]
 
It’s time to visit the Explore Zone for rewards!
Event time: After the update on June 19th 00:00 - June 25th 23:59 EST
 
During the event, enemies in the Exploration Zone will have two reward bonuses at the same time, allowing you to earn more EXP, coins, or loot per battle!
 
[h1]4. Kaguya's Dreamland: Midsummer Boss Challenge[/h1]
 
Event time:  June 24th 2:00 - June 25th 22:00 EST
Location: Futamiokitama Shrine, Japan
 
How to play: 
1. During the event, all players around the world can challenge the boss Kaguya!
2. Spend Challenge times to challenge the boss. Every player starts with 3 challenge times.
3. Players recover 1 challenge time per hour. The maximum amount of challenge times is 3.
 
Rewards:
Players have a chance to obtain rewards such as Reality Rendezvous Frame, Ootengu Frame, Hakuro Frame, Yasha Frame and AR Amulet, Base Daruma, Jade etc., as well as coins!
 
Rendezvous with your fellow Onmyoji!
 
[h1]5. New limited packs are on sale![/h1]
 
The Event-Limited Pack will be added to the Pack Shop!
- The special item "Reality Blessing"
- Mystery Amulet x 1, AP x 20 (every day for 7 consecutive days)
By using the special item Reality Blessing, the amount of Challenge Coins dropped from the Boss Challenge will be increased.
 
Please don't miss out!
 
[h1]----Improvements----[/h1]
1. Fixed language and technical bugs.
