notes.title: New shikigami - SP Crimson Yoto! | Updates on May 29th
notes.content:
Dear Onmyoji,

In order to bring you a better gaming experience, the server will be shut down for maintenance from 2:00 - 6:00 EST on May 29th. If it is not completed on time, the opening time will be postponed. For details regarding the update, please check the update announcement to be posted later, or the game login page after the maintenance.

During the maintenance period, you will not be able to access the game from the server. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. Thank you for your support and understanding!

[h1]Important Update[/h1]

[h1]1. New shikigami - SP Crimson Yoto![/h1]

※ A crimson blade slices through the air! Brand new SP shikigami Crimson Yoto (VA: Shiori Izawa) arrives in Heian-Kyo!

※ After the maintenance on May 29th, summon via Mystery Amulet, Jade, or AR Amulet for a chance to form a pact with her!

[h1]2. Crimson Saber event comes with tons of rewards![/h1]

※ Summoning Event: After maintenance on May 29th - 23:59, June 4th EST

※ SP shikigami Crimson Yoto arrives in style, increasing your chance of summoning SP/SSR! Six great offers to reward players for summoning. May you be blessed by luck and summon those rare shikigami!

(The assembly and summoning event is available to all players who have reached Lv. 15.)

Offer No. 1: SP/SSR Chance UP event!

※ When summoning, players' chances of summoning SP/SSR shikigami will be increased by 2.5x! Each player can enjoy this SP/SSR Chance Up offer up to 3 times.

Offer No. 2: SSR All Collected benefit arrives!

※ Players who have completed the All SSR Collected achievement before the maintenance on May 29th are eligible to enjoy the special benefit of "When a rare shikigami (SP/SSR) is summoned, the chance of them being Crimson Yoto is increased to 15%" (one-time only).

※ Important Rules:

All SSR Collected counts the SSR shikigami lit up in the Collection (excluding Ryomen).

All SSR Collected does not include the limited-edition crossover SSR Rikuo Nura, Medicine Seller, Hozuki, Inuyasha, Sesshomaru, and Kikyo.

Offer No. 3: End Your Unlucky Streak project!

※ Players who use Mystery Amulets, Jade, or AR Amulets to summon 10 times without summoning an SP/SSR shikigami during the event will receive 1 Mystery Amulet to help you end your unlucky streak!

Offer No. 4: 10 R shikigami pay out great rewards!

※ During the summoning event, the first time you summon with a Draw x10 and receive all R shikigami, you will be sent a special gift!

(Note: Summoning with Draw x1 does not apply. Only applicable with summoning using Draw x10.)

Offer No.5: SR Choice reward!

※ During the summoning event, for each 100 summons performed via Mystery Amulets, Jade, or AR Amulets, you will receive 1 SR shikigami of your choice.

Offer No.6: Blazing Arrival illustration reward!

※ During the summoning event, when you collect SP Crimson Yoto through summoning or combining shards, you will also receive the corresponding limited-edition illustration!

[h1]3. Event - Crimson Yoto Memory Scrolls[/h1]

※ Crimson Yoto Memory Scrolls Rank Rewards - Crimson Blade event opens

※ Event Time: After maintenance on May 29th - 23:59, June 18th EST

※ During the event, take part in different zone challenges to receive Memory Scroll shards.

※ Donate shards to repair the Memory Scrolls. Each shard donated will grant you random rewards.

※ The top 200 players in each server for each chapter will receive the shards of the SP shikigami Crimson Yoto, and the top 500 players will each receive a Crimson Blade avatar frame reward.

※ Once all Memory Scrolls are repaired, you won't receive any more Memory Scroll shards and will no longer be able to repair Memory Scrolls.

※ We've improved the drop rate of all Memory Scroll shards. The Orochi of the Maidens: Moan stage now yields more Memory Scroll shards.

[h1]4. Themed Event - Illusory Moon[/h1]

※ Event Time: After maintenance on May 29th - 23:59, June 11th EST

An illusory moon loomed over Heian-Kyo, bringing a crimson menace to the world!

※ Brand new boss Winged Tsukinohime is arriving in Heian-Kyo.

※ Winged Tsukinohime arrives in Plateau of Encounter and will move towards Heian-Kyo via Mt. Septem, Mt. Gloom, and Mt. Oe. Players need to repel her before she arrives in Heian-Kyo to save the capital.

※ Players can access a map from the Courtyard to challenge Winged Tsukinohime, who is moving towards the capital.

※ Challenge battles include solo battles and Front and Rear Lineup battles.

Front and Rear Lineup battles:

This battle mode requires 1 player to deploy a Front Lineup and 2 players to each deploy a Rear Lineup.

The player who deploys the Front Lineup takes extra damage. The players who deploy the Rear Lineups take less damage.

※ Shikigami and monsters are also fighting against Winged Tsukinohime in their own territory. Everyone has united to face the common threat.

Two battles are available in the event based on the progress of Winged Tsukinohime: Pursuit Battle and Challenge Battle.

During the Challenge Battles, there will be shikigami acting as Stationed Shikigami who will receive 50% ATK and HP bonus in battles.

Stationed Shikigami details are as follows:

Challenge Battle of Plateau of Encounter: Tamamonomae, Yuki, and Ittan-momen

Challenge Battle of Mt. Septem: Yamakaze, Menreiki, and Ubume

Challenge Battle of Mt. Gloom: Ootengu, Yoto Hime, and Yuki Onna

Challenge Battle of Mt. Oe: Shuten Doji, Ibaraki Doji, and Momiji

※ The player's highest damage dealt to Winged Tsukinohime each day will be calculated towards the Total Score. After the event, rewards will be issued based on the Total Score. Rewards include an event-exclusive avatar frame, Skill Daruma, grade 5 Grade Daruma, and other rare items.

※ During the event, damage dealt to Winged Tsukinohime will be converted to a score at a fixed rate. The score is used to unlock and purchase the items in the Essence shop. Score can only be earned a limited amount of times each day.

※ After the Challenge Battle of an area is cleared, the Blood Moon Dreamland of that area will appear on the map.

Challenge the Blood Moon Dreamland to receive Moon Shards that you can use to increase the stats of your shikigami in the event.

※ After the event, access to the event will remain available until the maintenance on June 19th so players can exchange points for rewards in the Essence shop.

[h1]5. Orochi's Memory Scrolls Evil God Descends: Evil Unbound revamped and updated[/h1]

After the maintenance, players can tap the cherry tree in the Courtyard to watch the revamped Memory Scroll stories. We sincerely apologize for the delay. Players can claim a gift box from us after watching each story.

※ Details of the updated stories will be issued via in-game mail. Thank you for your attention and understanding.

[h1]6. New additions - Skin shop updated[/h1]

※ Shishio's Gilded Forester skin and Yaksha's Blood Thirst skin are now available in the Skin shop at a 20% discount for the first week. Players are welcome to head there and purchase them!

[h1]7. Upgraded the Achievement system[/h1]

※ 500-day login rewards have been added to the Achievements page. These rewards are extremely rich! Players can check the details in-game. The achievements list is also improved for easier browsing and searching.

[h1]8. Shrine updated - Jinmenju is now available in Shrine[/h1]

※ SR shikigami Jinmenju is now available in the Shrine. Players can exchange him by spending 3,500 Talismans.

[h1]9. Illustration shop updated[/h1]

※ New illustrations are available in the Illustration shop. Players who are interested can head to the shop to purchase them.

[h1]10.  Vision Update - Onmyoji[/h1] 

※The interface of Onmyoji has revamped, now you can enjoy the beautiful view of the courtyard from new Onmyoji scene.

※Improve four main characters' model quality, and also implement some modify of art details to make their apperance more appropriate.

※Now our four main character also have their own movement while interactive with them.

[h1]Shikigami Improvements[/h1]

[h1]1. Koi[/h1]

Bubble Shield

Improved the AI in auto mode. Now she will use the skill as long as there's an ally without a shield.

Bubble Cage

Improved the AI in auto mode. Now the skill prioritizes targeting the enemy with the highest Crit.

[h1]2. Improved how the Soul Aonyobo works in Royal Battles when the shikigami is in Frozen status.[/h1]

When taking lethal damage for the first time, removes all buffs and debuffs, recovers HP by 100% and inflicts Frozen on self for 1 turn. When under Frozen, DEF is increased by 100%, and gains immunity to all debuffs. If the shikigami survives the Frozen status, recovers HP by 100% again. Triggers only once each round.

[h1]Improvements[/h1]

1. Added refresh rules for SP skins in the Shrine Rules page.

2. Clarified the skill description of Kikyo's Soul Barrier. The "At the end of her turn, creates a soul barrier to protect herself." effect will not be triggered if she's unable to take actions. The current skill effects remain unchanged.

3. Clarified the skill description of Sesshomaru's Barrier: Tenseiga. When he takes lethal damage, all buffs and debuffs will be removed. The current skill effects remain unchanged.

4. Improved how the skill descriptions of shikigami skills are displayed in battles. Now they will only appear when you tap and hold the icons of the skills.

5. When Higanbana's Crimson Flowers deals damage to an enemy, the skill icon will now appear above Higanbana rather than the enemy who took the damage.

6. Improved the display of the front page when you entrust your shikigami to a friend. Now the page will no longer appear dark, whether or not their slots are occupied.

7. Improved the Soul icons in the Soul page where some of the icons appeared lower than others.

8. Now when you watch videos in the game, the background music will be turned off temporarily.

9. Improved the Mio model before and after her evolution.

10. Improved how the Guild Accompany quest works. When a leader has selected the quest, all guild members will now automatically claim the quest.

11. Improved the display of the Skill Daruma Shard Pack icon in the Feat Shop.

12. Fixed the quest descriptions of some of the mystery quests in Demon Encounter. They are now clearer.

13. Improved the icon display of events discovered in Demon Encounter. Now players can more easily find the location of the events they found.

14. Improved the model of Lord Arakawa's Furious Waters skin.

15. Improved the repeated display of the notification window that appears when releasing shikigami who have daily releasing limits.

[h1]Fixed Issues[/h1]

1. Fixed the issue in the Soul exchange page where the player would select a Boss Soul and tap the Exchange button, but the game would not correctly transition to the exchange page.

2. Fixed the issue of Kaoru's Warm Protection, where allies protected by Owl's Protection were affected by the Souls Mimic and Dawn Fairy.

3. Fixed the issue where in certain occasions, if only shikigami revived by Yao Bikuni's Divination Sigil remained on one side, that side would not be considered defeated. Now they will be considered defeated.

5. Fixed the issue where the damage reflected by Yao Bikuni's Divination Sigil could sometimes be damage that's neither single-targeted nor indirect damage. Also a shikigami that has gained immunity to damage will no longer be affected by this reflected damage.

5. Now if a field expires when multiple fields are active on the battlefield, the remaining active fields will display correctly.

6. Fixed the issue where some of the skill damage dealt was counted as normal damage dealt.

7. Fixed the missing skill sound FX of Tsuchigumo and Hako Shoujo in battles

notes.title: Crimson is Coming! | Updates on May 22th
notes.content:
Dear Onmyoji,

To ensure a better game experience, we are performing an update from May 22nd 2:00 to May 22nd 6:00 EST. During this time you will not be able to log in. The duration time is an estimate and may be extended due to technical issues. We really appreciate your patience and understanding.

[h1]----Update Content----[/h1]

[h1]1. Prepare：Crimson is Coming![/h1]

Event time: May 25th 0:00 until May 28th 23:59 EST

-Claim Assembly Summoning Box to receive a random SP Crimson Yoto's keepsake. Collect all 4 keepsakes required to receive her rewards, and even ONE chance to become the God of Luck of the summoning event which could DIRECTLY  receive the new shikigami!  

-During the assembly stage, with the assembly numbers growing, all players could not only claim Mystery Amulets as rewards, but would also unlock relative plots about Crimson Yoto on the same time.

[h1]2. Fortune Temple[/h1]

Event Time: May 23th 00:00 - May 29th 23:59 EST

-During the event, players can use coins, jade, medals, etc. in exchange for items in Fortune Temple. Each item can only be purchased once per day and the quota resets at 00:00 EST. The lineup will refresh every day.

[h1]3. Fortune Bonus Event![/h1]

Event Time: May 22nd 02:30 - May 28th 23:59 EST

-During the event, players have a chance of obtaining Evo Drops, Soul Drops, EXP and Coin bonuses after battling in Exploration Zone, Soul Zone or Evo Zone. The bonus duration for a bonus will be extended if the player has already obtained the same bonus.

[h1]4. Choose your favorite Soul Drops[/h1]

Event Time: May 25th 00:00 - May 26th 23:59 EST

-During the event, players can choose the type of souls that drop in Soul Zone. Players can choose 4 types of souls. However, the same soul cannot be chosen more than once in any lineup. After the lineup has been selected, players can edit the lineup at any time. The lineup applies to the first 200 challenges per day. After this, the dropping rate and types of souls will revert to normal.

[h1]----Optimizations and Bugs Fixed----[/h1]

1. Fixed language and technical bugs.

notes.title: Time For Guild Event "All For One!" | Updates on May 15th
notes.content:
Dear Onmyoji,

To ensure a better game experience, we will perform an update on May 15th 00:00 EST. The server will not go down for this update, so just enjoy it :)

[h1]----Update Content----[/h1]

[h1]1. Time For Guild Event "All For One!"[/h1]

Friendship Medals Submission: May 15th 00:00 – June 1st 23:59 EST
Rewards Claiming: May 29th 00:00 – June 1st 23:59 EST
How to play:
-During the event, players who complete the specific mission will receive friendship medals.
-Players will receive a reward for submitting friendship medals to their guild.
-All the submissions will be counted towards the guild total.
-At the end of the event, additional rewards will be presented to the players depending on the guild total.

Note:
- Before submitting friendship medals, you must first join and bind to a guild.
- If you change your guild after your submission, the submission will not be counted to your new guild.
- Players have to submit at least 80 friendship medals to receive the additional rewards from the guild.
- At the end of the event, members who met all the three event requirements above will receive guild rewards according to the total friendship medals the guild owned. Rewards will be sent via in-game mail.

[h1]2.Demon Parade Chance Up![/h1]

Event Time: May 15th 00:00 - May 21th, 23:59 EST
During the event period, the chances of the first 5 games each day will be increased! Onmyoji, have your beans ready!

[h1]3.Demon Encounter. Double Guild Medals! Up![/h1]

Event time:  May 15th 00:00 - May 21st 23:59 EST
During the event, Guild Medals obtained after challenging Demon Encounter 4 times will be doubled! This is a great chance to collect Guild Medals and redeem more rewards!

notes.title: Two SP Shikigami coming! | Updates on April 24th
notes.content:
Dear Onmyoji,
 
To ensure a better game experience, we are performing an update from [b]Apr. 24th 2:00 to Apr. 24th 6:00 EST[/b]. During this time you will not be able to log in. The duration time is an estimate and may be extended due to technical issues. We really appreciate your patience and understanding.
 
Update Content
 
[h1]1. Two SP Shikigami coming! [/h1]
 
Event time: after the update on April 24th until April 30th 23:59 EST
 
- All SP/SSR Shikigami chance up!
During the event, the summon rate for SP and SSR Shikigami will be 2.5 times the normal rate! 
 
Note: After the player has summoned 3 SP or SSR Shikigami during the event, the summon rate will revert back to normal.
 
- Uncollected SSR Shikigami
The first SP/SSR Shikigami summoned during the event is guaranteed to be a Shikigami the player has not previously owned!
 
Note: This will be prioritized over any other effects.
 
- SSR collection reward!
For players who complete the SSR collection before the update on April 24th, the appearance rate for the two new SP Shikigami is increased to 15% when an SP or SSR Shikigami is summoned. (This increased appearance rate only applies once.)
 
Note: 
- Only Shikigami that are lit up in the SSR Shikigami Collection will be counted. (Ryomen excluded)
- Crossover characters will not be taken into consideration when calculating the completion of the SSR collection.
- The player will receive a bonus increase to the appearance rate of SP Azurestorm Ichimokuren and SP Divine Miketsu, based on their completion progress.
 
- End Your Unlucky Streak!
During the event, players who do not obtain an SP or SSR Shikigami after performing 10 consecutive summons using Mystery Amulets, Jade, or AR Amulets will receive 1 Mystery Amulet.
 
- All R Summon x10 Rewards
During the event, the first time players perform Summon x10 and receive all R Shikigami, they will receive a mystery reward.
 
Note: This only applies to Summon x10. Single summons do not count.
 
- Choose an SR Shikigami
For every 100 summons using Mystery Amulets, Jade, or AR Amulets, players will receive an SR Shikigami of their choosing.
 
- Gods' Arrival Illustration
Players who summon SP Azurestorm Ichimokuren or SP Divine Miketsu during the event period using Mystery Amulets, Jade, AR Amulet, or shards will obtain an exclusive illustration of the corresponding Shikigami!
 
[h1]2. Orochi of the Maidens: Moans[/h1]
 
New Soul zone "Orochi of the Maidens: Moans" will be available after the update on April 24th!
 
The following souls will be added to this new soul zone:
Monday: Sea Sprite
Tuesday: Yamabiko
Wednesday: Soultaker
Thursday: Nightwing
Friday: Kyoukotsu
 
Note:
- Only players who have cleared stage-10 Orochi Zone in solo mode will be able to challenge this new soul zone.
- The newly added souls will not affect the soul drop in Soul zone stage 1 – stage 10.
- Players who clear this new soul zone within a certain time limit in solo mode will be awarded an Orochi of the Maidens Mark.
 
[h1]3.Double Memory Scrolls Event![/h1]
 
Azurestorm Ichimokuren Memory Scroll
Event time: after the update on April 24th - May 21st 23:59 EST
 
How to play:
- Players can obtain scroll shards by participating in different activities in the game. 
- Donate scroll shards to help repair the memory scrolls. Players will obtain a random reward for every donation.
- After a memory scroll has been fully repaired, rewards will be awarded to all players according to their donation ranking.
- For each memory scroll, players rank 200 or higher will receive SP Shikigami Azurestorm Ichimokuren shards. Players ranked 500 or above will receive the "Gods' Arrival Frame". 
- After all memory scrolls have been repaired, players can no longer obtain or donate scroll shards.
 
Divine Miketsu Memory Scroll: Sunlit Miketsu
Event time: after the update on April 24th - May 21st 23:59 EST
 
How to play:
- Players can obtain scroll shards by participating in different activities in the game. 
- Donate scroll shards to help repair the memory scrolls. Players will obtain a random reward for every donation.
- After a memory scroll has been fully repaired, rewards will be awarded to all players according to their donation ranking.
- For each memory scroll, players rank 200 or higher will receive SP Shikigami Divine Miketsu shards. Players ranked 500 or above will receive the "Gods' Arrival Frame". 
- After all memory scrolls have been repaired, players can no longer obtain or donate scroll shards.
 
[h1]4. Blessings from Divine Miketsu[/h1]

Event time: after the update on April 24th until May 8th 2:00 EST
During the event, players can use the tokens of the Goddess - Miketsu Coins - to make wishes in her shrine. The Goddess of Prosperity and Success will listen to all wishes made and light up Ema as rewards.
 
[h1]5. New Skins for You![/h1]

- After the update on April 24th, Zashiki's new skin "Firework Display" will be available in the skin shop with 20% off for the first week! 
- After the update on April 24th, Ryomen's new skin "Thunder Daredevil" will be added to the Honor shop. Don't miss out!
- After the update on April 24th, Momo's new skin "Nectarine Scent" will be added to the feat shop, where players can redeem it using the feat.
 
[h1]6. Illustrations Feature Update![/h1]

After the update on April.24th, the UI of Illustration and Illustration Shop will update! And new illustrations added in the shop with stories are for you! Come to check them out!
 
[h1]Game Improvements[/h1]

1. Added a switch to allow players to auto-feed Sakuramochi to the paper doll in auto mode. When Auto-feed is enabled, Sakuramochi will be fed automatically to the paper doll in auto mode, provided the player has enough Sakuramochi, AP, and feeding attempts remaining.
2. Shikigami pool in Royal Battle will reset after the update. Players will need to configure their lineups again.
3. Added 2 default images for Guild Nameplate. They will be displayed if the Leader doesn't upload any images.
4. Added special display actions to some of Kingyo's skins.
5. Added a visual effect to the target protected by Hakuzosu's Shadowing Shelter skill that he has after his evolution.
6. Added the name of the player who upgraded the guild to the upgrade notice.
 
[h1]Fixed Issues[/h1]

1. Fixed the abnormal visual effect that sometimes occurred when multiple field effects were stacked during battle.
2. Fixed the errors in some of the scenarios in Heian Tales: Sakura Fest.
3. Fixed the issue where the effect of granting a new turn took effect after a round ends, causing the player to take the newly granted turn in the next round.
4. Fixed the issue where Heian Tales: Sakura Fest was still shaded even after being completed.
5. Fixed the model of Dodomeki after her evolution, where her eyeball visuals were blocked.
6. Fixed the issue where the player could still use their buddies' co-op shikigami even after unfriending them.
7. Improved the frame style of photos in chat channels and players' Pages to prevent the frames from blocking the content of the photos as much as possible.
8. Improved the display of the Guild Realm Raid progress bar when the progress reaches 100%.
9. Added a second confirmation prompt when the player uses a shikigami at max level as a material to upgrade another shikigami.
10. Added Shikigami Name to the filters on the Shikigami page so players can check the shikigami they have of the same name.
11. Improved the Soul sorting function. Players can now tap again on the selected Souls Stats to cancel selection.
12. Improved the Shops by moving the S-Jade to Jade exchange function to the Pack Shop and renaming the Jade Shop to S-Jade Shop.
13. Players who are banned from posting comments can no longer share Guild Nameplates with any chat channel.
14. Fixed the issue with the Soul Odokuro where its damage boosting effect, granted when taking damage from a monster, remained in effect even when the round ended.
15. Fixed the issue where players who have collected all the shikigami on the Index are unable to complete the related achievement.
16. Fixed the issue where Secret Zones allowed the player to enter in incorrect ways, regardless of the level requirements.
17. Fixed the continuity issue with Tenjo-kudari's celebration action displayed when she wins a battle.
18. Fixed the issue with Yoto Hime Frog's Croak: Savage Combo skill not dealing more damage when the skill is leveled up.
19. Fixed the issue where Soul Rift inflicted by Nokanshi's Soulsplit skill was affected by Effect HIT. Now the status works like other indirect damage dealing effects that are guaranteed to hit.
20. Improved the description of Hozuki's Full Control skill, clarifying that its effect triggers upon attacking rather than on dealing damage.
21. Removed the word Evolved on the shikigami bio page.
22. Fixed the issue where the link may be displayed incorrectly when sharing a pre-set lineup with the guild channel.
23. Fixed the issue with the New button on the Area Boss page, where the button's disappearance logic was inconsistent with other buttons.
24. Fixed the issue with Kaoru's Vigilant Owl skill where the effect that should be inflicted when the skill is at max level took effect even when it was not at max level. Also, the Alert status she has is now correctly removed when she changes the status to Play.
 
[h1]Skill Improvements[/h1]

1. Improved the description of Oguna's Soul Offering skill, clarifying that he revives all allies before he sacrifices himself.
2. Improved the description of Shiro's Soul Call skill, clarifying that the Protection of Shiro he creates is a shielding effect by adding the wording "counts as a shield."
3. Improved the descriptions of some of the skills that were mistakenly described as healing effects where they should be recovery effects. Affected skills include Hako Shoujo's Retrace skill, Kyuumei Neko's Nine Lives skill, Tanuki's Drunken Stupor skill, Gaki's Voracious skill, Kyonshi Ani's Resurrection skill, Jikikaeru's Change of Luck skill, and the Brutal skill of Tomato, who is summoned by Kyonshi Imouto's Dog Attack skill.

notes.title: Cherry Blossom Season! Sakura Forecast! | Updates on April 3rd
notes.content:
Dear Onmyoji,
To ensure a better game experience, we are performing an update from [b]Apr. 3rd 2:00 to Apr. 3rd 5:00 EST[/b]. During this time you will not be able to log in. The duration time is an estimate and may be extended due to technical issues. We really appreciate your patience and understanding.

[h1]----Update Content----[/h1]

[h1]1. Cherry Blossom Season! Sakura Forecast![/h1] 

The warm breeze from the south signals the start of the cherry blossom season, with the residents of Heian-Kyo eagerly waiting for the blooming scenes. Come and join the Shikigami under the cherry blossom trees, along with a new Scrapbook decoration system waiting to be explored!

Event Time: After the update on April 3rd - April 16th 23:59 (EST) 

How to play:
- Gain 100 Courage and unlock a new "Hanami" event per day. 
- Players will get rewards including Skill Daruma, G6 Realm Card, and Sakura Coins, etc. by completing "Hanami" in different areas. 
- Sakura Coins can be exchanged within letter paper and stickers in Scrapbook Shop. Players will receive additional Sakura Forecast souvenir after the exchange. 
- Collect items to decorate your own Scrapbook! Players who share their creation for the first time will obtain 1 AR Amulet. 

[h1]2. Spring Battle event[/h1]

Event Time: April 3rd 00:00 - April 16th 23:59 EST

How to play: 
- Players can receive points through battles in Exploration Zone, Evo Zone, Soul Zone, Realm Raid, and Duel, etc.
- Players can also receive a point by summoning using Broken Amulets, Mystery Amulets, and AR Amulets, etc.
- Points can be exchanged for various rewards, including Coins, Jade, Mystery Amulet, Daruma and more!

Note:
- Points will become invalid once the event ends, please exchange your points in time.

[h1]3. Coin Chaos returns![/h1] 

Event Time: April 3rd 00:00 - April 16th 23:59 EST

Complete the following missions to obtain coins!
- Summon 3 times with Mystery Amulets, AR Amulets or Jade
- Obtain 100 Courage in Kimodameshi
- Participate in 5 Duels

Note: 
The missions reset daily at 00:00 EST and unclaimed rewards will be lost. Please remember to claim your rewards before they expire!

[h1]----Optimizations and Bugs Fixed----[/h1]
1. Fixed language and technical bugs.
2. Added another April Fortune Pack for players who cannot purchase the current April Fortune Pack.

notes.title: Divine Descent: Eye of Orochi! | Updates on March 27th
notes.content:
Dear Onmyoji,

To ensure a better game experience, we are performing an update from [b]Mar. 27th 2:00 to Mar. 27th 6:00 EST[/b]. During this time you will not be able to log in. The duration time is an estimate and may be extended due to technical issues. We really appreciate your patience and understanding.

[h1]----Update Content----[/h1]

[h1]1. Divine Descent: Eye of Orochi![/h1]

After the update on March 27th, using Jade, Mystery Amulets or AR Amulets will have a chance to summon SSR Shikigami Orochi! The following summon events will also be held at the same time, so don't miss out on this great chance!

Event Time: After the update on March 27th - April 2nd 23:59 EST
* The summon events are available to players level 15 or above.

- All SP/SSR Shikigami chance up!
During the event, the summon chance of SP and SSR Shikigami will be 2.5 times the normal chance!
Note: After the player has summoned an SP or SSR Shikigami for 3 times, the summon chance will revert back to normal.

- SSR collection reward!
For players who complete the SSR collection before the update on March 27th, the appearance rate for SSR Orochi is increased to 20% when an SP or SSR Shikigami is summoned. After a player has summoned the first SSR Orochi during the event, the appearance rate will revert back to normal.
Note: Only Shikigami that are lit in the SSR Shikigami Collection will be counted (Ryomen excluded). SSR Collection does not include crossover characters Medicine Seller, Hozuki, Inuyasha, Sesshomaru, and Kikyo.

- End Your Unlucky Streak！
During the event, players who do not obtain an SP or SSR Shikigami after performing 10 consecutive summons with Mystery Amulets, Jade, or AR amulets will receive 1 Mystery Amulet.

- All R Summon x10 Rewards!
Players who perform 10x summon and receive all R Shikigami for the first time during the event will receive a mystery reward.
Note: This only applies to 10x summon. Single pulls do not count.

[h1]2. Orochi Memory Scrolls![/h1]

Time: After the update on March 27th - April 16th 23:59 EST
Players can obtain scroll shards by participating in different activities in the game. Donate scroll shards to help repair the memory scrolls. Players will obtain a random reward for every donation. After a memory scroll has been fully repaired,  rewards will be awarded to all players according to their donation ranking. 

NOTE!
- In order to enrich the storyline and provide players with a better experience, the Memory Scrolls content is under revision and the video is not currently available. 
- While the Memory Scrolls event will start after the patch update on March 27th, the story won't be unlocked until we complete the revision.
- The reward of the Memory Scrolls will not be affected due to the revision, you can still get the rewards.

We regret any inconvenience caused to players & thank you for your understanding and patience!

[h1]3. Get ready for new BOSS Shinkirou! [/h1]

After the update on March 27th, new Assembly Boss Shinkirou will appear in Demon Encounter! Players can challenge the new boss Shinkirou on Monday and Tuesday every week. The weekly challenge for Assembly Boss Odokuro and Namazu will be adjusted to Wednesday and Thursday respectively.

[h1]4.  Friendship Pack x Ame Onna Limited Skin event![/h1]

Event Time: After the update on March 27th - April 23rd 23:59 EST

Participate in the Friendship Pack x Ame Onna Limited Skin event to obtain Ame Onna's new skin "Lady in the Snow"!Players who redeem this skin during the event period will obtain a "Vitality" frame as a bonus!

[h1]5. The Descent of Froglets![/h1]

Beware as the froglet army strikes on April Fools Day!
Event Time: April 1st 00:00 - April 1st 23:59 EST
During April Fools Day, players who clear Exploration Zone will have a chance to encounter Froglets Descent Demon Seal. Participate in this event for a chance to obtain the April Fools Day exclusive Kamaitachi frame!

If you miss the event, you'll still have the chance to obtain the April Fools Day exclusive Kamaitachi frame by purchasing the Kamaitachi Pack in Store until April 2nd 23:59 EST.

Note: if you have already owned the Kamaitachi frame, it will be automatically converted as 401 coins when you obtain it again. 

[h1]6. New Skins on Sale![/h1]

Shouzu's new skin “Ocean Beauty”  and Hakuro's new skin “Sakura Archer”  will be available for purchase in the Skin Store after the update on Mar. 27th. They will be 20% off for the first week, so don’t miss out!

[h1]7. Shikigami Bios Improved![/h1]

The display and the interface of Shikigami Bios improved! And we released new bios for part of Shikigami including Ootengu, Yoto Hime, Enma, Higanbana and Menreiki. After unlock the new bios, you will get the new accessories and skill-casting effects. Unlocking the new bios needs a certain Shikigami affection. Sending gifts can add Shikigami affection. Those gifts can be obtained from Kimodameshi, Feat Shop for the guild, Demon Encounter, Friendship Packs, purchasing Special Gift pack in the store and so on. The price of the Special Gift pack will be 50% off for the first 2 weeks.

Note: Currently it's not possible to unlock bios by winning practice battles even some unlocking hints said that. The practice battle mode now is not available. 

[h1]8. New loading pictures added![/h1]

After the update on Mar. 27th, we update the default loading pictures and added more in the store. Let's come to have a check!

[h1]9. New Opening CG! (Only for Mobile Devices)[/h1]

The  Evil God Orochi is preparing to descend upon Heian-Kyo! Please enjoy the new opening CG of the evil god Orochi!

[h1]----Improvements----[/h1]
1. Speeded up the skill-casting speed of Kikyo's Soul Barrier skill.
2. Optimized Momiji's model before her evolution, making the new model more consistent with the concept of art.
3. Players can now easily check if their Shikigami are equipped with Souls at the start of an Ultimate Orochi zone challenge.
4. A slide bar is added when selecting Shikigami at the start of an Ultimate Orochi zone challenge.
5. Hungry and unhappy status displayed above the pet in your courtyard have been removed. You can still check their status in your Pet House.
6. Optimized the display of the Shikigami page when the player has no Shikigami.
7. Optimized the skill-casting AI ofKoroka's Silence Prank skill. Under auto mode, the skill will now be cast on a random enemy with Prank status.
8. Optimized the rules for making wishes: If you have collected a Shikigami before, you can make a wish for the shard of the Shikigami even if you currently don't have a shard or a pact of the Shikigami.

[h1]----Fixed Issues----[/h1]
1. Fixed the issue of lack of highlight in the left eye of Kusa's model.
2. In-battle Carp Banner that counts as taking a turn will no longer trigger skill effects likeJuzu's Karma (which gains her a Bead when an enemy takes an action).
3. Corrected the skill description of Shiro's Soul Call skill. The Protection of Shiro should be "Sustainable for 1 turn" rather than “Lasting for 1 turn".
4. Clarified the skill description of Hiyoribou's Nourishment skill. Added the line of "If multiple Hiyoribou are present, all of their Sunshine Dolls will be sacrificed." to clarify the co-related effect.
5. Fixed the issue of when a Shikigami is granted a new turn by a skill effect, a Move Bar lowering effect would cause the Shikigami to lose the chance to take actions.
6. Revised the skill description of Hako Shoujo's Retrace skill with the line "Effective immediately when a preserved ally would be KO\'d from taking damage, preventing the ally from taking lethal damage." to clarify its effect.
7. Fixed the effects regarding revival skills. Under some circumstances, the debuffs on the revived Shikigami are not removed.
8. Fixed the incorrect interaction between the Souls Senecio and Yamabiko regarding incorrectly inflicting Daze.
9. Fixed the issue of a counter-attack launched by the Onmyoji's Totem, which will gain Juzu a Bead for her skill Karma.
10. Fixed the inconsistency error in the models of Inuyasha before and after his evolution.
11. Fixed the display error of some of the in-battle effects of Sesshomaru's Demonic Aura skin.
12. Fixed the display error of Menreiki's Red Asura Masks accessory on some devices.
13. Fixed the incorrect in-battle voices of Menreiki when she's in her evolved skin.

notes.title: Final Stage of Onmyoji x Inuyasha Crossover Event! | Updates on March 13th
notes.content:
Dear Onmyoji,
 
To ensure a better game experience, we are performing an update [b]from Mar. 13th 2:00 to Mar. 13th 5:00 EST[/b]. During this time you will not be able to log in. The duration time is an estimate and may be extended due to technical issues. We really appreciate your patience and understanding.
 
[h1]----Update Content----[/h1]
 
[h1]1. The final stage of the Onmyoji x Inuyasha crossover event is here! [/h1]

Event Time:  After the update on March 13th - March 19th 23:59 EST
 
- During the event, summon with Mystery Amulets, Jade, or AR Amulets for a chance to get Inuyasha, Sesshomaru or Kikyo shards! Players can designate the shard they want before summoning and can change their choice at any time.
- This is the 3rd and final stage of the Onmyoji x InuYasha Crossover Event! Limited SSR Character Inuyasha, Sesshomaru, and Kikyo can only be acquired through this event.
- Inuyasha, Sesshomaru, and Kikyo can only be acquired by collecting shards. They cannot be obtained directly from summoning.
- Players lvl 15 or above can participate in the summoning of Inuyasha, Sesshomaru, and Kikyo
- Players lvl 40 or above can donate or wish for Inuyasha, Sesshomaru, and Kikyo shards in the guild
- Inuyasha, Sesshomaru, and Kikyo are not included in the Shikigami Collection.
 
[h1]2. Summon Event also to come![/h1]
- During the last Onmyoji x Inuyasha Crossover Event, the chance of summoning an SP/SSR Shikigami will be increased to 2.5 times! The summoning chance will revert to normal after summoning your first SP/SSR Shikigami during this event.
- During the event, for every 100 summons (via Mystery Amulet, Jade or AR Amulet), players can obtain 1 SR Shikigami of their choice.
 
[h1]3. Get ready for Inuyasha Demon Seal![/h1]
- During the event, players who clear Exploration Zone will have a chance to encounter Inuyasha's Demon Seal, clearing it will have a chance of obtaining shards of Inuyasha, Sesshomaru, Kikyo and Inuyasha's "Scar of the Wind" skin shard.
- Players can obtain at most 1 Inuyasha shard, 1 Sesshomaru shard, 1 Kikyo shard and 4 "Scar of the Wind" skin shard per day.
 
Dear Onmyoji, this will be the last chance to meet the trio before they bid farewell to Heian-Kyo!
 
[h1]4. Limited Skins for Inuyasha and Sesshomaru on Sale![/h1]
 
- Inuyasha's Scar of the Wind skin shard can be obtained via Demon Encounter, Inuyasha Demon Seal from Mar. 13th after update to Mar. 19th 23:59 EST.
- Sesshomaru's Demonic Aura skin shard can be obtained via Kimodameshi from Mar. 14th 00:00 to Mar. 19th 23:59 EST.
- All skin shards above including the previous Kikyo's Fall Bellflower skin shard can be obtained via purchasing in General of Mall from Mar. 13th after update to Mar. 19th 23:59 EST.
 
[h1]5. New Secret Zone coming[/h1]
 
After the update on March 13th, a new Secret Zone “Yuki’s Memories” will be added. Challenge Yuki’s Secret Zone to witness the power of blizzard and get the special reward: Yuki’s new skin “Snowy Winter”.
 
[h1]6. Listen to the tales of the wind![/h1]
 
After the update on Mar. 13th, the new side chapter "Wind Shield" will be available! Dear Onmyoji, please listen to the forgotten story in the wind!
 
[h1]7. New Skins on Sale![/h1]
 
Bukkuman's new skin “Voyaging Farseeker”  and Inugami’s new skin “Sakura Flurry”  will be available for purchase in the Skin Store after the update on Mar. 13th. They will be 20% off for the first week, so don’t miss out!
 
[h1]8. Growing Happiness frame[/h1]

Time: After the update on March 13th
 
- After the update on March 13th, players can obtain the “Growing Happiness” frame by summoning (via Mystery Amulet, Jade, or AR Amulet) 10 times.
- After obtaining the "Growing Happiness" frame, every time a player summons using Mystery Amulets, Jade or AR Amulets, EXP will be added to the frame. 
-  Players will obtain a certain amount of initial EXP on the "Growing Happiness" frame when they first obtain the frame, based on the progress of the player's SP/SSR Shikigami collection (Including Ryomen and Crossover Event Characters) before the update on March 13th.

notes.title: "Inferno Ibaraki Doji" is arriving! | Updates on February 27th
notes.content:
Dear Onmyoji,
 
To ensure a better game experience, we are performing an update from [b]Feb. 27th 2:00 to Feb. 27th 6:00 EST[/b]. During this time you will not be able to log in. The duration time is an estimate and may be extended due to technical issues. We really appreciate your patience and understanding.
 
[h1]----Update Content----[/h1]
 
[h1]1.  New SP Shikigami "Inferno Ibaraki Doji" is arriving, here are the summoning events that come along![/h1]
 
Time: After the update on Feb. 27th - March 5th 23:59 EST
 
- All SP/SSR Shikigami chance up!
During the event, the summon chance of SP and SSR Shikigami will be 2.5 times the normal chance! 
Note: After the player has summoned an SP or SSR Shikigami 3 times during the event, the summon chance will revert back to normal.
 
- Uncollected SSR Shikigami
The first SSR Shikigami summoned during the event is guaranteed to be a Shikigami the player has not previously owned!
Note: This is only valid with SSR Shikigami summon, SP Shikigami is not included.
 
- SSR collection reward!
For players who complete the SSR collection before the update on February 27th, the appearance rate for SP Inferno Ibaraki Doji is increased to 15% when an SP or SSR Shikigami is summoned. For every 50 summons, this chance will increase by 1%.
Note: 
- After a player has summoned the first SP Inferno Ibaraki Doji during the event, the summon rate of SP Inferno Ibaraki Doji will revert back to normal.
- Only Shikigami that are lit in the SSR Shikigami Collection will be counted. (Ryomen excluded)
- SSR Collection does not include crossover characters.
 
- End Your Unlucky Streak
During the event, players who do not obtain an SP or SSR Shikigami after performing 10 consecutive summons with Mystery Amulets, Jade, or AR amulets will receive 1 Mystery Amulet.
 
- All R Summon x10 Rewards
Players who perform Summon x10 and receive all R Shikigami for the first time during the event will receive a mystery reward.
Note: This only applies to Summon x10. Single pull does not count.

[h1]2 New SR Shikigami Jinmenju gets on the stage![/h1]
 
After the update on February 27th, SR Shikigami Jinmenju will come to Heian-Kyo! At the same time, there will be a Jinmenju Friendship Pack Event!
 
Event time: After the update on February 27th - March 12th, 23:59 EST
During the event, invite friends to join the event to obtain Jinmenju shards!
Note: Each player can invite 2 friends at most per day, and can be invited by one friend per day.

[h1]3. New Chapters Released![/h1]

After the update on February 27th, new chapters of the main story - Chapter 27 "Loneliness of the Sea" and Chapter 28 "Girl and Her Masks" will be unlocked, along with new Exploration Zones!
 
[h1]4. New Skins on Sale![/h1]

Yoto Hime's new skin "Battle-forged Warrior" and Ibaraki Doji's new skin "Hellfire Warlord" will be available for purchase in the Skin Store after the update on February 27th. They will be 20% off for the first week, so don’t miss out!
 
[h1]5. Special Events for Girls' Day![/h1]

As the weather warms up, not only spring is on the doorstep. The Japanese traditional Hinamatsuri (Girls' Day) festival is also just around the corner! Here are special events celebrating it for you!
 
- Collect! Exquisite Hina Dolls!
Event Time: March 3rd 00:00 - March 16th 23:59 EST
During the event, collect and use various combinations of Hina Dolls (Doujo, Chocho, Futakuchi, and Kusa dolls) to exchange for Grade 4 Gourmet Realm Cards.
Rewards can be exchanged repeatedly. Each Gourmet Realm Card can be exchanged up to 7 times during the event!
 
- Skins Discount!
Event Time: March 3rd 00:00 - March 6th 2:30 EST
During the time, all skins selling in the store of Kagura, Kaguya, Kingyo, Doujo, Kusa, Chocho, and Kyonshi Imoto will be  20% off. Let's celebrate with these cute girls!
 
- Girls' Day Pack!
Event Time: March 3rd 00:00 - March 5th 23:59 EST
Pack contains:
*Girls\' Day frame
*AR Amulet x3
*Daily rewards for 7 days: Mystery Amulet x1, G6 Random Soul
 
[h1]6. New loading pictures added![/h1]

After the update on Feb. 27th, we update the default loading pictures and added more in the store. Let's come to have a check!
 
[h1]----Improvements----[/h1]

1. Visual updates: 
- Updated the in-battle model of Higanbana and Miketsu before and after their evolution.
- Updated the display and in-battle model of Higanbana's Pearly White, Cavorting Candles, and special edition Bleached Silk skins.
- Updated the display and in-battle model of Miketsu's Bountiful Harvest and special edition Bamboo skins.
-  Updated the summoning animations of Higanbana and Miketsu.
- Updated the model display of Ubume before and after her evolution.
-  Updated the model display of Ebisu before and after her evolution.
2. Improvements to Guild Supplies: 
-  When the AP supply is available to claim, a notification will appear on the guild medal.
-  The Bento Box can store up to 20 supplied AP.
-  Players can choose to claim supplied AP from nearby guilds or their own guilds.
3. Improved the notice that appears when submitting Evo materials for guild quests. Now when players have a sufficient amount of Evo materials, the amount required for the quest will be submitted by default.
4. Revised how N shards are described in rule text for making a wish in a guild. Also added a rule specifying that players can only receive up to 1 SP shard each time.
5. Improved the AI of Shiro Mujou. He no longer uses Soul Hunt when there are only a few enemies left now.
6. Improved how the Guild Raid selection page is displayed on some devices, making it fit the whole screen.
7. Improved the message display duration in the guild channel. Some messages will now disappear after 2 minutes. This should avoid too many expired messages being displayed on the guild channel. These messages include: 
- All team up messages
- Push notifications of guild raid defeat
- Players' blessings when others summon SSR/SP Shikigami via amulets/combining shards
- Notices of players claiming Gift Envelopes
8. Improved how the Guild Raid selection page is displayed. A sorting function based on guild medals has been added on the right to help players choose.
9. Changed the Apprentice level requirement for the Mentor system. The lowest level required for an Apprentice is now Lv. 1 instead of Lv. 12.
10. Improved the coin bonus icon displayed when a Tesso is deployed in battle.
11. Improved the animation and special effects of Kisei's Maple Master skin.
12. Slightly reduced the power of Sakura as a monster in the stage 10 of the Secret Zone: Riverside Tales.
13. Profiles with no Souls can now be added to Soul Profiles.
 
[h1]----Fixed Issues----[/h1]

1. Fixed the special effect display inconsistency between the model and the concept art of Umibozu's Tender of Sea skin.
2. Fixed the issue of Shikigami avatar sizes being too big for frames.
3. Fixed an issue in the Secret Zone: Life of Higanbana where some of the monster souls summoned by Shiro's skill were unable to perform normal attacks.
4. Fixed the display error regarding where players can obtain the 3 Souls (Tree Nymph, Soul Edge, Senecio) obtainable in the Sougenbi zone.
5. Fixed the display errors when swapping pets in the courtyard.
6. Fixed the errors in guild info, level, and players limit displayed to players who are not in any guild.
7. Fixed language and technical bugs.

notes.title: Paper Crane Wishes! | Valentine's Day Updates on February 13th
notes.content:
Dear Onmyoji,

To ensure a better game experience, we have performed [b]Valentine's Day update on Feb 13th 00:00 EST[/b]. The servers were not going down for this update, please enjoy the game :)

[h1]----Update Content----[/h1]

[h1]1. New Challenge: Okuribito Defense[/h1] 

Okuribito and Ittan-momen are arriving in Heian-Kyo. Onmyoji, are you ready for the new defense?

Event Time:
Challenge Stage: Feb. 14th - Feb. 20th (EST) 
Daily Opening Hours: 2:00 - 24:00 EST
Display Stage: Feb. 21st 00:00 - Feb. 22nd 23:59 EST

 Event Rules
- Players of level 30 and above are eligible to participate. 
- Each challenge costs 5 AP with no limitation on the number of attempts. 
- Defense Damage is calculated based on the damage dealt with Okuribito/Ittan-momen (damage to minions won't be calculated). The highest Defense Damage of the day will be calculated towards each day's Defense Scores. 
- Defense Scores in each zone are calculated separately. Two scores sum up to the day's Defense Score. The Defense Score of each day sums up to the Event Total Score. 
- Defense Damage dealt in team mode will only be calculated into Individual Accumulated Damage and the total Defense Damage of all players on the server. It will not be calculated into the Defense Score or will not be counted in ranking.
- As some shikigami have healing ability, the real-time score may be reduced when Okuribito or Ittan-momen being healed in the battle. In this case, each challenge grants at least 100 points.
- Players with an Event Total Score below 300,000 will not be put in the ranking.

Assisting Shikigami
- Players can spend Jade to have an assisting shikigami to help in the defense every day. 
- The assisting shikigami will become an extra ally unit in the battle.
- Each assisting shikigami will be available until 12:00 A.M. the next day.

Event Rewards
- Rich rewards will be offered for the first 2 challenges daily, normal rewards will be offered since the third time. A challenge reward will be offered when completing the challenges of two zones in “solo mode” for the first time each day. 
- Individual Accumulated Damage Rewards will be offered when player's total damage to Okuribito or Ittan-momen reaches certain thresholds.
- The server's Defense Reward Grade will be decided on the server total damage when the event ends. 
- Individual Rewards are based on one’s performance in the server percentile rank. Better rewards for higher rank players. 
- Players ranked in the top tier are eligible to receive SR Shikigami Okuribito and Ittan-momen shards. Okuribito and Ittan-momen will be available to summon. We will inform the exact date later.
- Defense Grade Rewards will be issued to players on Feb. 22nd by in-game mail. Please don’t forget to claim the rewards.

Note: Okuribito and Ittan-momen cannot be summoned in this update. 

[h1]2. Paper Crane Wishes[/h1]

Do you have a secret affection for a fellow Onmyoji, or maybe just a heartfelt thank you to those who helped you in Heian-Kyo?

Why not let the paper crane carry your message!

On Feb. 14th (EST), players can purchase "Paper Crane Wishes" in the mall to deliverer messages; meanwhile, players will receive the event-limited frame after purchase.

Wish receivers can give a response, while others can give a like in the channel to receive a random reward.

For every paper crane received, 1 paper crane will show up on courtyard trees. The max. amount of paper crane displayed is seven.

Don't miss out the chance of confessing your love!

[h1]3. Demon Seal for Ittan-momen[/h1]

From Feb. 14th 00:00 to Feb 20th 23:59 EST, Ittan-momen's shards are in Demon Seal(maximum10 shards daily). Collect 40 shards to summon your own Ittan-momen!

Note: Ittan-momen cannot be summoned in this update. 

[h1]----Fixed Issues and Optimizations----[/h1]
1. Fixed language and technical bugs.

- Recharge to a certain amount to obtain bonus rewards, including "Dark Seimei" limited skin.
- For players who already have "Dark Seimei" limited skin, they will receive a "Lord of Kyoto" frame instead.
- Players who already have "Lord of Kyoto" frame will receive an upgraded Gold Daruma version "Lord of Kyoto" frame.
- For players who already have the Gold Daruma version "Lord of Kyoto" frame, they will receive 2 Boutique talismans instead, and will gain the right to enter the Boutique!
- The Boutique offers various items for exchange.

[h1]6. New Skins for Susabi and Chin[/h1]

After the update on Jan. 30th, Susabi's new skin “Summer Night Sky” and Chin's “Twittering Emerald”  will be available for purchase in skin store. There will be a 20% discount for the first week, don’t miss out!

[h1]7. New loading pictures on sale![/h1]

Added an update default pictures of Lunar New Year and joyful winter days, and also the previous update default loading pictures and the upcoming mysterious Shikigami's pictures are available to buy in the mall.

[h1]8. Lunar New Year Events upcoming! [/h1]

To celebrate the upcoming Lunar New Year, get ready for a series of events in Heian-Kyo! Come and get your share of fortune!

- Daily Free Summon
Event time: February 4th 00:00 - February 8th 23:59 EST
During the event, players get 1 free summon every day!

- Shikigami Skins on Discount
Event time: February 4th 00:00 -  February 8th 23:59 EST
During the event, all skins in the shop except Susabi's "Summer Night Sky", Chin's "Twittering Emerald" and all the Limited Shikigami skins will be 20% off!
Note:  Susabi's "Summer Night Sky" and Chin's "Twittering Emerald" will be 20% off during February 4th 00:00 to February 6th 02:30 EST since they are still in the first-week discount. 

- Lunar New Year Packs on Sale
Event time: On sale from February 4th 00:00 - February 5th 23:59 EST

- Lunar New Year Boss Challenge
Event time: February 4th - February 5th, 2:00 - 22:00 daily EST

Challenge the Lunar New Year Boss Ebisu for a chance to obtain rewards including many frames such as Ebisu Frame, Reality Rendezvous Frame, Jade, AR Amulets, and more. Also, the new item Challange Coin can be obtained during the event. Use Challenge Coins that are randomly dropped by Boss Ebisu to redeem various rewards in the Challenge Shop! The Challenge Shop will be open for business during the event!

[h1]----Improvements----[/h1]

1. Increased the rate of searching the boss in Demon Encounter. 
2.  Optimized UI for Bond:
- Added current Bond value to the Bond progress bar. Players can see clearly how much Bond they have established with other players;
- Added a daily Bond progress page where players can check how much Bond they've received for the day and how much Bond they can receive for each interaction with their friends; (Data between friends may be subject to time lags. Please wait for the data of both players to be synced.)
-  Sending skins to a friend now will increase your Bond with your friend by 75 for each skin sent.
3. Lineup previews in Personal Realm Raids and Guild Raids now show the Onmyoji info of the lineups.
4.  Blacklist function improved. Blacklisted players can no longer leave messages on the player's Page.
5. Timer added to the Sougenbi zones and Totem zones.
6. Optimized operations for Pre-set Soul Profiles. Players can now change the currently displayed Shikigami in the profile list page. They can also now tap on the blank space to close the page.
7. Optimized the UI of Collection - Area Collection.
8. Shikigami Model Improvements
- Improved the model display of Aoandon after her evolution.
- Improved the model display of Enma after her evolution.
9. The PC version now supports mouse wheel scrolling in the Exploration zone.
10. Added lock lineup function to the Guild Raid page.
11. Improved the display of the EXP bar of players at max level in Courtyard and Town.
12. Players can now access the Onmyoji and Shikigami page in the Area Boss main page, helping them make adjustments to their Onmyoji, Shikigami, and souls equipped.
13. Improved how the date is displayed in friends' chat.
14. Players can now lock their Shikigami shards. Locked Shikigami shards must be unlocked before they can be used to summon a Shikigami. Players can still donate the shards they have locked to their guildmates or friends.
16. Added a page-closing option when a friend sends a Co-op Wanted Quest.

[h1]----Fixed Issues and Optimizations----[/h1]

1. Fixed language and technical bugs.
2. Fixed the missing firework effect and the Shikigami Easter egg in the Courtyard's Summer Nights skin.
3. Fixed the skill names of Yellow Imp, which were displayed incorrectly when using the skills in certain zones as a monster.
4. Fixed a stretched camera view issue when tapping Shrine in some cases.
5. Fixed the battle replays showing the unmatched Shikigami evolution status and skin.
6. Fixed the issue with the Exploration zone map appearing abnormal when multi-touch is used.
7. Fixed the issue with the team page appearing abnormal when players try to enter a team while the display Shikigami for the Courtyard is being changed.
8. Fixed the issue with the tab text of Explore and Challenge in the first 18 chapters showing incorrect colors when players switch between the two tabs.
9. Fixed the issue with the purchase pop-up still appearing for items that are sold out in the Merchant.
10. Fixed an issue of additional Slow effect in Poison status due to an inability to trigger the effect of increasing the extra base chance of inflicting Freeze on the target, created by the SR Shikigami Yuki Onna's Blizzard or the 4-piece set effect of Snow Spirit.
11. Fixed an issue causing Yamakaze's Violent failure to take effect at the end of a turn when the effect of Suppress inflicted on Yamakaze disappears on the turn he's inflicted with the Suppress effect.
12. Fixed an issue causing Kosodenote's Thread Connection to be unable to transfer indirect damage.
13. Fixed an issue causing the controlling effect of Deep Slumber being removed when no actual damage is dealt due to the protection of the shielding effect.
14. Fixed an issue enabling Kuro's Soul Rage to still be triggered by transferred damage under some circumstances.
15. Fixed an issue causing the effect of The Protection of Shiro from Shiro's Soul Call to remove other shielding effects when blocking damage.
16. Fixed the required score display being shown incorrectly for each tier in Duel Tiers.
17. Fixed an issue causing some battle result pages to look abnormal.
18. Fixed the wine table and the paper doll appearing outside the screen when using the Kosodenote-themed realm skin Threaded Memories in some resolutions on some devices.

notes.title: Okikumushi is Coming! | Update on January 16th
notes.content:
Dear Onmyoji,

To ensure a better game experience, we are performing an update from [b]Jan. 16th 2:00 to Jan. 16th 6:00 EST[/b]. During this time you will not be able to log in. The duration time is an estimate and may be extended due to technical issues. We really appreciate your patience and understanding.

[h1]----Update Content----[/h1]

[h1]1. New SR Shikigami Okikumushi is Coming![/h1]

“Eating leaves during the day, sleeping during the night... Is this really the way to become a beautiful butterfly?” After the update on Jan. 16th, the new Shikigami will arrive.

[h1]2. Okikumushi & SP/SSR Chance Up![/h1]

After the update on Jan. 16th - Jan. 22nd 23:59 EST

- Players have 5 times chance up of getting Okikumushi while summoning SR Shikigami (be increased to 15%)
- Players have 1 time 2.5X chance up of summoning SP/ SSR Shikigami.

Note: the event only applies to players of level 15 and above.

[h1]3. Challenge the Grade 6 Kirin![/h1]

After the update on January 16th (EST), Guilds level 3 or higher which have defeated Grade 5 Kirin, will be able to challenge the new Grade 6 Kirin! The Grade 6 Kirin hunt can be initiated by the Guild Master or Officers. 

Onmyoji, gather your guild members and prepare to challenge the Grade 6 Kirin!

[h1]4. New Side Story "Wails of the Flock" is released![/h1]

After the update on Jan. 16th (EST), players can access this new side chapter through Heian Tales! To Unlock the side story, Shikigami  Chin is required.

[h1]5. Prepare to challenge a new Secret Zone![/h1]

After the update on January 16th (EST), a new secret zone Youko's Romance" will be added! Clear all 10 stages of the secret zone to obtain Youko's new skin "Fox of Mystery".

[h1]6. New Feature "Shikigami Dance" is coming![/h1]

After the update on January 16th (EST), the new feature "Shikigami Dance" is coming! Now you can enjoy the dance of certain Shikigami by using the AR feature. Tap "Collection", then tap the fan on the top right corner to enter.

Note: this is only available for the Mobile device. 

[h1]7. New skins on sale![/h1]

After the update on January 16th (EST), the Yumekui's skin "Azure Nightmare" and the Miketsu’s skin “Bountiful Goddess" will be added to the skin store. Also, they will be 20% off during the first week!

[h1]----Fixed Issues and Optimizations----[/h1]

1. Fixed language and technical bugs.
2. Optimized the Buff Feature
- Players can turn on/off the buff in preparation for the battle. 
3. Optimized the "Make Wish" Feature
- Added the sliding bar and category buttons in the Guild interface. Players can tap the button to a certain area.

[h1]----Shikigami Improvements----[/h1]

1. Yamakaze

Adjusted the indirect damage equal to 18% of target's current HP + 120% Yamakaza's ATK (max 150%) caused by the Torn effects inflicted by Demonic Slash after the target's turn to the indirect damage equal to 12% of target's current HP + 88% Yamakaza's ATK (max 320%). And the damage ignores target's DEF by 600.

2. Hiyoribo - Nourishment

Adjusted the calculation order of Hiyoribou's Revive from reviving instantly to reviving after the skill takes effect. This was done to fix the fluctuation caused by calculating part of the revive amount.

3. Corrected the description of Divination Sigil(Yao Bikuni) and Backlash Wave! (Inuyasha).

4. Modified the problem that the transitive damage by the skill "Decoy Doll" of Ushi no Toki won't trigger Soul "Kyoukotsu".

4. Fixed the issue that under specific circumstance, Seimei's Divine Lightning and Kagura's Divine Fire will awaken enemies under Sleep effect when dealing damage.

5. Fixed the issue that Kaguya's Dragon Jewel can obtain orbs in the turn of Judge Banner.

6. Fixed the issue that the skill "Diamond Sutra" of Hitotsume will be triggered out without being damaged.

7. Fixed the issue that the damage of Fujin won't increase after upgrade the level of Ryomen's skill "Divine Combo" from 4 to 5. 

8. Increase the direct and subsequent damage caused by the skill "Death Penalty" of Hangan from 79% attack (max 95%) to 100% attack (max 125%)

notes.title: Get Ready for New Gameplay “Heian Fable”! | Update on January 9th
notes.content:
Dear Onmyoji,
 
To ensure a better game experience, we are performing an update from [b]Jan. 9th 2:00 to Jan. 9th 6:00 EST[/b]. During this time you will not be able to log in. The duration time is an estimate and may be extended due to technical issues. We really appreciate your patience and understanding.
 
[h1]----Update Content----[/h1]
 
[h1]1. Get Ready for New Gameplay “Heian Fable”[/h1]
 
The underworld was supposed to purify evil spirits. However, due to the over-powerful Onikiri, the evil demons and spirits are escaping and disturbing the peace in Heian-Kyo. In a sudden visit by Ibaraki Doji, Seimei is asked to travel to the underworld and cleanse the evilness. How will the story unfold between Seimei, Ibaraki Doji, and Onikiri?
 
Find out in the brand new game mode "Heian Fable” after the update on Jan. 9th!

[h1]2. Gold Talisman Exchange Is Coming! [/h1]
 
After the update on January 9th, Gold Talismans can be used to redeem Gilded Box in the shrine, which contains various rewards including SP skin tokens and more! SP skin tokens can be used to redeem SP skins for random Shikigami in the shrine.
 
[h1]3. Onmyoji Golden Skin Series[/h1]
 
After the update on January 9th (EST), the golden skin series will be added to the game! Players who collect the 'Blazing Sun frame', 'In the Clouds frame', and the 'Snake Sword frame' can unlock the new achievement "Onmyoji Conqueror", and will be rewarded the following Onmyoji Golden Skin series:
 
- Seimei: Golden Maple
- Kagura: Golden Autumn
- Hiromasa: Golden Bow
- Yao Bikuni: Golden Phoenix
 
How to obtain these frames:
 
- "Blazing Sun" Frame: Players who complete "Full Collection" (Includes all SSR, SR, R, and N Shikigami) can obtain this frame.(This achievement is hidden unless you complete it)
- "In the Clouds" Frame: Players who clear all Secret Zones can unlock new achievement – ‘Domination: Secret Zones’ and receive this frame as a reward!
- "Snake Sword" Frame: Players have chances to obtain this frame by clearing Ultimate Orochi stage 7, 8, 9 or 10.
 
[h1]4.Kosodenote Realm Skin[/h1]
 
After the update on January 9th, Kosodenote's Realm Skin "Threaded Memories" will be added!
 
[h1]5. Fortune Temple[/h1]
 
After the update on January 10th 00:00 until January 18th 23:59 EST, the Fortune Temple will be open again! Don't miss your chance!
 
[h1]----Fixed Issues and Optimizations----[/h1]
 
- Fixed language and technical bugs.
- The SSR Box priced 6000 talismans will be online for one more turn.

notes.title: Inuyasha Crossover: Come to Meet Kikyo! | Update on December 12th
notes.content:
Dear Onmyoji,
 
To ensure a better game experience, we are performing an update from Dec. 12th 2:00 to Dec. 12th 6:00 EST. During this time you will not be able to log in. The duration time is an estimate and may be extended due to technical issues. We really appreciate your patience and understanding.
 
[h1]----Update Content----[/h1]
 
[h1]1. Inuyasha Crossover: Come to Meet Kikyo![/h1]
 
The 2nd Onmyoji x InuYasha Crossover event is coming! With Inuyasha and Sesshomaru returning, and Kikyo as a newcomer to Heian-Kyo!
 
Event Time: After the update on December 12th - December 18th 23:59 EST
 
- During the event, summon with Mystery Amulets, Jade, or AR Amulets for a chance to get Inuyasha, Sesshomaru or Kikyo shards! Players can designate the shard they want before summoning and can change their choice at any time.
 
- During the event, players who clear Exploration Zone will have a chance to encounter Kikyo's Demon Seal, clearing it will have a chance of obtaining shards of Kikyo (maximum 1 daily) or shards of her skin (maximum 4 daily).
 
Note:
 
- Onmyoji x InuYasha Crossover Event will be held a total of 3 times, this is the 2nd time. Limited SSR Character Inuyasha, Sesshomaru, and Kikyo can only be acquired through this event. 
 
- Before using Mystery Amulet, Jade or AR Amulet to summon, players can designate a type of shard from Inuyasha, Sesshomaru or Kikyo. When performing summon, players will have a chance of obtaining shards for the chosen character.
 
- Inuyasha, Sesshomaru, and Kikyo can only be acquired by collecting shards. They cannot be obtained directly from summoning.
 
[h1]2.Inuyasha Crossover: Kikyo's New Skin! [/h1]
 
Event Time: After the update on December 12th - December 18th 23:59 EST
 
Players can collect Kikyo's skin shards by challenging the assembly boss in Demon Encounter, clearing Kikyo's Demon Seal or purchasing shards from the general store. Collect 50 shards to redeem this limited skin from the skin store! Additional rewards will be presented to players who obtain this limited skin during the event period.
 
Note:
- During the event, players who clear an Exploration Zone will have a chance to encounter the Demon Seal of Kikyo. Shards of Kikyo and her skin can be obtained from the Demon Seal by chance.
- At most 1 Kikyo shard and 4 Kikyo skin shards can be obtained from Demon Seal per day.
- Players can also pray for 1 Kikyo's skin shard per day in the Guild interface.
 
[h1]3. Seimei's Lost Memory and the Final Battle[/h1]
 
The wheel of fate has started to turn again. Seimei and his party arrive in a desolated ruin, where the last piece of Seimei's lost memory lies. With the help from a mysterious figure, Seimei finally recalls his past and prepares for his final confrontation with Orochi.
 
Watch the end of the long battle against Orochi in the new Main Story Chapter 26 - "Final Battle", which will be available in the near future!
 
[h1]4. Inuyasha Crossover: Limited Shikigami in Royal Battle![/h1]
 
Don’t be disappointed if you haven’t been able to gather enough Inuyasha, Sesshomaru and Kikyo shards, since Inuyasha, Sesshomaru and Kikyo will be joining Royal Battle after update on Dec. 12th. Participate in the Royal Battle and watch their exceptional performance in battle.
 
[h1]5. Hot Spring Courtyard Skin Event![/h1]
 
Event Time: Dec. 12th 2018 after update - Jan. 11th 2019 23:59 EST
 
During the event, complete the puzzle to unlock the Courtyard's skin - Hot Spring. Seize the chance to get the wonderful courtyard skin! 
 
[h1]6. New Winter Skins of Hana and Yuki[/h1]
 
After the update on Dec. 12th, Hana's new skin "Frosted Pearl" and Yuki's new skin "Direwolf" will be available for purchase in skin store. There will be a 20% discount for the first week, don’t miss out!
 
[h1]7. Inuyasha Crossover Packs on Sale![/h1]
 
Inuyasha Summon Pack I (price: 50 S-Jade)
 
(1). Base Daruma x 3
(2). Daily reward for 7 days: Mystery Amulet x 1, coin x 10,000

Inuyasha Summon Pack II (price: 350 S-Jade)
 
(1). Grade Daruma x 3, Mystery Amulet x 5
(2). Daily reward for 14 days: Mystery Amulet x 1, Coin x 50,000
 
Inuyasha Summon Pack III (price: 850 S-Jade)
 
(1). Grade 3 Grade Daruma x3, Mystery Amulet x10
(2). Daily reward for 14 days: Mystery Amulet x 2, coin x 50,000, EXP Daruma x 1, Skill Daruma Shard x 2
 
Kikyo Arrives! I (price: 50 S-Jade)
 
Mystery Amulet x 15, Base Daruma x 5, Grade Daruma x 5, Exp Daruma x5, Jade x 300
 
Kikyo Arrives! II (price: 350 S-Jade)

Kikyo Arrives! III (price: 1600 S-Jade)
 
Mystery Amulet x 50, Grade 4 Grade Daruma x 3, Grade 3 Grade Daruma x 5, EXP Daruma x 10, Jade x 1000, Skill Daruma x 1
 
[h1]----Experience Improvements----[/h1]
 
1. Clarified the text description on the mentor system application page.
2. Adjusted the Shikigami selection slide bar position when dispatching Shikigami on iPhone X resolution.
3. Balanced the size and scale of Shikigami on the summon page after summoning via Draw x 10.
4. Optimized the AI of Chocho's Dance of Hope in auto mode. Now she performs healing when the HP of an ally is below 75% instead of 50% as before. The change does not affect Chocho as a monster in zones, whose AI remains unchanged.
5. Balanced and unified the size and standing position of Shikigami in the Skins and Shikigami page.
6. Using the mouse wheel to zoom in and out on images is now supported on PC version.
7. Added ways to share replays after players clear stage 10 of Ultimate Orochi and win Royal Battles.
8. Added a new chat channel: Mentor!
- Mentor channel is a channel created specially for players to find Mentors and Apprentices.
- Only players qualified to be Mentors or Apprentices who are currently not under any mentorship are eligible to enter the channel.
- In the channel, players can chat freely to find Mentors or Apprentices.
9. Added the amount owned by the player to the description of some of the items.
10. Added a way for players to view the bios of Demon Encounter bosses. Players can now view their bios from the Boss Collection.
11. Fixed the display error regarding levels on the Soul page.
12. Fixed the error message pop-up that appeared when trying to share Bond progress after it was promoted to the next level.
13. Fixed a display issue on the wish-making page in a guild.
14. Fixed the frame of the shard of Inferno Ibaraki Doji showing an incorrect rarity.
15. Improved the display style when viewing the concept art of Shikigami on the Shikigami page. The word "Evolved" is now removed.
16. Improved the display of the Reverse Scales players currently own when exchanging for Souls in the Soul shop.
17. Improved the map in the Exploration zone. Player characters will no longer be covered up certain areas on the map.
18. Clarified the ambiguous description of the Unlucky Streak achievement.
19. Improved how players can deploy Shikigami when dispatching Shikigami. Players can now tap to dispatch them, in addition to dragging them.
20. Players can now tap and hold to select multiple souls when releasing souls.
21. Players in the Recent contacts/Recent teams lists who have not been added as friends now have an "Add as Friend" button added to their extended panel so players can add them easily.
22. Added sharing feature to Area Boss: Conquer the World achievement. Players can now share the Conquer the World mark from the list of marks.
 
[h1]----Bug Fixes----[/h1]
 
1. Fixed the default display order for pre-set lineups before battles. Optimized the UI of pre-set lineups before battles.
2. Fixed the issue of Area Bosses still being locked when players have the exact amount of Fame to unlock them.
3. Fixed issues that prevented the Duel Wins: Ootengu and Duel Wins: Hououga achievements from completing.
4. Fixed an issue that caused the icons above the firework frog and firework paper doll to disappear when players access the guild feast from the Shikigami page.
5. Fixed the incorrect multiplier of Kiyohime's skill when she is a monster in zones.
6. Fixed the lag when selecting Shikigami on the Dispatching Shikigami page.
7. Fixed the issue that caused the extended Friends page to not disappear when a new group chat is created.
8. Corrected the incorrect description of Ryomen shard.
9. Fixed the facing issue of Ushi no Toki's straw doll when she summons the doll in Totem Zone battles.
10. Fix the display issue affecting Shikigami when they are frozen in Demon Parade.
11. Fixed the missing special effects of Chin's skill Chin's Feathers.
 
[h1]----Shikigami Improvements----[/h1]
 
1. Umibozu
 
Blessed Water
 
- Changed how the skill works. When a flurry of damage is dealt, the skill now calculates "the ally with the lowest proportion of HP" in a more timely manner, meaning that when a team has multiple allies with damaged HP, the skill targets more evenly when healing them, rather than targeting only 1-2 allies when healing.
 
- Skill improvement. The healing effect is now triggered only by damage dealt by his own skills (extra damage inflicted, such as from the soul Seductress, no longer triggers the healing effect). When a target receives healing multiple times in an action, the healing efficiency is now reduced by 15% for each extra healing received.
 
Giant Waves
 
Reduced the skill-casting animation time from 5.2s to 2.9s to speed up the pace.
- Damage increased. The skill now deals damage equal to 45% of his ATK instead of 39% when at the max level.

2. Nekomata
 
Improved the AI of Nekomata in auto mode. Meowlee Attack is now prioritized before Meownified Attack when either of the below conditions is met.
 
- When there is an enemy with HP below 70%.
- When there is only one enemy left.
 
3. Fixed the issue affecting Ichimokuren's ATK draining effect from his Wind Amulet: Damage was counted as a debuff. The effect is now counted as a buff.
 
4. Fixed the issue affecting Warrior Soul's Soul Slash. "When Haunting Soul is dispelled, 1 orb is removed from target" no longer triggers when all debuffs are dispelled on ending a round.
 
5. Fixed the issue that prevented the soul Nightwing from triggering correctly when dealing damage with some skills.
